positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 51.000 colleagues in nearly 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

Job Description:

Join our Data & AI team.

You will become part of a multidisciplinary team where data engineering, architecture, AI, analytics, governance and visualization come together. Together, we help clients get more value out of their data: from setting up the right data foundations to building dashboards, analytics solutions and AI use cases that support better decisions.

As a Data Engineer, will work with modern data technologies to develop and manage end-to-end data solutions, from ingestion and transformation to serving layers. In close collaboration with other data experts (BI consultants, AI engineers, etc.) and client stakeholders, you will translate business and analytics requirements into production-ready, end-to-end data systems.

You will be part of our Data Foundation practice: a team of data engineers and architects, within our Data & AI department. Looking beyond the sleek dashboards and hype-driven AI applications, we make sure that AI and BI initiatives are powered by a reliable and performant back end. Using proven components and best practices, we continuously challenge ourselves to design solutions tailored to our clients’ data needs, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Your responsibilities include the following:

  • Build high-quality data solutions that create value for our clients.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them to technical specifications.
  • Design, implement and orchestrate scalable and efficient data pipelines to collect, process, and serve large datasets.
  • Contribute to sales proposals and business development initiatives.
  • Engage in knowledge-sharing and support more junior colleagues.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for client advisory.
Qualifications:

We’re seeking motivated colleagues who are eager to engineer the best solutions for our clients and to be an active member of our team of experts. If you enjoy tackling complex technical problems and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in software engineering in a data context.
  • Programming experience with one or more languages, such as Python.
  • Knowledge of storage concepts/technologies (RDBs, DWHs, lakehouses, etc.)  and distributed computing.
  • Experience in designing, building and owning data pipelines (Databricks, dbt, Airflow, ...)
  • Experience with at least one cloud provider (Azure, AWS or GCP).
  • Experience with incremental and streaming workloads, CDC and SCD.
  • Familiar with platform engineering (including CI/CD and IaC automation) in a data mesh-like context.
  • The concept of DataOps is embedded in your way of working.
  • Familiar with the challenges of BI and AI workloads and applications.
  • Experienced in implementing data governance & security (IAM, data quality mgmt, metadata mgmt., ...).
  • Aware of currently available technologies and upcoming data trends.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Able to work autonomously, balance multiple stakeholders, make pragmatic technical decisions and manage work time effectively.
  • Strong communicative and interpersonal skills, bridging technical and business audiences while building strong client and team relationships.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, helping our team grow.
  • You have a degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related field.
  • You are proficient in English and Dutch or French

What we can offer you  

At Sopra Steria, you’ll join our Data Foundations Practice within the Data & AI team: a group of experts building modern data platforms that power analytics and AI.

We design scalable, secure and maintainable data pipelines and architectures using best practices and tools like Databricks, Azure, SQL and Snowflake.

You’ll help build the backbone of Data & AI, improving reliability and data quality through automation, testing and monitoring, within a collaborative and fast-learning environment.

As part of Sopra Steria, you’ll also benefit from strong career development opportunities, both locally and internationally, supported by the Sopra Steria Academy and a wider network of more than 51.000 professionals.

 

Additional Information:

We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes: 

  • A variety of perks, such as mobility options (including a company car), insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more. 
  • Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development. 
  • The opportunity to connect with fellow Sopra Steria colleagues at various team events. 

Our goal is to build high-functioning teams and healthy team environments that inspire and help each other to deliver excellence for each of our customers.

Excited about this job opportunity? Great! We are looking forward to your application!

______

Sopra Steria is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, ancestry, nationality, color, family or medical leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

positions.title: Product Manager Manufacturing (Kapelle-op-den-Bos, BE)
positions.description:
At Etex, our purpose is building better together. We are an international leader in sustainable construction, driven by a passion for excellence, but it's our people that are our top priority. We connect, collaborate, and champion the well-being of our employees, forming partnerships and pioneering change in our ever-evolving industry.
At Etex, we seek to make a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and our communities. Are you looking for a company where you can learn, grow & lead? Join us as IT Product Manager for Manufacturing and drive operational excellence! We are looking for a dynamic and solution-oriented manufacturing product manager to amplify our manufacturing products, services and projects. In this role, you will drive the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of digital manufacturing products – examples include MES system, S/4Hana, predictive and condition-based maintenance, Computerized Maintenance Management Systems, IoT energy monitoring, Advanced Analytics & AI, and IT and OT convergences.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering, operations, cybersecurity and external partners to ensure our manufacturing products deliver measurable value, remain secure, and evolve with the needs of the organization.
What You'll Do:

Drive and define the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle together with the divisional and central business stakeholders
Translate business needs into clear product requirements and prioritize the backlog based on value, risk, and operational impact
Champion innovation by leveraging AI to drive a data culture, unlock deeper insights across the production process, and increase efficiency within IT function
Ensure alignment with corporate strategy, sustainability goals, and regulatory requirements
End‑to‑end ownership of one or more product areas in manufacturing in the fields of Production, maintenance, energy, EH&S and/or IT/OT.
Coordinate with internal teams and external partner to ensure on‑time and in‑budget delivery.
Oversee and steer implementation, testing, deployment, change management, and user adoption.
Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of manufacturing products.
Ensure patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security compliance processes exist and are executed by IT operations and OT teams.
Monitor KPIs and system performance, proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
Act as the primary point of contact for your manufacturing products both at central and local level
Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and transform business challenges into solutions.
Communicate product updates, roadmaps, and performance metrics to leadership and user community.
Ensure all systems comply with cybersecurity standards, audit requirements, and industry regulations.
Maintain documentation, risk assessments, and change records.

What You'll Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Several years of experience in IT product management, IT project management, or comparable roles within complex environments.
Strong understanding of manufacturing (process), business processes, across production and maintenance.
Experience or keen interest in working in industrial, manufacturing, utilities, or OT‑heavy environments.
Solid knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity principles, and application lifecycle management
Familiar with SAP S/4HANA or ECC, particularly modules PM, PP and/or QM and open to dive deeper into the topic
Good understanding of SDLC, release management, and environment coordination.
Dynamic and entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for continuous learning & improvement.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical perspectives.
Strong problem‑solving abilities, able to turn complex challenges into pragmatic solutions.
Customer‑focused mindset with experience scaling Proofs of Concept into impactful, production‑ready solutions across large, global manufacturing landscapes (100+ sites).
Ability to lead, manage, and coach diverse, cross‑functional teams.
Proactive approach and willingness to take end‑to‑end ownership.

Why Join Us:

We are named the world's #1 most trustworthy company in the construction sector by Newsweek and Statista in 2023! And one of the top companies to grow your career in Belgium in 2023 according to LinkedIn!
Our culture – we connect & care about those around us. We nurture teamwork, communities, partnerships and new ways of working, placing the highest importance on the safety and working environment of our people.

In this role, you will drive the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of digital manufacturing products – examples include MES system, S/4Hana, predictive and condition-based maintenance, Computerized Maintenance Management Systems, IoT energy monitoring, Advanced Analytics & AI, and IT and OT convergences.

  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements and prioritize the backlog based on value, risk, and operational impact
  • Champion innovation by leveraging AI to drive a data culture, unlock deeper insights across the production process, and increase efficiency within IT function
  • Ensure alignment with corporate strategy, sustainability goals, and regulatory requirements
  • End‑to‑end ownership of one or more product areas in manufacturing in the fields of Production, maintenance, energy, EH&S and/or IT/OT.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partner to ensure on‑time and in‑budget delivery.
  • Oversee and steer implementation, testing, deployment, change management, and user adoption.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of manufacturing products.
  • Ensure patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security compliance processes exist and are executed by IT operations and OT teams.
  • Monitor KPIs and system performance, proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for your manufacturing products both at central and local level
  • Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and transform business challenges into solutions.
  • Communicate product updates, roadmaps, and performance metrics to leadership and user community.
  • Ensure all systems comply with cybersecurity standards, audit requirements, and industry regulations.
  • Maintain documentation, risk assessments, and change records.

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Several years of experience in IT product management, IT project management, or comparable roles within complex environments.

At Etex, our purpose is to inspire new ways of living. We are an international leader in sustainable construction, driven by a passion for excellence, but it's our people that are our top priority. We connect, collaborate, and champion the well-being of our employees, forming partnerships and pioneering change in our ever-evolving industry.
At Etex, we seek to make a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and our communities. Are you looking for a company where you can learn, grow & lead? Join us as Global Testing Engineer and drive operational excellence!Before the use of building materials is approved for use in fire rated constructions, their fire performance is demonstrated by fire tests.
These fire tests are executed to the specifications given internationally defined standards.As the Global Test Engineer, together with independent test labs, you will define a test package for an approval that is in line with the demand of our Product managers or R&D experts.
What You'll Do:

Define test packages with independent fire test laboratories.
Draft precise CAD drawings for each required fire test.
Organize logistics of all building materials to European test labs.
Supervise on‑site installation performed by the internal installation team.

Witness and monitor the execution of fire tests.
Evaluate fire test results and analyze performance data.
Propose improvements and follow up on corresponding approvals.

Master’s degree in engineering or equivalent by experience
Curiosity and willingness to learn about fire testing within construction sector.
Proactive attitude and hands-on approach.
Excellent communication skills and ability to connect with people within different levels of organization.
Analytical and detail-oriented mindset.
Auto Cad knowledge.
Experience in fire resistance or fire testing is a plus.
Willingness to travel internationally on occasion.

positions.title: Proces Engineer (Meppel, NL, 7944HT)
positions.description:
Als Proces Engineer bij Scania Production Meppel draag je bij aan processen die dagelijks impact maken in onze fabriek én daarbuiten. Je werkt in een omgeving waar samenwerking, vertrouwen en vakmanschap centraal staan, en waar collega’s elkaar actief ondersteunen om samen beter te worden. Hier krijg je de ruimte om verbeteringen door te voeren die niet alleen technisch kloppen, maar ook echt werken in de praktijk. Tegelijkertijd bouw je aan je eigen ontwikkeling binnen een organisatie die zich inzet voor een duurzame toekomst in transport, met arbeidsvoorwaarden die passen bij jouw werkweek en behoefte aan balans. Hier werken we samen aan de uitdagingen van vandaag en de oplossingen van morgen. En daar zijn we trots op.
 
 Draag bij aan de toekomst bij Scania als Proces Engineer
Als Proces Engineer bepaal jij jouw impact binnen Scania. Samen met jouw collega’s zorg je ervoor dat de processen in onze paintshop (het hart van de fabriek) continu verbeteren en betrouwbaar blijven draaien. Je werkt samen aan verschillende technische projecten en draagt bij aan verbeter- en vervangingsprojecten. Je neemt deel aan of leidt optimalisaties op het gebied van techniek, veiligheid en efficiëntie, met steun van je team. Kijkend naar jouw competenties en interesses stemmen we de inhoud van het Proces Engineer pakket zo goed mogelijk af, zodat je werkt aan de projecten die bij je passen en waarin je je verder kunt ontwikkelen. Zo ben je als Proces Engineer een waardevolle en betrokken schakel binnen het team. Concrete werkzaamheden kunnen zijn:

het coördineren en uitwerken van technische vraagstukken rondom de installatie van nieuwe lakrobots, samen met betrokken collega’s en partners.
het coördineren van veiligheidsprojecten en het oppakken van deelprojecten gericht op het voldoen aan veiligheidsrichtlijnen, met technische en procesmatige oplossingen.
het ondersteunen als superuser van het MES-systeem dat de paintshop aanstuurt, waarbij je zorgt voor een duidelijke werkwijze, verbeteringen coördineert en schakelt met onze externe partner die het systeem beheert.

De missie van Scania 
Wereldwijd werken wij met zo’n 58.000 collega’s samen aan duurzame transportoplossingen. Wat wij doen, heeft impact, vandaag én morgen. Daarom geven we elkaar de ruimte om mee te denken en te verbeteren. Zo bouwen we samen aan echte verandering.
 
Scania Production Meppel
Onze fabriek in Meppel is uniek door de meest geavanceerde lakrobots ter wereld, maar het zijn onze mensen die ons écht speciaal maken. Wij combineren hightech innovatie met de trots van oprecht vakmanschap. Samen met 12 collega’s vorm jij het team Process en Project Engineering Paintshop en werk je in een fijne LEAN-omgeving waar we echt op elkaar kunnen rekenen. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken en jezelf te ontwikkelen, omringd door de beste techniek en een team waarin jij écht het verschil maakt.
 
Jouw talenten
Jij voelt je op je plek wanneer je collega’s met verschillende achtergronden, disciplines en perspectieven met elkaar verbindt en actief bijdraagt aan een open en ondersteunende werksfeer. Je bent een motivator die niet afwacht, maar zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt en anderen daarin meeneemt. Met een inventieve blik zie je kansen voor verbetering en weet je mensen op een positieve manier in beweging te brengen. Verder heb je:

een afgeronde technische of werktuigbouwkundige hbo-opleiding.
goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.
ervaring hebt in een productie- of engineeringomgeving of een relevante stage afgerond.

Wat biedt Scania jou 
Werken bij Scania draait niet alleen om de functie, maar vooral om jou. Daarom kijken we verder dan alleen het werk en bieden we een arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket dat goed aansluit bij wat jij nodig hebt, nu en in de toekomst.
 
Je komt terecht in een professionele en stabiele werkomgeving met moderne technologie, waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je werk op jouw manier in te vullen en jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

een brutomaandsalaris van € 4.420 tot € 5.576 (afhankelijk van jouw werkweek).
27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen voor een goede werk-privébalans.
de vrijheid om deels vanuit huis te werken en zo je werk flexibel in te delen.
volop ruimte en aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en groei.
een uitstekende pensioenregeling voor later.

Morgen verbeteren begint vandaag als Proces Engineer bij Scania
Bij Scania geloven we dat diversiteit ons sterker maakt. We nodigen iedereen, ongeacht achtergrond of gender, van harte uit om op de vacature van Proces Engineer te reageren.
 
Vragen stellen mag altijd! Wil je meer weten over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Sara Hoekman,
Groupleader Process & Project Engineering via sara.hoekman@scania.com Wil je meer weten over de
sollicitatieprocedure? Neem daarvoor contact op met Hanjo Hartnack, Recruitment via
hanjo.hartnack@scania.com of +31 6 1869 1033.
 
--
 
Disclaimer externe recruitmentbureaus
Externe recruitmentbureaus kunnen kandidaten voorstellen wanneer zij beschikken over een geldige overeenkomst met Scania en hiervoor vooraf zijn uitgenodigd door Corporate Recruitment.
 
Ongevraagd toegestuurde cv’s of kandidaatprofielen worden niet in behandeling genomen via het betreffende bureau en geven geen recht op enige vergoeding of plaatsingsfee. Scania behoudt zich het recht voor om deze kandidaten indien gewenst rechtstreeks te benaderen en in procedure te nemen.

positions.descriptionMarkdown:
Als Proces Engineer bij Scania Production Meppel draag je bij aan processen die dagelijks impact maken in onze fabriek én daarbuiten. Je werkt in een omgeving waar samenwerking, vertrouwen en vakmanschap centraal staan, en waar collega’s elkaar actief ondersteunen om samen beter te worden. Hier krijg je de ruimte om verbeteringen door te voeren die niet alleen technisch kloppen, maar ook echt werken in de praktijk. Tegelijkertijd bouw je aan je eigen ontwikkeling binnen een organisatie die zich inzet voor een duurzame toekomst in transport, met arbeidsvoorwaarden die passen bij jouw werkweek en behoefte aan balans. Hier werken we samen aan de uitdagingen van vandaag en de oplossingen van morgen. En daar zijn we trots op.

 
Draag bij aan de toekomst bij Scania als Proces Engineer

Als Proces Engineer bepaal jij jouw impact binnen Scania. Samen met jouw collega’s zorg je ervoor dat de processen in onze paintshop (het hart van de fabriek) continu verbeteren en betrouwbaar blijven draaien. Je werkt samen aan verschillende technische projecten en draagt bij aan verbeter- en vervangingsprojecten. Je neemt deel aan of leidt optimalisaties op het gebied van techniek, veiligheid en efficiëntie, met steun van je team. Kijkend naar jouw competenties en interesses stemmen we de inhoud van het Proces Engineer pakket zo goed mogelijk af, zodat je werkt aan de projecten die bij je passen en waarin je je verder kunt ontwikkelen. Zo ben je als Proces Engineer een waardevolle en betrokken schakel binnen het team. Concrete werkzaamheden kunnen zijn:

 

- het coördineren en uitwerken van technische vraagstukken rondom de installatie van nieuwe lakrobots, samen met betrokken collega’s en partners.

- het coördineren van veiligheidsprojecten en het oppakken van deelprojecten gericht op het voldoen aan veiligheidsrichtlijnen, met technische en procesmatige oplossingen.

- het ondersteunen als superuser van het MES-systeem dat de paintshop aanstuurt, waarbij je zorgt voor een duidelijke werkwijze, verbeteringen coördineert en schakelt met onze externe partner die het systeem beheert.

 
De missie van Scania

Wereldwijd werken wij met zo’n 58.000 collega’s samen aan duurzame transportoplossingen. Wat wij doen, heeft impact, vandaag én morgen. Daarom geven we elkaar de ruimte om mee te denken en te verbeteren. Zo bouwen we samen aan echte verandering.

 
Scania Production Meppel

Onze fabriek in Meppel is uniek door de meest geavanceerde lakrobots ter wereld, maar het zijn onze mensen die ons écht speciaal maken. Wij combineren hightech innovatie met de trots van oprecht vakmanschap. Samen met 12 collega’s vorm jij het team Process en Project Engineering Paintshop en werk je in een fijne LEAN-omgeving waar we echt op elkaar kunnen rekenen. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken en jezelf te ontwikkelen, omringd door de beste techniek en een team waarin jij écht het verschil maakt.

 
Jouw talenten

Jij voelt je op je plek wanneer je collega’s met verschillende achtergronden, disciplines en perspectieven met elkaar verbindt en actief bijdraagt aan een open en ondersteunende werksfeer. Je bent een motivator die niet afwacht, maar zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt en anderen daarin meeneemt. Met een inventieve blik zie je kansen voor verbetering en weet je mensen op een positieve manier in beweging te brengen. Verder heb je:

 

- een afgeronde technische of werktuigbouwkundige hbo-opleiding.

- goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.

- ervaring hebt in een productie- of engineeringomgeving of een relevante stage afgerond.

 
Wat biedt Scania jou

Werken bij Scania draait niet alleen om de functie, maar vooral om jou. Daarom kijken we verder dan alleen het werk en bieden we een arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket dat goed aansluit bij wat jij nodig hebt, nu en in de toekomst.

 
Je komt terecht in een professionele en stabiele werkomgeving met moderne technologie, waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je werk op jouw manier in te vullen en jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

 

- een brutomaandsalaris van € 4.420 tot € 5.576 (afhankelijk van jouw werkweek).

- 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen voor een goede werk-privébalans.

- de vrijheid om deels vanuit huis te werken en zo je werk flexibel in te delen.

- volop ruimte en aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

- een uitstekende pensioenregeling voor later.

 
Morgen verbeteren begint vandaag als Proces Engineer bij Scania

Bij Scania geloven we dat diversiteit ons sterker maakt. We nodigen iedereen, ongeacht achtergrond of gender, van harte uit om op de vacature van Proces Engineer te reageren.

 
Vragen stellen mag altijd! Wil je meer weten over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Sara Hoekman,

Groupleader Process & Project Engineering via sara.hoekman@scania.com Wil je meer weten over de

sollicitatieprocedure? Neem daarvoor contact op met Hanjo Hartnack, Recruitment via

hanjo.hartnack@scania.com of +31 6 1869 1033.

positions.description:
Ben jij iemand die analytisch denkt, graag initiatief neemt en energie haalt uit het optimaliseren van logistieke processen? Wil jij werken in een dynamische omgeving waar jouw ideeën echt het verschil kunnen maken? Dan is de functie van Logistiek Engineer bij Scania Productie Zwolle echt iets voor jou. Continu verbeteren zit in ons DNA, we streven altijd naar beter. En daar zijn we trots op. 
Draag bij aan de toekomst bij Scania als Logistiek Engineer Als Logistiek Engineer bouw jij verder op 130 jaar innoveren. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het verbeteren en vernieuwen van logistieke processen binnen de organisatie. Je ondersteunt de logistieke afdeling bij het oplossen van knelpunten en zorgt voor het leiden en uitvoeren van logistieke verbeterprojecten. Daarnaast werk je aan het optimaliseren van lay-outs en transportstromen om de efficiëntie te verhogen. Je analyseert data en ontwikkelt duidelijke dashboards om de prestaties van de processen inzichtelijk te maken en continue verbetering te waarborgen. Als enthousiaste Logistiek Engineer ben jij daar dé aangewezen persoon voor. Verder houd jij je bezig met het:

bespreken van knelpunten met collega’s en samen acties opstellen.
zoeken naar manieren om werkplekken slimmer in te richten.
analyseren van de impact van nieuwe producten op de logistiek.
opvragen van offertes bij leveranciers voor nieuwe middelen.
maken van overzichtelijke dashboards die helpen bij het nemen van besluiten.

De missie van Scania In meer dan 100 landen werken wij met zo’n 58.000 collega's aan duurzame transportoplossingen. Hierbij staat de klant op nummer 1. Onze kernwaarden en principes zijn ons navigatiesysteem. Zo blijven we op de goede weg. We kijken vooruit, iedereen telt mee en jouw mening horen we graag. We drive real change.
Scania Production ZwolleWij zijn dé plek waar Scania-trucks tot leven komen. In Zwolle staat onze grootste en modernste assemblagefabriek van Europa, goed voor maar liefst 60% van de jaarlijkse Scania-productie. Hier komen alle losse onderdelen samen en worden ze omgevormd tot complete trucks die we leveren aan meer dan 80 landen wereldwijd. Met geavanceerde productietechnieken en een sterke focus op kwaliteit en efficiëntie blijven we innoveren. Dit doe je samen met 20 collega’s bij de afdeling Logistiek Engineering. Op deze afdeling werken we aan de logistieke toekomst van Scania Production Zwolle. 
 
Jouw talentenJij bent analytisch en neemt initiatief om processen te verbeteren. Je hebt een probleemoplossend vermogen en werkt goed samen met collega's om knelpunten aan te pakken. Je zoekt altijd naar manieren om efficiënter te werken en hebt oog voor detail. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder voorstellen doen en gegevens op een overzichtelijke manier presenteren. Verder heb je: 

een afgeronde hbo of wo-opleiding in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Logistiek of Industriële Automatisering.
affiniteit met en ervaring in logistieke processen en verbeterprojecten.
ervaring met het beheren en aanpassen van lay-outtekeningen in AutoCAD.
kennis van ERP-systemen, bij voorkeur SAP.
ervaring met data-analyses en simulaties in Python.
goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels, zowel spreken als schrijven.

Wat biedt Scania jou Bij ons maak je met jouw drive het verschil. Als Logistiek Engineer werk je in een omgeving vol professionals en de nieuwste technologieën. Daarnaast krijg je:

een brutomaandsalaris van €3511,18 tot € 4855,85 (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband).
een winstdeling.
27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen.
de ruimte en mogelijkheid om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. 

Morgen verbeteren begint vandaag
Geef je carrière een boost als Logistiek Engineer bij Scania! Of, zoals we het ook wel zeggen: let’s drive the future together. We ontvangen graag jouw sollicitatie op deze vacature van Logistiek Engineer bij Scania. Solliciteren kan door op de sollicitatiebutton te klikken. Let op: wanneer de juiste persoon is gevonden, sluit de vacature.

Wil je meer weten over de sollicitatieprocedure? Zoek dan contact met Inge van Weperen, Corporate Recruiter, via inge.van.weperen@scania.com.

positions.description:
Jij krijgt energie van een rol waarin je werkt aan diverse en complexe assets, wat zorgt voor afwisseling en inhoudelijke uitdaging. Je hebt veel autonomie in je werk en beweegt je vanuit een hecht en betrokken team tussen projecten en maintenance, waarbij je de verbinding legt met de organisatie en zorgt dat nieuwe en bestaande installaties goed op elkaar aansluiten. Binnen Scania Production Meppel heb je een zichtbare rol en denk je mee op strategisch, tactisch én operationeel niveau, met directe impact op hoe wij als Scania toekomstbestendig blijven. Hier werken we samen aan de uitdagingen van vandaag en de oplossingen van morgen. En daar zijn we trots op.
 
 Draag bij aan de toekomst bij Scania als Engineer Maintenance & Projects
Als Engineer Maintenance & Projects bepaal jij jouw impact binnen Scania. Samen met jouw collega’s zorg je ervoor dat onze installaties betrouwbaar, beschikbaar en goed te onderhouden zijn, nu én in de toekomst. Je brengt het maintenance-perspectief in bij projecten, van ontwerp tot oplevering, zodat onderhoud vanaf het begin goed is ingericht. Zo help je slimme keuzes maken die bijdragen aan stabiele processen en beheersbare kosten. Aan het einde van de dag zie je jouw impact terug in een soepel draaiende productie, een sterk onderhoudsplan en een samenwerking waarin collega’s elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Als ondernemende Engineer Maintenance & Projects ben jij een onmisbare schakel in ons team. Verder houd jij je bezig met het:

ontwikkelen en borgen van onderhoudsconcepten (preventief en predictief) en het voorbereiden en optimaliseren van onderhoudsplannen en spare parts.
opstellen van vervangingsplanningen, het bepalen hoe belangrijk installaties voor de operatie zijn en het optimaliseren van de technische beschikbaarheid.
vastleggen van onderhoudsinformatie en zorgen voor een complete en duidelijke vertaling naar de maintenance organisatie.
vertegenwoordigen van maintenance binnen projecten, van ontwerp tot oplevering, en het beoordelen van technische ontwerpen, leveranciersaanbiedingen en onderhoudscontracten.
deelnemen aan FAT/SAT en samenwerken met interne en externe stakeholders, ook internationaal, zodat alles goed op elkaar aansluit.

De missie van Scania 
Wereldwijd werken wij met zo’n 58.000 collega’s samen aan duurzame transportoplossingen. Wat wij doen, heeft impact, vandaag én morgen. Daarom geven we elkaar de ruimte om mee te denken en te verbeteren. Zo bouwen we samen aan echte verandering.
 
Scania Production Meppel
Onze fabriek in Meppel is uniek door de meest geavanceerde lakrobots ter wereld, maar het zijn onze mensen die ons écht speciaal maken. Wij combineren hightech innovatie met de trots van oprecht vakmanschap. Samen met 10 collega’s vorm jij het team Maintenance Engineering en werk je in een fijne LEAN-omgeving waar we echt op elkaar kunnen rekenen. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om jouw werk zelf vorm te geven, invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes en te groeien in je rol, omringd door moderne techniek en een team waarin jij écht het verschil maakt.

Je brengt het maintenance-perspectief in bij projecten, van ontwerp tot oplevering, zodat onderhoud vanaf het begin goed is ingericht. Wij combineren hightech innovatie met de trots van oprecht vakmanschap. Samen met 10 collega’s vorm jij het team Maintenance Engineering en werk je in een fijne LEAN-omgeving waar we echt op elkaar kunnen rekenen. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om jouw werk zelf vorm te geven, invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes en te groeien in je rol, omringd door moderne techniek en een team waarin jij écht het verschil maakt.

positions.description:
Azure Data Engineer

 Data Engineer – Financial Services
Onze klanten bouwen innovatieve oplossingen binnen de financiële sector. Als data engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken, analyseren en opslaan van data van, naar en in de cloud.
Jouw rol in één alinea
In deze rol verwerk en ontsluit je ruwe data van meerdere grote internationale organisaties. Daarnaast geef je leiding aan teams en ontwikkel je herbruikbare data‑oplossingen. Je werkt met grote hoeveelheden data en bijbehorende verwerkingsprocessen. Uiteraard heb je veel klantcontact, waarbij je klanten adviseert over hoe zij de waarde van hun data kunnen maximaliseren.
Jouw thuisbasis bij Capgemini
Je wordt onderdeel van Capgemini Financial Services Benelux. Samen met een team van collega’s die net zo gedreven zijn als jij, werk je aan een gezamenlijk doel in een inspirerende en professionele omgeving.
Wat bieden wij?
Koude voeten? Die kennen wij niet. Bij ons krijg je direct een vast contract.

Alle trainingen die je nodig hebt om succesvol te zijn als data engineer
Een goed gevulde koffer met vakantiegeld en voldoende vrije tijd (26 dagen) om ervan te genieten
Een pensioen zonder eigen bijdrage, zodat je later met plezier terugdenkt aan Capgemini
Werk waar je wilt, met een device naar keuze en een connectivity allowance
Een snelle laptop en een simkaart die je ook privé mag gebruiken
Onderweg met een leaseauto, NS‑Business Card of vergoeding van reiskosten
En natuurlijk een passend salaris, waarover we graag met je in gesprek gaan

Waarom past deze functie bij jou?
Maak je geen zorgen over een lange eisenlijst. Denk je dat deze rol bij je past, maar voldoe je niet aan alle exacte vereisten? Solliciteer vooral. We gaan graag het gesprek aan om te kijken of er een goede match is.
We zijn benieuwd naar jouw:

Werkervaring in IT en data engineering
Ervaring met cloud‑gebaseerde data services en het ontwerpen en bouwen van data‑omgevingen in de cloud, met name binnen Azure
Basiskennis van data management, data processing en data‑modellering
Ervaring met Python
Ervaring met DevOps‑tools (een grote plus)
Ervaring met Azure Data Services (ADF, SQL DWH, Databricks)

Werken bij Capgemini
Get the future you want — dat is een belofte. Vanaf dag één zorgen we voor een goede onboarding en duidelijke, transparante groeipaden. Werken bij Capgemini betekent werken in het internationale hart van innovatie: de top van technologische ontwikkelingen. Met oog voor jou én voor de toekomst, waarin duurzaamheid, diversiteit en inclusie centraal staan.

positions.title: CSV Engineer
positions.description:
CSV Engineer

 Capgemini Engineering
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.Your role
As a Computer Systems Validation (CSV) Engineer at Capgemini Engineering, you will play a vital role in testing and qualifying process installations, equipment, and facilities within the life sciences sector. You will help ensure compliance with GMP regulations and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Develop qualification plans, requirement specifications, User Acceptance Test protocols, and qualification reports.
Lead validation efforts for automated processes and equipment, taking ownership of key deliverables.
Review validation documentation to ensure alignment with GMP guidelines and regulatory standards.
Identify and implement improvements in GMP documentation processes.
Act as a central point of contact for internal teams, including production, QA, and QC.
Your profile
You are a detail-oriented and proactive professional with a passion for quality and innovation in regulated environments.

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Technology, (Bio)Process Technology, Chemistry, or a related technical field.]
Solid understanding of GMP regulations and relevant industry standards.
Hands-on experience with Computer Systems Validation (CSV) in regulated environments.
Strong documentation and communication skills, with a keen eye for detail.
Motivation to grow your expertise through our inclusive and accessible training programs.
What you’ll love about working here

Engage in projects that directly impact industrial technology and innovation, where you can collaborate with top engineers and expand your expertise.
Access to career development programs, certifications, and digital learning platforms to support your growth.
A salary between €3.600,- and €5.100,- per month. On top of that, Capgemini contributes to your pension and offers a mobility budget of €800,- per month. 
Flexible working hours and hybrid working options to support your lifestyle and well-being.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Job description

At Olenex, we supply a broad portfolio of high-quality edible oils and fats to customers worldwide. With thirteen strategically located refineries across Europe, we produce a wide range of liquid and tropical oils. Our team of specialists works closely with both food and non-food producers to deliver tailor-made ingredients that meet specific needs.

Beyond production, we are active in trading and sourcing raw materials to strengthen our offering in the oil and fats industry. Sustainability and fair trade are at the heart of what we do. Through our #SharedResponsibility initiative, we build integral partnerships and work toward a 100% sustainable supply chain.

 

We also believe in investing in our people. At Olenex, you’ll find opportunities for career development, training, and contribution within a dynamic and challenging environment where your impact truly matters.

We are currently looking for a experienced & driven

Laboratory Technician (Product Development)

to join our team at the laboratory in the Zaandam location.

As a Laboratory Technician, you and the team are responsible for all specific sample requests from our customers. In collaboration with our Technical Account Managers, we are closely involved in projects for the improvement of new products and processes. We produce these samples in a brand-new product development laboratory by carrying out chemical, sensory, and instrumental analyses on products, oils, and fats. We also generate these samples by laboratory scale production processes.

You will be part of a small team, together you are responsible for all sample and improvement projects for the customer. Within this role, you get to work in a very new laboratory with the newest equipment for processing and analysis.

This role gives you the opportunity to grow into an experienced oil and fats technician.

Job requirements

What the role entails?

·       Perform various production processes on laboratory scale

·       Accurately perform chemical and instrumental analyses such as GC, SFC and various titrations

·       Accurate mixing and manufacturing of samples in small and larger quantities

·       Entering analysis data and producing reports/trends in our software system

·       Carrying out sensory analyses

·       Label and ship samples professionally and neatly to the customer

·       Preparing products in our application lab for customer visits

To excel in this role, you bring:

·       You have an MLO or HLO diploma (analytical chemistry, food technology or equivalent training)

·       You have gained work/internship experience within a development or analytical department, preferably in a food organization

·       You work well independently as well as in groups

·       You have a pragmatic and flexible attitude

·       Preferably experience with edible oils and fats

·       You know how to combine different tasks

·       You have good communication skills in Dutch and English

What we offer you:


·         Enthusiastic colleagues from all over the world

·         Multiple training & development options

·         13th month salary

·         30 days of paid holidays per year

·         A fully company-paid pension plan

·         Discount on health insurance and fitness

·         Competitive Salary

Sounds like you? Apply for the next chapter in your career!

positions.descriptionHtml:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity

As a Product Marketing Manager at myTomorrows, you will define how our products are positioned, understood, adopted, and embedded into real-world clinical and research workflows across the global healthcare ecosystem.

Your focus is on product positioning, adoption, and real-world clarity, translating complex product capabilities into clear, real-world value for key stakeholders

You will sit at the intersection of Product, Commercial, and Medical, bringing customer and user insight into how our solutions are positioned, communicated, and adopted by key stakeholders.

What you'll do in this role

  • Own the Product Narrative: Shape and refine the end-to-end narrative across clinical trials and Expanded Access, clearly differentiating myTomorrows from legacy databases and lead-gen platforms.

  • Drive Adoption: Translate physician workflows and trial site needs into scalable messaging frameworks that remove friction and increase user engagement.

  • Bridge the Gap: Act as the voice of the market; synthesize insights from sites, physicians, and sponsors to feed actionable requirements back into the Product team.

  • Enable Teams: Build product-native enablement assets (narratives, workflow diagrams, value frameworks) to empower Commercial, Medical, and Growth teams.

  • Lead Product Launches: Own product readiness for new features and launches, ensuring internal alignment on messaging and use-case clarity.

What you bring to the table

  • Must-Have Requirement: Deep, proven experience within the BioPharma, Clinical Trials, or Expanded Access (EAP) ecosystem. Understanding the complex regulatory, operational, and protocol-driven constraints of this industry is essential for this role.

  • Experience: 4–6 years in Product Marketing or Product Strategy within HealthTech, digital health, or biopharma.

  • Storytelling & Structure: Exceptional structured thinking with the ability to map complex product capabilities to real-world user outcomes.

  • Execution: Relentless ownership and follow-through—you take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.

  • Cross-Functional Agility: Comfortable navigating 0-to-1 environments and collaborating closely with Product, Commercial, and Medical stakeholders.

  • User Empathy: Deep understanding of the distinct workflows and pain points of trial sites, rare disease ecosystems, and pharma teams.

What success looks like in 6 months

  • One Unified Story: A clear, jargon-free product narrative that the Commercial and Medical teams can pitch confidently in under 60 seconds.

  • Data-Driven Impact: Improved referral-to-enrollment conversion driven by clearer workflow communication and localized messaging.

  • Feedback Loop: An established, fast-paced insight loop between users and the product team, replacing internal assumptions with real-world clinical realities.


What we offer

  • Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments.

  • International work environment, scale-up energy, and a flat organizational structure encouraging creativity and accountability.

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and an Employee Stock Option Plan.

  • Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions.

  • Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows.

  • Hybrid working model.

  • Policies to support working parents.

  • Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp.

  • Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual 'myTomorrowland' company-wide celebration!

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

positions.description: Job Description:High Voltage Cable Engineer – Underground and Submarine cableDelft, Netherlands Do you want to be part of the energy transition industry, helping to guide the public and private sector in the delivery of technologies and systems to meet global and national net zero targets? Are you looking to bring your expertise and enthusiasm into play in a high performing team delivering a range of innovative engineering design projects? Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture? If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Power Systems department as our new Electrical engineer and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future. Your new roleAs our new Electrical Engineer, you will join a team of more than 50 passionate and high performing HV, MV and LV specialists working predominantly within the global Energy industry. positions.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

High Voltage Cable Engineer – Underground and Submarine cable

Delft, Netherlands

 

Do you want to be part of the energy transition industry, helping to guide the public and private sector in the delivery of technologies and systems to meet global and national net zero targets? Are you looking to bring your expertise and enthusiasm into play in a high performing team delivering a range of innovative engineering design projects? Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture?

 

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Power Systems department as our new Electrical engineer and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

 

Your new role

As our new Electrical Engineer, you will join a team of more than 50 passionate and high performing HV, MV and LV specialists working predominantly within the global Energy industry. We are particularly focused on offshore wind, power-to-X, carbon capture and energy transition projects. We cover all phases of project delivery including concept and feasibility studies, detailed engineering, EPC and follow-on engineering on international projects.

 

Your key role will be:

  • Reviewing project documents and preparing technical reports
  • Cable rating and thermal calculations
  • Onshore cable bonding design and jointing arrangement
  • Onshore cable route development and installation strategy (e.g. direct burial, HDD and drilling, crossing design)
  • Assessing interface with transition joint bay, substation, and civil works
  • Cable factory and site inspection during cable manufacturing and installation (traveling abroad may require)

 

Your new team

You will be part of the Power Systems department at Ramboll Delft, where we support our clients on due diligence, permitting, compliance (audit), management systems and a wide variety of other EHS projects. We work on challenging projects together with colleagues around the world from our Environmental and Health Division, and with other Ramboll Divisions.

 

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. While we're happy to support you in your continued learning and development, we've identified some qualifications, skills, and competencies for this role that will prepare you for success.

 

These include:

  • Completed university degree in Electrical Engineering
  • +3 years’ experience in onshore (underground) HV cable design 66KV up to 400KV
  • Experience in Cymcap or other cable rating software
  • Experience in working with cable related international and local standards
  • Fluent in English. Dutch and German languages are big plus to deal with local clients
  • Experience in cable accessories is a plus
  • Experience in cable installation and civil works is a big plus
  • Experience with Fiber optic cable is a plus

 

What we can offer you

  • Investment in your personal development;
  • Trustworthy leaders guided by our leadership principles;
  • An open, collaborative, and empowering culture where your uniqueness is valued;
  • Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects;
  • A long-term vision from a foundation owned company;
  • Internal training programs to expand your knowledge and improve your skills;
  • Promotion of a healthy work-life balance with flexible working hours and workplace arrangements;
  • 30 vacation days per year;
  • Pension contributions;
  • The use of information systems and digital solutions that offer new opportunities and internal systems that effectively support your work.

 

Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consulting firm. We believe that the goal of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. That's where we begin—and how we work. At Ramboll, our people are our core strength, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should behave. Openness and curiosity are the cornerstones of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that seeks fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all its forms to actively create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

 

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV and cover letter.

 

Deadline: 15 July 2026

Please note that for this position, we are not able to offer support with work permits or relocation.

Thank you for your time and we look forward to receiving your application.

 

About Ramboll

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.

 

Equality, diversity, and inclusion is at the heart of what we do

We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process

positions.title: Android Engineer: IPP Hardware
positions.description:
This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
The Hardware stream is dedicated to the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Adyen's In-Person Payments hardware solutions, which are deployed globally across the retail, hospitality, travel, and entertainment sectors. Our team collaborates with both internal and external stakeholders to address various aspects such as payment terminal user interfaces, firmware quality, and the integration of our payment terminals. We empower our merchants to seamlessly and independently integrate with reliable products at scale and with rapid deployment.
Who you are: 

A motivated, enthusiastic team player: collaborate with other engineers, product designers, and business stakeholders
Able to provide reliable and clearly understandable code
Willing to learn and improve
Flexible, open to new ideas
Have a keen eye for detail
Able to debug and solve problems within the Android application and collaborate effectively on cross-functional issues
Proactive in bringing great ideas to improve our solution
Enthusiastic to investigate new technical possibilities, yet able to work within existing frameworks
Self-disciplined and enjoy working at a fast pace while managing and prioritizing goals

Must have qualifications: 

2 - 6 years of experience in native Android application development
Strong proficiency in Kotlin and the Android SDK
Experience with modern Android architecture, including dependency injection (e.g. Hilt, Dagger) and asynchronous programming (e.g. Kotlin Coroutines and Flow)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Nice to have technical qualifications:

Familiarity with AOSP or building system-level apps.
Knowledge of security best practices.
Experience with CI/CD and automated testing frameworks.

This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.
Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
What’s next?
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

positions.description:
Software Engineer I - Financial Products Authorisation Optimisation Team
This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
About The Team
We're looking for a Software Engineer I to join our Financial Products Authorisation Optimisation team in Amsterdam. This team works on maximizing issuing authorization rates by approving legitimate transactions while minimizing fraud, as well as providing authentication services for the whole Financial Products solution. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects, learn from experienced professionals, and grow your skills in a supportive, cross-functional setting.
As a Software Engineer I on this team, you'll contribute to building and maintaining the real-time risk engine that evaluates issuing and banking transactions, our ACS (Access Control Server), and Strong Customer Authentication services. Your work will directly impact how our customers pay with their Adyen-issued cards and authenticate for their transactions.
What You'll Do
As a Software Engineer I on the team, you will:

Develop and implement new features for the services owned by the team.
Work closely with our Issuing and Banking teams.
Learn and influence our approach to fraud prevention and authorisation rate maximization.
Collaborate with experienced engineers to understand requirements, design solutions, and resolve technical challenges.
Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable, and secure software.
Contribute to the entire software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and deployment.
Help troubleshoot and debug issues in our production systems.
Apply best practices in software development, including testing, deployment, and monitoring.
Receive targeted mentorship and guidance from senior engineers, accelerating your learning and professional development.

Who You Are

Experience: You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience (outside of internships/university projects) where you have already put software principles into practice.
Tech Stack: You are proficient in Java and excited to apply and expand your skills in a large-scale professional setting.
Core Knowledge: You have a solid foundational understanding of databases, distributed systems, and scalability concepts.
Mindset: You're a proactive problem-solver with a curious mind and a willingness to ask questions.
Collaboration: You're a strong team player who enjoys collaborating and learning from others.
Engineering Quality: You have a keen interest in software development, clean code, and design patterns.

If you already have a solid foundation in software engineering and are looking for a role where you can make a real difference, receive great mentorship, and accelerate your career within a critical financial domain, we encourage you to apply!
Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application.
What’s next?
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
Please note that this role is a full-time position in Amsterdam. It will require a relocation in case you live outside of the Netherlands.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

About The Team

We're looking for a Software Engineer I to join our Financial Products Authorisation Optimisation team in Amsterdam. This team works on maximizing issuing authorization rates by approving legitimate transactions while minimizing fraud, as well as providing authentication services for the whole Financial Products solution. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects, learn from experienced professionals, and grow your skills in a supportive, cross-functional setting.

As a Software Engineer I on this team, you'll contribute to building and maintaining the real-time risk engine that evaluates issuing and banking transactions, our ACS (Access Control Server), and Strong Customer Authentication services. Your work will directly impact how our customers pay with their Adyen-issued cards and authenticate for their transactions.

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer I on the team, you will:

- Develop and implement new features for the services owned by the team.

- Work closely with our Issuing and Banking teams.

- Learn and influence our approach to fraud prevention and authorisation rate maximization.

- Collaborate with experienced engineers to understand requirements, design solutions, and resolve technical challenges.

- Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable, and secure software.

- Contribute to the entire software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and deployment.

- Help troubleshoot and debug issues in our production systems.

- Apply best practices in software development, including testing, deployment, and monitoring.

- Receive targeted mentorship and guidance from senior engineers, accelerating your learning and professional development.

Who You Are

- Experience: You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience (outside of internships/university projects) where you have already put software principles into practice.

- Tech Stack: You are proficient in Java and excited to apply and expand your skills in a large-scale professional setting.

- Core Knowledge: You have a solid foundational understanding of databases, distributed systems, and scalability concepts.

- Mindset: You're a proactive problem-solver with a curious mind and a willingness to ask questions.

- Collaboration: You're a strong team player who enjoys collaborating and learning from others.

- Engineering Quality: You have a keen interest in software development, clean code, and design patterns.

If you already have a solid foundation in software engineering and are looking for a role where you can make a real difference, receive great mentorship, and accelerate your career within a critical financial domain, we encourage you to apply!

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application.

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

Please note that this role is a full-time position in Amsterdam. It will require a relocation in case you live outside of the Netherlands.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

🦸‍♂️ Présentation de l’équipe

Devoteam Toulouse, avec ses 200 collaborateurs, est un acteur incontournable de la transformation digitale sur le bassin toulousain. Au sein de l'agence, A Cloud accompagne ses clients à devenir des entreprises plateformes grâce au Cloud, et à contribuer à construire une économie numérique plus soutenable. Notre objectif est d’élargir le champ des possibles pour les organisations à la recherche de réponses aux défis technologiques modernes, en utilisant des plateformes cloud qui permettent d’expérimenter rapidement et d’innover à moindre coût.

Pour contribuer à ces transformations, nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) consultant(e) GCP Cloud Engineer  souhaitant rejoindre un collectif d’une quinzaine de consultant(e)s spécialisé(e)s en devops et cloud engineering à Toulouse.

Job Description:

💪 Vos missions :

  • Accompagner les équipes de développement à automatiser leur déploiement vers le Cloud par la mise en place de pipelines CI/CD (GitLab, CircleCI, Jenkins…) et l'utilisation d’outils d’Infra As code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Participer à la conception des solutions techniques et fonctionnelles sur des environnements GCP
  • Industrialiser et améliorer l’architecture technique, les outils et les processus
  • Implémenter des solutions de déploiement automatisées et sécurisées
  • Mettre en place les outils d’automatisation, de monitoring  et d’observabilité adaptés à l’environnement client
  • Accompagner, former des équipes de développement et de production à l’usage et à la maintenance de ces solutions
  • Sensibiliser les équipes aux démarches d’Intégration Continue et de Déploiement Continu
  • Créer des environnements en orchestrant et en interrogeant des API (web services)
  • Participer au développement d’environnements serverless (Lambda, API gateway, S3, dynamoDB…) ou microservices (Conteneurisation : Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Assurer une veille technologique continue sur les solutions cloud
Qualifications:

🎯 Vos atouts pour nous rejoindre :

Vous avez minimum deux années d’expérience professionnelle dans le métier de DevOps/SRE et sur tout ou partie des technologies de la Tribu:  

  • Cloud : GCP (Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud IAM, Cloud Monitoring ...)
  • Connaissance d'autre cloud provider serait un plus : AWS, Azure
  • Scripting : Python, Bash, Shell, Powershell…
  • Programmation : Python, JavaScript, Java…
  • Infrastructure As Code : Terraform, Packer, Ansible…
  • CICD : Gitlab, Jenkins…
  • Container : Docker, Kubernetes
  • Versionning : Git

 

  •  
Additional Information:

🙋‍♂️ Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

  • Nous sommes une AI-Driven Company, partenaire des plus grands partenaires technologiques (Google, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow,…) et composée d'un important collectif d'experts (50 tribus d'expertise). 

  • Avec 75% de nos collaborateurs certifiés dont 100 % sur la GenAI, Devoteam s'impose comme une Learning Company, où l’apprentissage continu est au cœur de notre ADN.

🤝 Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement chez Devoteam ?

  • Talent Acquisition Interview : l'objectif est de faire le point sur vos compétences, votre niveau d'anglais et de valider vos éléments de motivation 

  • Tech & Business Interview : cet entretien vise à approfondir vos compétences techniques et à vérifier leur adéquation avec nos besoins lors d'un échange avec un expert métier

  • Leadership Interview : il permet d'évaluer votre potentiel, vos ambitions et d'envisager votre évolution au sein de Devoteam.

Nous privilégions au moins un entretien en présentiel. Une prise de référence est demandée et, selon votre profil, des tests (techniques, anglais, personnalité...) peuvent vous être adressés. Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous faisons parvenir une proposition présentant les conditions d'embauche. En cas d'acceptation, le contrat de travail est formalisé.

Le Groupe Devoteam oeuvre pour l'égalité des chances, pour la promotion de ses collaboratrices et de ses collaborateurs au mérite et lutte activement contre toute forme de discrimination. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité contribue à la créativité, au dynamisme et à l'excellence de notre organisation. Chaque candidature est donc considérée indépendamment de tout critère discriminatoire.

Si vous partagez notre passion pour la technologie et que vous souhaitez construire le monde numérique responsable de demain, alors vous êtes peut-être le passionné que nous recherchons chez Devoteam.

Job Description:

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Product Owner confirmé(e) pour intervenir sur des projets innovants au cœur des secteurs médical, santé.

Vous rejoindrez un environnement stimulant, à forte valeur ajoutée, où les enjeux techniques et humains se croisent pour concevoir des solutions à impact concret.

Vos missions : 

En tant que Product Owner, vous serez au centre de la chaîne de valeur produit :

  • Recueillir et analyser les besoins métiers et utilisateurs
  • Définir et prioriser la roadmap produit
  • Rédiger les user stories et gérer le backlog
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques (dev, QA, UX)
  • Assurer le lien entre les parties prenantes (métiers, techniques, direction)
  • Piloter les sprints et garantir la bonne livraison des fonctionnalités
  • Être garant(e) de la vision produit et de la valeur délivrée
Qualifications:

Votre profil

  • Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou poste similaire
  • Expérience impérative dans les secteurs : santé, médical ou robotique
  • Issu(e) d’un environnement technique (développement, ingénierie, etc.)
  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux IT et capacité à dialoguer avec des équipes techniques
  • Aisance dans les échanges avec des interlocuteurs variés (techniques, métiers, direction)
  • Maîtrise des méthodes Agile / Scrum
  • Esprit d’analyse, leadership naturel et excellent relationnel
  • Bac + 5 
Additional Information:
  • Des parcours professionnels sur mesure (évolution de carrière, formations adaptées, mentoring…) ;
  • Avoir le choix de sa mission et un accompagnement personnalisé tout au long de votre carrière ;
  • Evoluer dans un environnement où l’apprentissage est favorisé : formations certifiantes, e-learning, meetUp, concours de code, parcours d’évolutions etc ;
  • Faire partie de communautés d’experts qui partagent leurs savoirs et expériences au sein de nos centres de compétences ;
  • Un environnement convivial avec de nombreux événements festifs (soirée annuelle, séminaires & teambuiding, déjeuners et afterworks…) ;

Vos différences sont nos atouts. C’est pourquoi Meritis est engagée en faveur de la diversité et de la non-discrimination. Tous nos métiers sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap. Si vous avez une question ou pensez être victime ou témoin d’une discrimination, vous pouvez contacter ethiquegroup@meritis.fr.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

Qui sommes nous ?

Fondé en France, Talan est aujourd’hui un groupe international qui accompagne ses clients dans leur transformation Data & IA, de bout en bout, en combinant conseil en management et expertise technologique.

Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable.

Notre proposition de valeur repose sur un écosystème d’innovation structuré : 2 500 experts Data & IA, des solutions propriétaires construites sur des modèles avancés et un laboratoire de recherche appliquée, de développement expérimental et d’innovation.

Nous traduisons l’innovation technologique en avantage concurrentiel depuis plus de 20 ans dans des secteurs stratégiques : banques et services financiers, énergie, transport et mobilité, luxe et distribution, santé.

Porté par sa promesse de Positive Innovation, Talan s’impose comme un acteur de référence pour répondre à la complexité croissante des environnements économiques, technologiques et réglementaires.
 

Et Talan Sud Est ?

Talan Sud-Est est présent depuis 2007 à Lyon et compte environ 350 collaborateurs répartis entre Aix-Marseille et Lyon. En plein développement, les équipes s'agrandissent ! 

Nous continuons de développer aujourd'hui nos activités auprès de grands comptes et d’ETI, principalement dans les secteurs de l’Energie et de l’Environnement, du Transport et de la Logistique, de l’Industrie, de la Distribution, de la Santé et des Services Publiques. 

L’expertise, la bonne humeur, le collectif et de l’esprit d’entreprendre, constituent notre ADN. 

Job Description:

Descriptif du poste :

Ce poste est à pourvoir dans le cadre d'une mission pour l'un de nos clients du secteur banque / assurances. 

Contexte

Le service concerné gère pour les 3 marchés (Agriculteurs, Professionnels et Entreprises) les outils informatiques mis à disposition des caisses régionales et de leurs clients pour fluidifier les étapes du cycle de vie des crédits.
Au sein de la tribu, un Business Analyst expérimenté est recherché sur le périmètre de l’avant‑vente.
Avec les membres de la squad (PO, SM, BA, IT), la mission consiste à répondre aux besoins métier en concevant et fabriquant des solutions UX soignées, robustes, efficientes, à moindre risque et respectant les coûts et jalons (TTM, ROI).
Le périmètre couvre notamment la mise en place d’un outil de simulation crédit dans le parcours d’avant‑vente.

Tâches
— Répondre aux besoins métier avec la squad.
— Concevoir et fabriquer des solutions adaptées.
— Participer au cadrage et à la définition des solutions.
— Contribuer à l’intégration d’un outil de simulation crédit dans le parcours d’avant‑vente.

Qualifications:

Profil recherché :

Attendu

  • Capacité d’analyse, de formalisation et de transformation des besoins métier en solution.
  • Maitrise méthodologique pour cadrages et design de solutions.
  • Capacité à travailler avec des profils variés (utilisateurs CR, IT, architectes…).
  • Autonomie et force de proposition, notamment sur des sujets nouveaux nécessitant cadrage et exploration.
  • Excellente communication.
  • Rigueur et méthodologie (animation d’ateliers, interviews utilisateurs, approche processus, rédaction de récits, tests…).
  • Connaissance du crédit et du secteur bancaire appréciée mais non indispensable.

Compétences requises

  • Analyse métier
  • Cadrage
  • Design de solutions
  • Animation d’ateliers
  • Processus / Rédaction / Tests
  • Travail en équipe
  • Communication
  • Autonomie et force de proposition
     

Avantages

  • Charte télétravail, prime d’équipement de 100 € 
  • Actionnariat salarié 
  • Proximité et convivialité cultivées à tous les niveaux de l’entreprise
  • Retour de congé maternité possible à 4/5ème sans perte de salaire pendant 6 mois 
  • Permanence handicap (consultant dédié aux collaborateurs en situation de handicap et aux proches aidants). 
  • Offre de formation complète sur site et à distance, programme de mentoring pour les femmes 
  • Mobilité en France et à l’étranger 
  • Tickets restaurant, prime vacances, 50% transport (abonnement transport public), mutuelle 
  • Primes de cooptation de 500 à 4000 € 
  • Top 1% des entreprises évaluées par Ecovadis dans le domaine social, environnemental et éthique  
     

Processus de recrutement

L’équipe recrutement s’engage à vous proposer un processus de recrutement rapide et fluide avec à minima un entretien en présentiel dans nos locaux :  

  • Un premier échange de 30 à 45 minutes en visio ou par téléphone avec le recruteur pour vous présenter le poste et comprendre votre projet professionnel
  • Un entretien opérationnel en binôme avec deux experts de l'équipe
  • Un entretien managérial
  • Un dernier entretien avec la directrice Talan Sud Est

Talan est une entreprise responsable, attachée à la diversité. Des aménagements de poste peuvent être organisés pour tenir compte des personnes en situation de handicap.
