Vous assurez l'implémentation et l'application des procédures.

Vous fournissez de l'input ou du feed-back au management local et à tous les collègues concernés. La qualité de votre feed-back permet de trouver rapidement des solutions de rechange.

Vous savez préparer des communications (feed-back, etc.) et les transmettre aux collaborateurs. Vos explications sont claires et adaptées à votre public cible.

Vous proposez des initiatives de « simplification et d’éffiacité des coûts » et les développez en concertation avec la direction.

Spécificités du SAR

Vote fonction consiste à gérer au quotidien les bâtiments (entretien correctif et préventif) relevant de votre surveillance.

  • Les sites (parties de bâtiments, sentiers et jardins, etc.)
  • Les installations techniques (HVAC, éclairage, ascenseurs, détection incendie, haute et basse tension, etc... .)

Vous êtes très présent sur le terrain pour contrôler et analyser les problèmes éventuels et pour superviser les travaux de maintenance, les visites des lieux de travail, les One Site Visits.

Vous veillez à la sécurité, au respect des prescriptions légales et contractuelles et à la résolution rapide et efficace des problèmes.

Vous effectuez des analyses d'outsourcing afin de vérifier si les tâches imposées peuvent être effectuées avec le personnel et les moyens disponibles dans le respect du calendrier et du budget fixés.

En qualité de superviseur, vous contrôlez et complétez les banques de données et veillez à les garder entièrement à jour. Vous êtes responsable de l'exécution des One Site Visits et du suivi des remarques qui en découlent. Vous assurez le suivi des travaux de maintenance exécutés par des firmes externes.

Votre profil

Connaissances

Aptitudes

  • Vous avez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et vous êtes en mesure de communiquer le résultat de votre analyse de manière claire et efficace, adaptée au public cible.
  • Vous avez d'excellentes compétences orales et écrites.
  • Vous êtes résistant au stress et flexible en toutes circonstances.
  • Vous travaillez de manière structurée et précise.
  • Vous pouvez travailler de manière indépendante et en équipe.
  • Vous prenez des initiatives.
  • Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en gestion du temps.
  • Vous anticipez les problèmes potentiels, vous prenez des initiatives et proposez des améliorations.
  • Vous êtes orienté client et ce aussi bien pour les clients internes qu'externes.
  • Vous prenez vos responsabilités et terminez ce que vous avez entrepris.
  • Vous travaillez de manière axée sur les résultats et vous assurez un bon suivi du début à la fin.
  • Vous êtes créatif, proactif, positif et orienté vers les solutions.
  • Vous avez soif d'apprendre et vous êtes prêt à vous plonger dans toutes les activités d'IFM.
  • En toutes circonstances, vous faites preuve de la plus grande honnêteté et d'un respect indéfectible de la déontologie et des procédures.
  • Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en gestion des problèmes avec lesquelles vous pouvez détecter et analyser les problèmes fréquents et prendre les mesures nécessaires pour les solutionner.

La loi du 11 décembre 1998 relative à la classification et aux habilitations, attestations et avis de sécurité oblige les personnes ayant accès à des locaux, infrastructures et applications dits sensibles ou critiques d’avoir un avis de sécurité approprié délivré par l’IBPT.

Qu’avons-nous à vous offrir ?

  • En tant qu’entreprise 100 % belge, nous prenons nos décisions en trois langues. Toutes à la fois, si vous voulez.
  • Nous sommes ouverts à tout le monde : h, f, x et toutes les lettres de l’alphabet.
  • Nous encourageons le développement personnel. Brosser les cours de la Proximus Academy ? Cela ne vous viendra même pas à l’esprit.
  • Nous misons sur la durabilité. Pour nous, c’est une évidence.
  • Travailler ensemble, c’est bien. S’amuser ensemble, c’est encore mieux. Voilà pourquoi nous organisons régulièrement des activités sympathiques (si vous aimez vous déguiser en Saint-Nicolas, nous sommes preneurs !).
  • Nous croyons en la responsabilité. La nôtre, mais aussi la vôtre. Une responsabilité que vous pourrez assumer en lançant vos propres initiatives.
  • Nous mettons nos clients au cœur de notre démarche. Et comme nous sommes tous clients quelque part, vous savez déjà comment vous y prendre. Pratique !
  • Et l’équilibre essentiel entre travail et vie privée ? Nous penchons en faveur d’une juste répartition.
Vous pouvez bien évidemment compter sur un package salarial attractif. Cliquez ici (ou postule) pour découvrir ce que nous avons d’autre à offrir.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Description of the position

Can’t wait to make an impact on the world?

In this role, you will combine deep hands-on Java development expertise with strategic technical leadership. You’ll architect complex solutions, drive large-scale migrations, and build high-performing distributed teams across multiple time zones. This is an ideal opportunity for a technical leader who thrives in both coding and mentoring environments.

Description of the position

Your journey with us

Technical Leadership
  • Design and oversee Java modernization strategies and technical roadmaps for enterprise clients
  • Define scalable, resilient, and secure Java-based solutions aligned with business objectives
  • Establish technical standards, best practices, and architectural patterns for your development team
  • Conduct comprehensive technical reviews and code quality assessments
  • Mentor and guide nearshore/offshore developers on architectural decisions and technical excellence
Hands-On Development
  • Lead complex Java modernization projects including JBoss upgrades and Spring Boot migrations
  • Direct migration initiatives from Java EE / Jakarta EE legacy systems to modern frameworks
  • Oversee Spring Framework migrations (5 -> 6) and javax -> jakarta transitions
  • Manage RichFaces to PrimeFaces UI framework migrations
  • Refactor and remediate legacy codebases using industry-leading tools like OpenRewrite
  • Integration of code written by delivery center" and take care of CI/CD process
  • To understand code written in NL & FR
  • To ensure this is legacy migration, not super fancy innovative work
  • Write, review, and optimize production-grade Java code
Team Management & Development
  • Manage and mentor nearshore/offshore Java development teams
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Establish development processes, quality gates, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and skill development across distributed teams
  • Ensure adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality metrics
  • Coordinate effectively across different time zones and cultural contexts.
Application Server & Deployment Expertise
  • Lead JBoss/WildFly upgrade initiatives and platform migrations
  • Oversee application server configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting
  • Ensure deployment strategies (WAR/EAR) are optimized, documented, and production-ready
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.

Description of the position

Let's talk about you

  • BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • Minimum 4+ years of professional Java development experience.
  • Previous experience in banking sector would be considered an asset.
  • Proven track record managing distributed development teams (nearshore/offshore)
  • Deep understanding of Java language features, design patterns, and best practices
  • Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and functional programming concepts
  • Hands-on experience with javax -> jakarta namespace migrations - Knowledge of Spring ecosystem (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud)
  • Proficiency with JPA/Hibernate ORM framework. Knowledge of enterprise application patterns and design principles
  • Hands-on experience with JBoss / WildFly administration and optimization
  • Expertise in WAR/EAR deployment and troubleshooting - Understanding of application server configuration and performance tuning
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration and optimization - Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and strategies
  • Passionate about technology, innovation, and continuous learning
  • Ability to balance logical problem-solving with innovative thinking
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to code quality
  • Proven ability to lead and mentor technical teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong presentation abilities for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts for stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments with architects, business analysts, and QA teams
  • Team player who enjoys collaborating to solve complex problems.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English (French is an extra asset).

Our story

Deloitte Customer is… ‘ALL THINGS CUSTOMER’. We focus all our talent, creativity, and technology on all the connection points between an organisation and its customer.

Across all clients and sectors, we believe great customer expefriences create greater impact. That elevating the human experience creates enduring value, for the organization, for the customer, for society, for all.

Description of the position

Within Marketing & Commerce we design transformational Marketing & Commerce strategies, implement innovative technology solutions and optimize our client’s business impact. Experience is at the heart of the human condition. It’s how we learn. It’s how we live. It changes us. We believe that humans retain more from an experience than from things. How we feel is what sticks with us. Our experience imbues the world with meaning, embeds memories, and transforms our perceptions and behaviors. Great experiences build connections. Strong connections create loyalty. Loyalty drives business results

Description of the position


Who is Deloitte?
We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.
In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.
Why Deloitte?
Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.
Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.
We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values.
Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:
  • My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
  • Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
  • Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
  • Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
  • Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities

Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements remains essential in today's reality:
  • Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
  • Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.

Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

Position:

Technical Solutions Architect RedHat

Job Description:

Arrow Enterprise Computing Solutions (ECS), a part of Arrow Electronics, brings innovative IT solutions to the market to solve complex business challenges. We deliver value-added distribution, business consulting and channel enablement services to leading technology manufacturers and their channel partners. We help businesses grow faster, operate efficiently and transform in a dynamic market.


About the role

The Technical Solutions Architect will provide technical and domain leadership by working closely with RedHat and senior Arrow staff in other departments to identify, recommend, develop, and support modernizing data center solutions for partners and customers. They will also support the sales and vendor teams with data center pre-sales technical and technology activities across the data center portfolio of products and services offered by Arrow. The activities will support Arrow partners, SI’s, MSP’s and Resellers in both a technical and commercial capacity.

They will be delivering customized demos and presentations, conducting training and webinars and providing technical advice and support for customers, including on-site installations.

Day to day duties

•           Provide technical knowledge and expertise to the customers on RedHat/OpenShift.

•          Advise clients transitioning to cloud-based and managed Datacentre services.

•            Serve as subject matter expert for modern Datacentre platform capabilities.

•            Support the commercial team in the development, construction of offers to the clients.

•            Interact with the partners, identifying the needs and business opportunities by performing technical consultancy.

•            Validate and work on NetApp configurations to support the business.

•            Deliver training/workshops/webinars/solution presentations to partners, also at vendor events and industry events.

•            Create PoC (proof of concepts) within the real customer's environment.

What We Are Looking For

•            Proven experience with RedHat/OpenShift.

•            Strong customer orientation with a sense of innovation and technology.

•            An ability to take the initiative and be a pro-active self-starter.

•            Empathetic, fair, and generous approach to staff and people management

•            A highly entrepreneurial spirit that manifests itself in a “let’s make it happen” approach, coupled with initiative and adaptability.

•            Excellent attention to detail and genuine passion for Information Technology.

•            Willingness to do some national trips to see partners.

•            Fluency in English required. French OR Dutch proficiency is highly appreciated.

What’s in It For You

•            Growth and learning opportunities.

•            Technical Certifications.

•            Challenging and diverse tasks.

•            Open Corporate Culture with a modern and dynamic work environment.

•            Safe and trustful employment.

•            Ability to participate in technology fairs and events.

•            Fully remote recruitment process.

•            Company car.

Arrow is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability status.

positions.description:
Company Description:Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We now want to make fossil-free living possible within one generation. To be able to reach this ambitious goal we are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission. Job Description:Within our Digital Engineering division in Project Delivery & Engineering, we deliver and integrate digital solutions that support renewable energy production and ensure reliable operations. As the primary provider of digital solutions for Business Unit Offshore Wind, and of Business Unit Onshore and Solar and Batteries, we manage the entire value chain—from bid acquisition to asset construction and operation—focusing on Operational Technology (OT) and IT. Cybersecurity and compliance are critical pillars in this mission. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Information Domain Specialist/Information Domain Architect to lead the design and governance of information architecture across operational systems and processes. This role is critical in ensuring that asset information is structured, integrated, and utilized effectively for both operational and maintenance purposes. You will work closely with business and technology teams to align data models, standards, and processes that support SCADA systems, operational dashboards, and enterprise maintenance platforms such as SAP, while also shaping the future of data platforms and architecture. Your Responsibilities As an Information Domain Architect, you will: Define and maintain the information architecture strategy for operational and maintenance systems. Integrate industry standards such as IEC CIM, RDS-PS/PP/ IEC 61850/61400 and others into data models and processes. Organize and structure asset information to enable efficient operations, monitoring, and maintenance. Participate in standardization committees (e.g., IEC, ISO) and initiatives, contributing to the definition and extension of domain information models to capture engineering, business, and process needs. Map concept from different domain models to each other to improve traceability, consistency, and interoperability across systems. Ensure interoperability and consistency of data across SCADA systems, operational dashboards, and enterprise platforms like SAP. Design and govern data platforms and architecture to support operational analytics, reporting, and integration with IT systems. Develop and maintain a roadmap for information architecture and data platforms, incorporating emerging standards and digitalisation initiatives. Drive improvements in data quality and integration to enable better data-driven decision-making across operations and maintenance. Collaborate with OT and IT architects to align information flows between operational technology and business systems. Enable advanced analytics, predictive maintenance, and digital twin capabilities through well-structured data integration. Qualifications:To succeed in this role, you should: Have experience in information architecture within operational environments (generation operations, maintenance processes etc), ideally in the energy or industrial sector with relevant engineering background. Demonstrate expertise in applying standards such as IEC CIM, RDS-PS, and RDS-PP to asset and operational data models. Understand operational systems and processes, including SCADA, automation platforms, and maintenance systems like SAP PM /MM. Experience in designing and implementing data platforms (e.g., data lakes, data warehouses) and integration architectures for OT/IT convergence. Company Description:

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We now want to make fossil-free living possible within one generation. To be able to reach this ambitious goal we are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission. 

Job Description:

Within our Digital Engineering division in Project Delivery & Engineering, we deliver and integrate digital solutions that support renewable energy production and ensure reliable operations. As the primary provider of digital solutions for Business Unit Offshore Wind, and of Business Unit Onshore and Solar and Batteries, we manage the entire value chain—from bid acquisition to asset construction and operation—focusing on Operational Technology (OT) and IT. Cybersecurity and compliance are critical pillars in this mission. 

About the Role 

We are looking for an experienced Information Domain Specialist/Information Domain Architect to lead the design and governance of information architecture across operational systems and processes. This role is critical in ensuring that asset information is structured, integrated, and utilized effectively for both operational and maintenance purposes. You will work closely with business and technology teams to align data models, standards, and processes that support SCADA systems, operational dashboards, and enterprise maintenance platforms such as SAP, while also shaping the future of data platforms and architecture. 

Your Responsibilities 

As an Information Domain Architect, you will: 

  • Define and maintain the information architecture strategy for operational and maintenance systems. 
  • Integrate industry standards such as IEC CIM, RDS-PS/PP/ IEC 61850/61400 and others into data models and processes. 
  • Organize and structure asset information to enable efficient operations, monitoring, and maintenance. 
  • Participate in standardization committees (e.g., IEC, ISO) and initiatives, contributing to the definition and extension of domain information models to capture engineering, business, and process needs. 
  • Map concept from different domain models to each other to improve traceability, consistency, and interoperability across systems. 
  • Ensure interoperability and consistency of data across SCADA systems, operational dashboards, and enterprise platforms like SAP. 
  • Design and govern data platforms and architecture to support operational analytics, reporting, and integration with IT systems. 
  • Develop and maintain a roadmap for information architecture and data platforms, incorporating emerging standards and digitalisation initiatives. 
  • Drive improvements in data quality and integration to enable better data-driven decision-making across operations and maintenance. 
  • Collaborate with OT and IT architects to align information flows between operational technology and business systems. 
  • Enable advanced analytics, predictive maintenance, and digital twin capabilities through well-structured data integration. 
Qualifications:

To succeed in this role, you should: 

  • Have experience in information architecture within operational environments (generation operations, maintenance processes etc), ideally in the energy or industrial sector with relevant engineering background. 
  • Demonstrate expertise in applying standards such as IEC CIM, RDS-PS, and RDS-PP to asset and operational data models. 
  • Understand operational systems and processes, including SCADA, automation platforms, and maintenance systems like SAP PM /MM. 
  • Experience in designing and implementing data platforms (e.g., data lakes, data warehouses) and integration architectures for OT/IT convergence. 
  • Be familiar with data modelling, master data management, asset inventory, and integration patterns. 
  • Experience in defining and extending domain information models and working with interoperability frameworks. 
  • Familiarity with semantic web technologies and ontology modelling, including OWL, RDF, and RDFS. 
  • knowledge of architecture frameworks and governance practices (e.g., TOGAF, ISA-95) is an advantage 
  • Be comfortable leading cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business and technical domains. 

Nice to have: 

  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (Azure Data Services) and streaming technologies for real-time operational data. 
  • Familiarity with digital twin concepts and asset performance management solutions. 
Additional Information:

Our offer 
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development. 

More Information 
We welcome your application in English, no later than 14/06/2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website. 
 
For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Adam Hammond via adam.hammond@vattenfall.com 

Commitment to Diversity

Vattenfall is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and services to support all our employees.

We are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We now want to make fossil-free living possible within one generation. To be able to reach this ambitious goal we are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Architect – Technical Authority to define, govern, and evolve the OT architecture across our renewable energy portfolio.
A Technical Authority is expected to:

  • Own architecture and standards across the domain
  • Act as escalation point for complex system decisions
  • Drive roadmap alignment and governance
  • Ensure competence development and consistency across teams

This is not only a design role. You will act as a technical authority for SCADA and OT systems, setting standards, guiding engineering teams, and ensuring consistent, high-quality solutions across projects and assets.

You will play a central role in building and developing technical competencies within Operational Technology in BA Wind, ensuring that our solutions are robust, secure, and scalable while enabling operational excellence.

Your Responsibilities

As a Senior OT Architect / Technical Authority, you will:

Architecture & Governance

  • Define, maintain, and enforce the OT architecture strategy for SCADA and automation systems
  • Establish and govern reference architectures, standards, and design principles across all assets
  • Act as the technical escalation point for complex system and integration decisions
  • Ensure alignment of architectures across projects, assets, and business units

Technical Authority & Capability Building

  • Act as Technical Authority for SCADA and OT systems, ensuring consistency and quality of engineering deliverables
  • Guide, coach, and challenge engineering teams to improve technical solutions and design decisions
  • Drive competence development within OT engineering teams (methods, tools, best practices)
  • Translate complex technical topics into clear guidance for both engineers and stakeholders

Engineering & Delivery Support

  • Lead the design and integration of Level 1 SCADA systems from major OEMs (Siemens, Vestas, GE, Nordex)
  • Support project teams with solution design, trade-offs, and technical decision-making
  • Drive standardization and interoperability across multi-vendor SCADA platforms
  • Provide technical leadership in vendor selection, system upgrades, and lifecycle management

Technology Leadership

  • Own and maintain the OT technology and architecture roadmap
  • Ensure cybersecurity-by-design and compliance with regulatory standards
  • Support digitalisation initiatives, including OT/IT integration and data enablement
  • Identify and drive adoption of emerging technologies and automation trends
Qualifications:

Experience & Expertise

  • Have extensive experience in OT architecture within renewable energy, with deep SCADA expertise
  • Bring proven experience acting as a senior technical lead, architect, or authority across multiple systems or projects
  • Have strong hands-on knowledge of Level 1 SCADA systems (Siemens, Vestas, GE, Nordex)
  • Understand industrial communication protocols (IEC 61850, OPC UA, Modbus) and OT cybersecurity

Leadership & Impact

  • Demonstrate the ability to guide, influence, and challenge engineering teams without direct line authority
  • Are able to translate complex technical concepts into clear and actionable guidance
  • Have experience driving standardisation, governance, and cross-team alignment

Architecture & Systems Thinking

  • Strong knowledge of architecture frameworks (ISA‑95, IEC 62443)
  • Proven track record of designing scalable, secure, and resilient OT solutions
  • Experience working across multiple projects, ensuring consistency and reuse

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating OT with cloud and data platforms
  • Knowledge of asset management systems and digital twin approaches
  • Experience working in a Technical Authority / domain lead setup
Additional Information:

Our offer 
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development. 

More Information 
We welcome your application in English, no later than 14/06/2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website. 
 
For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Adam Hammond via adam.hammond@vattenfall.com 

Commitment to Diversity

Vattenfall is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and services to support all our employees.

We are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

positions.descriptionHtml:
The Technical Customer Support Analyst serves as a frontline technical support resource for customer and internal issues submitted through the APRO helpdesk. This role is responsible for troubleshooting problems, managing ticket resolution within service levels, validating fixes, and ensuring timely, professional communication with customers and internal stakeholders.

The position also supports release readiness, system setup changes, documentation, issue escalation, and customer-specific configuration needs in partnership with consultants, development teams, and management.

Responsibilities

  • Manage technical support tickets from intake through resolution in line with SLA commitments and support procedures.
  • Troubleshoot application and configuration issues, validate fixes, and confirm successful outcomes.
  • Provide clear, timely updates to customers and internal teams regarding issue status, resolution steps, and next actions.
  • Partner with development, consultants, and leadership on escalations, releases, and continuous service improvement.
 

Tasks

  • Receive, log, prioritize, and manage helpdesk tickets from customers and internal teams, including accurate case documentation and time tracking.
  • Investigate and resolve application, setup, and environment-related issues within established service levels.
  • Communicate issue status, required actions, and resolution details clearly to customers and cross-functional teams.
  • Create and execute test scenarios to validate bug fixes, enhancements, and new development before closure or release.
  • Support software releases by performing testing, updating documentation, and coordinating customer communications.
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately and provide complete diagnostic details to development or other internal teams.
  • Maintain customer-specific configurations and approved processing formats as required.
  • Identify recurring issues, support trends, and improvement opportunities that can enhance service quality and customer experience.
 

Requirements

  • Minimum HBO-level education or equivalent experience in technical support, customer support, or a related field.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and case management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to support both customers and internal teams.
  • Proficiency in both English.


Work and Physical Requirements 
 
This position will be Hybrid (office & remote). Working in an office environment may require prolonged sitting, work in an air-conditioned environment, ability to work with others at various noise levels and ability to lift up to 30 pounds or 15 kg. 
 
Other Duties 
 
This job description is not intended to be a complete list of responsibilities. Other duties may be assigned by management that may reasonably fit in the scope of job. 
 
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement 
 
PairSoft is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Job Description

Junior Technical Project manager

Driven by growth, you are developing your expertise and leadership skills to take on larger and more complex challenges later in your career.

Purpose of the role

The Junior Project Manager leads projects from early FEL phases through execution to commissioning, qualification, and handover. They collaborate with cross-functional teams—Production, EHS, Quality, Finance, Maintenance, and Procurement—to deliver projects aligned with business goals.

They manage pharmaceutical projects such as equipment renewal, building modifications, and HVAC/utilities, typically handling two small-to-medium projects per year with a budget of €1–2 million. Ambitious to grow into a Project Manager role, they report to the Portfolio Manager Pharmaceutical GMP Projects.

Welcome to the team

Engineering & Site Strategy is a Center of Excellence within Pharmaceutical Operations. You will report directly to the Portfolio Manager and will support the project implementation activities for Investment Projects at the manufacturing site in Oss. With an annual budget of 20 – 40 M€ the team realizes production scale-ups and modifications on facility and /or production equipment.

Main responsibilities

  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, resources, milestones, and risk assessments, ensuring alignment with business objectives
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams (internal and external), assign tasks, monitor progress, and ensure accountability while maintaining team engagement
  • Define clear, measurable goals and deliverables, maintaining a strong focus on results and proactively addressing challenges
  • Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders, aligning expectations, facilitating communication, and providing regular updates on progress, risks, and achievements
  • Identify and manage project risks, implement mitigation actions, and adjust plans in response to changing conditions
  • Resolve issues in a timely and structured manner, making informed decisions to keep projects on track
  • Monitor and report on project performance using KPIs, identifying improvement opportunities and ensuring successful delivery
  • Manage project budgets and resources effectively, ensuring optimal allocation and cost control
  • Ensure all deliverables meet quality and safety standards through structured reviews and compliance with project objectives
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying and implementing enhancements in project procedures, tools, and ways of working in collaboration with Engineering & Services and project teams

Your profile

  • HBO (Polytechnic) level of thinking and working
  • 2+ years of experience in industrial implementation projects (pharma or food industry preferred)
  • Experience with both architectural projects and technical system installations
  • Strong focus on quality and safety
  • Self-driven, independent, and able to prioritize effectively
  • Proactive, with a hands-on “go-and-see” mindset
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
  • Service- and customer-oriented
  • Able to communicate effectively with both senior management and technical staff
  • Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken
  • Experience with projects in execution planning and budget control

We offer

We welcome you to a truly global, dynamic and challenging environment with great opportunities for personal development. Our benefits are very competitive, and the summary below will give you an idea of what you can expect.

  • Competitive salary and a 3% year-end bonus.
  • 35,5 days of leave.
  • Attractive collective health care insurance package with considerable reduction rates.
  • Solid Pension Plan.
  • Incentive Plan (bonus).
  • Commuting allowance.
  • Numerous training, coaching and e-learning modules for long term job opportunities and development.

With Organon, your career is more than just a job — it’s a journey of purpose, impact, and leadership. Together, we are building innovative solutions that improve health and change lives around the globe. If you're ready to grow, lead, and be part of something bigger — we want to hear from you!

Secondary Job Description

Who We Are:

Organon delivers ingenious health solutions that enable people to live their best lives. We are a $6.5 billion global healthcare company focused on making a world of difference for women, their families and the communities they care for. We have an important portfolio and are growing it by investing in the unmet needs of Women’s Health, expanding access to leading biosimilars and touching lives with a diverse and trusted portfolio of health solutions.  Our Vision is clear: A better and healthier every day for every woman.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from candidates with a diverse background. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our applicants. 

Search Firm Representatives Please Read Carefully 
Organon LLC, does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. All CVs / resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at our company without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of our company.  No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral where no pre-existing agreement is in place. Where agency agreements are in place, introductions are position specific. Please, no phone calls or emails.

  • Define starting points of the project with the respective sponsor and establish scope, budget, schedule, and quality requirements.
  • Set up the project team structure in consultation with resource managers.
  • Lead approximately 5 small to medium multi-disciplinary pharmaceutical projects per year, with an average annual volume of € 5–10 million.
  • Manage both capital and expense projects related to pharmaceutical equipment renewal, building modifications, HVAC and utility systems, or a combination of these areas.
  • Ensure execution of construction activities in compliance with Organon quality and safety standards.
  • Arrange availability of working space, installations, and services for project execution.
  • Develop conceptual design solutions, feasibility studies, and project definitions leading to approved proposals.
  • Obtain approval for investment proposals in line with Organon project standards and requirements.
  • Coordinate commissioning, start-up, and qualification of project deliverables.
  • Ensure project completion, including as-built documentation, maintenance deliverables, and operator training.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree (polytechnic or academic) in a technical field or similar through experience.
  • Minimum of 4 years of work experience with industrial implementation projects.

Job Description

Technical Project Manager

Purpose of the role

We are currently looking for an extension of our team and have therefor a vacancy available for the role of Project Manager. Fulfilling this role, you will be managing technical projects from the earliest phases up to delivery, including commissioning and qualification, for the Organon manufacturing site in Oss. To deliver these projects upon Business objectives, you will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders: Production, Safety Health & Environmental, Quality, Finance, Maintenance, Procurement, etc.

Welcome to the team

Engineering & Site Strategy is a Center of Excellence within Pharmaceutical Operations. You will report directly to the Portfolio Manager and will support the project implementation activities for Investment Projects at the manufacturing site in Oss. With an annual budget of 20 – 40 M€ the team realizes production scale-ups and modifications on facility and /or production equipment.

Main responsibilities

  • Oversee all aspects of project management, Including Quality, Safety, Scope, Costs, Resources and Timelines.
  • Define starting points of the project with the respective sponsor and establish scope, budget, schedule, and quality requirements.
  • Set up the project team structure in consultation with resource managers.
  • Lead approximately 5 small to medium multi-disciplinary pharmaceutical projects per year, with an average annual volume of € 5–10 million.
  • Manage both capital and expense projects related to pharmaceutical equipment renewal, building modifications, HVAC and utility systems, or a combination of these areas.
  • Ensure execution of construction activities in compliance with Organon quality and safety standards.
  • Arrange availability of working space, installations, and services for project execution.
  • Develop conceptual design solutions, feasibility studies, and project definitions leading to approved proposals.
  • Obtain approval for investment proposals in line with Organon project standards and requirements.
  • Coordinate commissioning, start-up, and qualification of project deliverables.
  • Ensure project completion, including as-built documentation, maintenance deliverables, and operator training.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree (polytechnic or academic) in a technical field or similar through experience.
  • Minimum of 4 years of work experience with industrial implementation projects.
  • Experience with architectural and pharmaceutical equipment projects, and with the actual installation of technical systems.
  • Communication skills, able to inspire and energize your project team (higher management and craftsmen);
  • Safety First and Quality Always mindset
  • ‘Self-starter’, independent, ability to prioritize.
  • Proactive and “Go-see” attitude
  • Service and customer oriented
  • Communicate in Dutch and English (both verbal and in writing)
  • Able to work with Microsoft Office.

We offer

We welcome you to a truly global, dynamic and challenging environment with great opportunities for personal development. Our benefits are very competitive, and the summary below will give you an idea of what you can expect.

  • Competitive salary and a 3% year-end bonus.
  • 35,5 days of leave.
  • Attractive collective health care insurance package with considerable reduction rates.
  • Solid Pension Plan.
  • Incentive Plan (bonus).
  • Commuting allowance.
  • Numerous training, coaching and e-learning modules for long term job opportunities and development.

With Organon, your career is more than just a job — it’s a journey of purpose, impact, and leadership. Together, we are building innovative solutions that improve health and change lives around the globe. If you're ready to grow, lead, and be part of something bigger — we want to hear from you!

Secondary Job Description

Who We Are:

Organon delivers ingenious health solutions that enable people to live their best lives. We are a $6.5 billion global healthcare company focused on making a world of difference for women, their families and the communities they care for. We have an important portfolio and are growing it by investing in the unmet needs of Women’s Health, expanding access to leading biosimilars and touching lives with a diverse and trusted portfolio of health solutions.  Our Vision is clear: A better and healthier every day for every woman.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from candidates with a diverse background. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our applicants. 

Search Firm Representatives Please Read Carefully 
Organon LLC, does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. All CVs / resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at our company without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of our company.  No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral where no pre-existing agreement is in place. Where agency agreements are in place, introductions are position specific. Please, no phone calls or emails.

Job Description

Junior Technical Project manager

Driven by growth, you are developing your expertise and leadership skills to take on larger and more complex challenges later in your career.

Purpose of the role

The Junior Project Manager leads projects from early FEL phases through execution to commissioning, qualification, and handover. They collaborate with cross-functional teams—Production, EHS, Quality, Finance, Maintenance, and Procurement—to deliver projects aligned with business goals.

They manage pharmaceutical projects such as equipment renewal, building modifications, and HVAC/utilities, typically handling two small-to-medium projects per year with a budget of €1–2 million. Ambitious to grow into a Project Manager role, they report to the Portfolio Manager Pharmaceutical GMP Projects.

Welcome to the team

Engineering & Site Strategy is a Center of Excellence within Pharmaceutical Operations. You will report directly to the Portfolio Manager and will support the project implementation activities for Investment Projects at the manufacturing site in Oss. With an annual budget of 20 – 40 M€ the team realizes production scale-ups and modifications on facility and /or production equipment.

Main responsibilities

  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, resources, milestones, and risk assessments, ensuring alignment with business objectives
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams (internal and external), assign tasks, monitor progress, and ensure accountability while maintaining team engagement
  • Define clear, measurable goals and deliverables, maintaining a strong focus on results and proactively addressing challenges
  • Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders, aligning expectations, facilitating communication, and providing regular updates on progress, risks, and achievements
  • Identify and manage project risks, implement mitigation actions, and adjust plans in response to changing conditions
  • Resolve issues in a timely and structured manner, making informed decisions to keep projects on track
  • Monitor and report on project performance using KPIs, identifying improvement opportunities and ensuring successful delivery
  • Manage project budgets and resources effectively, ensuring optimal allocation and cost control
  • Ensure all deliverables meet quality and safety standards through structured reviews and compliance with project objectives
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying and implementing enhancements in project procedures, tools, and ways of working in collaboration with Engineering & Services and project teams

Your profile

  • HBO (Polytechnic) level of thinking and working
  • 2+ years of experience in industrial implementation projects (pharma or food industry preferred)
  • Experience with both architectural projects and technical system installations
  • Strong focus on quality and safety
  • Self-driven, independent, and able to prioritize effectively
  • Proactive, with a hands-on “go-and-see” mindset
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
  • Service- and customer-oriented
  • Able to communicate effectively with both senior management and technical staff
  • Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken
  • Experience with projects in execution planning and budget control

We offer

We welcome you to a truly global, dynamic and challenging environment with great opportunities for personal development. Our benefits are very competitive, and the summary below will give you an idea of what you can expect.

  • Competitive salary and a 3% year-end bonus.
  • 35,5 days of leave.
  • Attractive collective health care insurance package with considerable reduction rates.
  • Solid Pension Plan.
  • Incentive Plan (bonus).
  • Commuting allowance.
  • Numerous training, coaching and e-learning modules for long term job opportunities and development.

With Organon, your career is more than just a job — it’s a journey of purpose, impact, and leadership. Together, we are building innovative solutions that improve health and change lives around the globe. If you're ready to grow, lead, and be part of something bigger — we want to hear from you!

Organon delivers ingenious health solutions that enable people to live their best lives. We are a $6.5 billion global healthcare company focused on making a world of difference for women, their families and the communities they care for. We have an important portfolio and are growing it by investing in the unmet needs of Women’s Health, expanding access to leading biosimilars and touching lives with a diverse and trusted portfolio of health solutions.  Our Vision is clear: A better and healthier every day for every woman.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from candidates with a diverse background. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our applicants.

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands (Local applicants only)

positions.descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and service-oriented Associate Technical Support

Specialist to join our end-user support organization. This role is ideal for individuals

looking to build foundational experience in IT operations and technical support within a

fast-paced environment.

The successful candidate will assist employees with day-to-day technology issues,

provide timely customer support, and gain exposure to a wide range of enterprise

technologies and support processes. We value curiosity, adaptability, professionalism,

and a strong desire to develop technical skills.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Respond to user support requests through ticketing systems, chat platforms,

email, and virtual support channels.

• Troubleshoot common hardware, software, and access-related issues for end

users.

• Provide support for laptops, desktop systems, printers, mobile devices, and

collaboration tools.

• Assist with account access, password resets, VPN connectivity, and basic system

configuration tasks.

• Support users across multiple operating systems including Windows, macOS,

and ChromeOS.

• Help deploy and maintain mobile devices including iPhones, Android phones, and

tablets.

• Perform initial diagnosis of incidents and escalate unresolved or advanced issues

to higher-level support teams.

• Document troubleshooting activities and follow established operational

procedures and service standards.

• Assist with workstation setup, onboarding activities, and equipment preparation

when required.

• Participate in ongoing learning opportunities to expand technical and customer

support capabilities.

Preferred Skills• Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills.

• Interest in information technology, technical troubleshooting, and end-user

support.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

• Comfortable learning new technologies, tools, and processes.

• Organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple support requests

effectively.

• Prior experience in customer-facing IT roles is helpful but not required.

 

Qualifications

• Exposure to enterprise support environments or help desk operations.

• Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar ticket management platforms.

• Basic understanding of networking concepts such as wireless connectivity and

remote access solutions.

• Experience using or supporting mobile devices and modern workplace

technologies.

 

What We Offer

• Opportunity to launch and grow a career in IT support and operations.

• Collaborative environment with mentorship from experienced technical

professionals.

• Hands-on experience supporting enterprise technologies and end-user

environments.

• Career development opportunities, training, and internal growth potential.

 

#LI-JW1

positions.title: Creative Event & Marketing Allrounderin
positions.description:
Du bist ein kreativer Wirbelwind mit Struktur im Herzen?
Dann wirst du bei uns aufblühen.
Wir suchen eine innovative Allrounderin, die alles kann und will:
Marketing, Eventmanagement, Design, Social Media, KI-Tools und Kundenkontakt.
Du hast Lust, Ideen umzusetzen, Konzepte zu entwickeln, Texte zu schreiben, Events vorzubereiten und auch mal selbst mit Kamera oder Handy an den Event zu gehen, um Videos zu drehen.
Ort: Binningen (bei Basel)
Start: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben

Mitgestaltung & Organisation unserer Crime-Events (physisch & digital)
Planung und Umsetzung von Marketing- und Social-Media-Kampagnen
Gestaltung von Flyern, Posts, Präsentationen und Webseiten (Canva, Elementor etc.)
Einsatz moderner KI-Tools für Content, Automatisierung & kreative Konzepte
Kommunikation mit Kunden & Schauspielern
Eventvorbereitung (Material, Requisiten, Unterlagen)
Filmen, Schneiden und Produzieren von kurzen Reels oder Clips

Qualifikation
Dein Profil

Ausbildung oder Erfahrung in Marketing, Kommunikation, Event oder Design
Leidenschaft für Innovation, Kreativität und Storytelling
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise trotz kreativer Energie
Sicher im Umgang mit Social Media, Canva, Google Workspace und KI-Tools
Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, Englisch von Vorteil
Begeisterungsfähig, zuverlässig, eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert

Benefits
Was dich erwartet

Ein kreatives, innovatives Umfeld voller Freiheit, Verantwortung und Abenteuer
Familiäres herzliches Team
Arbeit direkt mit der Gründerin
Raum für eigene Ideen und zukunftsorientierte Projekte
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 1 Tag Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
Faire Entlöhnung und
Entwicklungsperspektive

So bewirbst du dich
Schick uns deine Bewerbung mit kurzem Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf und ein, zwei Arbeitsproben (z. B. Social-Media-Posts, Design, Video etc.)

positions.title: Creative Content Producer - Visual Media & Illustration, 80% (ID 2005) (Zizers, CH)
positions.description:
Short Description
 
We are looking for a curious, versatile creative professional who brings illustration skills alongside broader visual content production skills. Faced with a content brief, the ideal candidate considers the most effective way to communicate the message, often combining multiple formats and drawing on creative experience beyond the AO to strengthen surgical education content.Main Responsibilities
 
Visual Content Production (Primary)

Produce high-quality illustrations, infographics, and visual assets for medical education materials across print, web, e-learning, and event formats
Work from established templates and the AO illustration style guide; create new templates where gaps exist
Translate complex surgical procedures and medical concepts into clear, visually compelling imagery
Prepare and optimize visual assets for multi-format publishing (responsive web, LMS, presentations, print)
Produce motion graphics, short animations, or interactive visual elements for digital education 
Manage and organize visual assets within the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, ensuring accurate cataloging, accessibility, and optimal usability across multiple digital platforms.

Creative Collaboration & Content Development

Participate in content development workshops with surgeons, including occasional international travel
Collaborate with medical editors, instructional designers, project managers, and subject matter experts to ensure visual accuracy and pedagogical effectiveness
Proactively research anatomy, procedures, and clinical context to produce informed, accurate visual work
Contribute to creative visual content production beyond medical illustration

Quality & Standards

Apply and evolve the AO illustration style guide; ensure visual consistency and quality control across all outputs
Prepare illustrations for production workflows (embedding, color management, transparency, masks)
Maintain and update the internal image database and digital asset management system

Main Requirements

Degree in graphic design, scientific/medical illustration, biomedical visualization, visual communication, or related field
2–3 years of professional experience in visual content production, graphic design, or scientific illustration
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop
Proven record to translate complex information into clear, memorable visual formats
Experience working from brand/style guides and template systems
Fluent English (written and verbal); German language skills preferred
Independent, structured, and organized working style with the ability to manage multiple projects
Comfort with AI-assisted creative workflows (e.g., Adobe Firefly, generative tools) as part of a modern production process

Highly Valued

Motion graphics / animation capability (After Effects or equivalent)
3D modelling, rendering, or visualization experience
Basic video editing or asset preparation for video production workflows
Understanding of responsive and multi-format design principles
Data visualization skills beyond standard charting
Familiarity with instructional design principles

Nice-to-Have

Experience with digital asset management systems (eg, Bynder)
Experience with content management systems (eg, Sitecore)
UX/UI design sensibility
Medical or scientific subject matter background

positions.descriptionHtml:
The story of Cartier is founded on audacity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 9000+ colleagues of 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity.

MISSION PRINCIPALE

Au sein de la Direction Brand Image, vous contribuez au développement et à la production des contenus éditoriaux de la Maison (ex : activités commerciales produits, histoire & storytelling, savoir-faire, expositions…), diffusés sur ses différents supports (média, social, presse, website…) à l’international.

Vous intervenez en lien étroit avec les équipes internes et les partenaires créatifs, en assurant la cohérence des projets, de leur conception à leur livraison.

RESPONSABILITES CLES

Regard, culture et accompagnement créatif

  • Participer à la formulation des briefs, en nourrissant la réflexion par une veille attentive et une compréhension sensible des enjeux d’image.
  • Accompagner les agences dans le développement de leurs propositions créatives.
  • Contribuer à l’affinement des concepts, des récits et des partis pris visuels.
  • Veiller à la justesse et à la continuité des expressions éditoriales de la Maison.
  • Participer à la réflexion autour des lignes éditoriales et de leur évolution.

Production et réalisation des contenus

  • Organiser et coordonner les shootings et tournages :
    • Préparation des productions,
    • Coordination des équipes et des talents,
    • Gestion logistique et suivi des confiés,
    • Suivi des plannings et des validations.
  • Veiller à la qualité d’exécution des productions et à la fidélité aux intentions créatives.
  • Suivre les étapes de post-production.
  • Assurer la fluidité des échanges entre les différents interlocuteurs.

Gestion et coordination des projets

  • Assurer le suivi et la livraison des projets dans le respect des délais.
  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets de production.
  • Coordonner les validations internes (éditoriales, juridiques, marketing).

Culture de l’image et curiosité

Ce poste repose sur une curiosité exigeante et continue pour l’image et la culture.

Dans cette perspective :

  • Vous entretenez une veille régulière sur la photographie, l’édition, le cinéma, le design et les pratiques artistiques contemporaines.
  • Vous observez les évolutions des écritures visuelles et des formes narratives.
  • Vous identifiez les talents, les studios et les approches susceptibles d’enrichir les projets de la Maison.
  • Vous développez une lecture personnelle et cultivée des images, au service des projets.
  • Vous contribuez à nourrir les réflexions créatives par un regard précis et constamment renouvelé.

PROFIL

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation supérieure en communication, école de commerce, ou universités, et justifiez d’une expérience d’au moins 3 ans en agence ou chez l’annonceur, dans les secteurs du luxe, de la mode ou de la communication internationale.
  • Vous vous distinguez par une curiosité forte, structurée et continue pour l’image et la culture visuelle. Vous avez un regard construit sur l’image.
  • Vous développez un intérêt marqué pour la photographie, l’édition, le cinéma, le design, l’art et les pratiques artistiques émergentes et avez une bonne compréhension de la chaîne de production (photo, film, digital).
  • Vous avez une capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs créatifs et opérationnels. 
  • Vous êtes rigoureux, organisé et autonome.
  • Vous avez un fort sens de l’anticipation et une capacité à prioriser.
  • Vous parlez français et anglais couramment.

Poste basé à : Paris 8ème

CDD à pourvoir à partir de juin 2026

positions.descriptionHtml:
Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement.


Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients.

Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée.


Dans le cadre, d 'un contrat pro ou d'Apprentissage de fin d’étude de 1 à 2 ans, nous te proposons de travailler sur des projets de transformation numérique variés qui vont couvrir toutes les phases de cadrage, conception, implémentation et déploiement.

Nous t’accompagnerons pour que tu montes significativement en compétences sur le poste de Développeur-se Backend Java. Il s’agira donc de…

  • Participer au développement et à la conception d’applications en utilisant les technologies Java/J2EE Spring (Springboot), JPA (Hibernate), Apache Tomcat, les API Rest/ Soap, JSF.
  • Pratiquer l’utilisation des conteneurs (Docker), leurs orchestrateurs (Kubernetes, Openshift) ainsi que l’un des 3 cloud Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Découvrir et expérimenter les domaines de l’industrialisation ainsi que les principaux composants d’une usine logicielle : Jenkins, Gitlab, Sonarqube, Artifactory, Jira, Confluence.
  • Être familiarisé au développement de projet en contexte Agile / Scrum / Software / Craftmanship.
  • Participer à la rédaction ou à l’évolution des documentations techniques
  • Effectuer et automatiser les tests avec JUnit, Postman et SoapUI.
  • Participer à la résolution des anomalies constatées et à la livraison des applications

QUI RECHERCHONS-NOUS ?

Tu termines ton cursus en Ecole d’ingénieur avec idéalement une spécialité dans le développement logiciel ou Web ?

Tu es curieux-se et motivé-e, tu as l’ambition de devenir Leader Technique Java dans un futur proche ?

Tu es Investi-e, doté-e d’un excellent relationnel, et tu apprécies relever les challenges technologiques complexes avec des collègues fédérateurs et orientés Solution ?

En plus, tu aimes travailler en mode Agile ?


Onepoint en quelques mots

Créée en 2002 par David Layani, Onepoint est devenu en un peu plus de 20 ans l’un des acteurs majeurs du conseil et de la tech, notre collectif compte aujourd’hui plus de 4000 talents en France (Aix-en-Provence, Bordeaux, Lyon, Nantes, Paris, Rennes, Strasbourg et Toulouse) et dans le monde (Australie, Belgique, Canada, Etats-Unis, Angleterre, Malaisie, Maroc et Singapour). Notre chiffre d’affaires a été multiplié par dix en 10 ans, atteignant plus de 500 millions d’euros, et ambitionne le milliard d’euros d’ici 4 ans.


Notre promesse   


Un parcours sur mesure pour tous nos talents

Pour accompagner l’évolution de tous nos talents, nous proposons deux axes d’évolution complémentaires leur permettant de s’épanouir et de bénéficier des mêmes avantages : le business management et l’expertise.


L’école Onepoint pour développer vos expertises

Avec plus de 200 formations à son catalogue, notre école permet à nos talents de se former tout au long de leur vie professionnelle, en articulant travail et apprentissage.


Nos lieux de vie

Nos espaces de travail sont situés au cœur des territoires, au plus près de de nos talents de concilier projet de vie et projet professionnel.


Et bien plus encore ...

Notre écosystème permet de pratiquer de nombreuses activités loisirs et sportives (musique, photo, e-sport, yoga…) avec un cadre de travail flexible grâce à une charte de  télétravail, et de prendre soin de tous (cabinet médical en libre accès, groupes de travail dédiés aux enjeux « égalité et pluralité » …).


Comme des images valent mieux que mille mots, découvrez notre ADN à travers cette vidéo : Nous sommes Onepoint✨

  • Création et Conceptualisation : à la suite de la réception du brief, vous participez à la réflexion créative en proposant des idées novatrices pour des packagings et gifts exclusifs, tout en respectant les codes de la Maison. Vous soumettez des propositions détaillées, des maquettes, croquis, rendus, planches d’inspirations et de matières.
  • Suivi de Projet : Vous participez à l’avancement des projets de la conception à la production, en réalisant des plans, des modélisations 3D, et des maquettes. Vous suivez le développement des projets en autonomie, puis leur production en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Achats.
  • Relation avec les Fournisseurs : Vous êtes en contact direct avec les fournisseurs externes pour assurer le bon déroulement des projets (participation aux réunions, suivi de production, contrôle des prototypes et ajustements).
  • Veille Créative et Concurrentielle : Vous suivez les tendances du marché en packaging et gifting, et réalisez une veille concurrentielle régulière.

Profil recherché :

  • Formation : De formation Bac+5 en école de design, arts appliqués, ou similaire.
  • Compétences Techniques : Vous maîtrisez la suite Adobe (Illustrator, Photoshop) et des logiciels de modélisation 3D tels que Rhino. Une expérience avec Keyshot serait un plus.
  • Compétences Personnelles : Vous êtes créatif(ve), curieux(se), et aimez travailler en équipe. Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se), et avez un bon sens de la gestion du temps. Vous êtes capables de gérer plusieurs projets simultanément et de vous adresser à différents interlocuteurs (internes et externes à l’entreprise).
  • Langues : Maîtrise de l’anglais souhaitée pour les échanges avec les fournisseurs et les équipes à l’international.

De la singularité de chacun naît la richesse de nos équipes. CHANEL valorise la diversité sous toutes ses formes.

Lieu : Paris
Durée : 6 mois, à partir de septembre 2026
Type : Stage

Company Description:

Le Groupe Digital Virgo compte parmi les spécialistes mondiaux du paiement mobile via les solutions de facturation des opérateurs télécoms. En connectant les marchands aux opérateurs, nous répondons au besoin croissant de digitalisation du paiement en utilisant un canal transactionnel simple, rapide et sécurisé, disponible partout dans le monde.

En rejoignant Digital Virgo, vous intégrez un Groupe international performant et innovant grâce à des équipes locales, à taille humaine qui collaborent au quotidien, fortes de leur complémentarité. Nous venons tous d’univers et de parcours différents, c’est cette diversité qui fait notre richesse.

Nos collaborateurs nous disent que l'ambiance de travail est un mix de bonne humeur, de bienveillance et d’exigence. Nous mettons l'accent sur le développement de chacun, l’autonomie et la prise d'initiatives.

Plus d’informations sur notre activité et groupe sur digitalvirgo.com

Job Description:

Au sein de notre pôle Editorial & Vidéo, véritable studio créatif intégré, vous contribuerez à la conception et à la production de contenus vidéo à forte valeur ajoutée.

Vous participerez à la création de vidéos destinées à nos campagnes publicitaires digitales, à la mise en avant de nos produits ainsi qu’à l’animation de nos réseaux sociaux, pour des audiences en France comme à l’international.

Nous recherchons un profil doté d’une solide compréhension des codes de la publicité digitale et des leviers de performance créative, capable de concevoir des contenus à la fois impactants, engageants et orientés résultats.

Vos missions :

En véritable chef de projet créatif, vous interviendrez à chaque étape de la production :

  • Participer à la réflexion créative : brainstorming, storytelling, concepts publicitaires et recommandations créatives. 
  • Donner vie aux idées : Concevoir et produire des vidéos pensées pour capter l’attention et performer sur les plateformes sociales.(motion design, montage, sound design, voix-off, habillage et effets visuels.)
  • Adapter les formats selon les plateformes et les usages (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Meta Ads…).
  • Optimiser la production grâce aux outils techniques et aux solutions d’IA dédiées à la création vidéo.
  • Explorer de nouveaux formats créatifs et intégrer des outils innovants, notamment liés à l’IA générative et à la création vidéo. 

 

Qualifications:

Profil recherché

  • Titulaire d'une formation en audiovisuel ou motion design (Bac+4/5)
  • Vous justifiez d’au moins 2 ans d’expérience en agence, en studio créatif ou dans un environnement orienté publicité digitale et social media
  • Vous maîtrisez parfaitement la suite Adobe, avec une expertise particulière sur After Effects
  • Des compétences en 3D, illustration, dessin ou l'usage d'outils IA créatives constituent un atout supplémentaire
  • À l’aise dans des environnements de production dynamiques, vous gérez des volumes importants de contenus tout en vous adaptant à des besoins variés.
  • Vous savez concilier efficacité opérationnelle, exigence créative et compréhension des enjeux marketing
  • Vous possédez une solide culture du marketing digital, avec une excellente maîtrise des codes de la publicité sur les réseaux sociaux et des formats orientés performance
  • Vous portez un intérêt marqué aux univers du divertissement (sport, musique, cinéma, gaming, culture web…)
  • Vous faites preuve de curiosité, de créativité et de rigueur, avec un sens aigu du rythme, de l’esthétique et du détail
  • Vous disposez d’un bon niveau d’anglais (B2 minimum), à l’écrit comme à l’oral

 

 

Additional Information:

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une équipe créative au sein d’un groupe international du digital et du divertissement.
  • Travailler sur des campagnes publicitaires, contenus social media et projets variés à destination d’audiences internationales.
  • Participer à des projets valorisants autour d’univers premium : gaming, sport, divertissement, médias…
  • Concevoir des contenus mêlant créativité, marketing digital et production vidéo à grande échelle.
  • Développer de vraies compétences en création publicitaire, motion design et formats social media.

Si vous aimez créer, innover et raconter des histoires en mouvement, envoyez-nous votre CV et votre portfolio : nous avons hâte de découvrir votre univers !

 

Politique Télétravail : 1 jour / semaine + 20 jours par an

Avantages entreprise : 8 jours de RTT, abonnement transports en commun ou vélo (prise en charge 50%), carte tickets restaurant (valeur 10 €, prise en charge à 60%), Mutuelle familiale (prise en charge à 60%), Participation.

CSE dynamique : Remboursement abonnement sportif, chèques vacances, billetterie (ticket cinéma, cheque culture…).

Rémunération: entre 32-38K selon profil

Vidéo à regarder :

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4ocC1FgUwt0Hk8cQG4nmWzP97aC5zNhR&si=Ux0IUAtShkvnCPsh

Process de recrutement 

Si votre profil retient notre attention, vous rencontrerez d’abord les RH, puis les responsables opérationnels.

Chez Digital Virgo, la diversité est notre force. Rejoignez une équipe inclusive où chacun.e a sa place.

🚲 Digital Virgo est aussi un employeur engagé Pro Vélo 💚

positions.descriptionHtml:
Présentation du rôle

Chez Onoff, la marque est un produit à part entière.

Nous recherchons un·e Creative Designer capable de donner forme à notre identité visuelle et de la faire vivre à travers des contenus simples, justes et impactants.

Votre terrain de jeu : le digital.
Vos formats : social, vidéo, motion, design.
Votre mission : transformer des idées en images qui comptent.

Vous travaillerez directement avec le Team Lead Brand dans une logique de binôme créatif. Un rôle central, avec de l’espace pour créer, proposer, tester, et faire évoluer la marque au quotidien.

Ce que vous ferez

Créer. Tester. Itérer.

  • Concevoir des assets pour nos produits et nos campagnes

  • Produire des contenus social-first (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X)

  • Décliner des campagnes sur plusieurs formats et plateformes

  • Créer des visuels, des animations et des contenus vidéo courts

  • Participer à la construction de l’univers visuel de la marque

Direction artistique & marque

Faire évoluer une identité.

  • Contribuer à la direction artistique d’Onoff

  • Maintenir une cohérence visuelle simple, claire et forte

  • Explorer de nouveaux territoires créatifs

  • Participer à la structuration de notre brand book et de notre plateforme de marque

  • Donner du sens visuel aux campagnes et aux produits

Motion & vidéo

Penser mouvement.

  • Produire des formats courts, pensés pour l’attention digitale

  • Créer des animations et du motion design

  • Monter des contenus rapides, efficaces, précis

  • Tester différents styles et approches narratives

  • Adapter les créations aux codes des plateformes sociales

Profil recherché

Nous cherchons avant tout un regard.

  • 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en design, brand ou création de contenu

  • Expérience en environnement startup ou SaaS appréciée

  • Forte culture visuelle et sens du détail

  • Bonne maîtrise des outils de création (After Effects, Premiere, Figma, Photoshop…)

  • À l’aise avec les formats social media et leurs codes

  • Capacité à produire vite, sans perdre en qualité

  • Anglais professionnel (B2 minimum)

Ce qui fait la différence

  • Une vraie sensibilité créative

  • Une capacité à simplifier des idées complexes

  • Une culture du digital et des tendances

  • Une envie de construire, pas seulement exécuter

  • Une forte autonomie

  • Un goût pour l’expérimentation (motion, IA, nouveaux formats)

Outils

  • After Effects

  • Premiere Pro

  • Figma

  • Photoshop / Illustrator

  • CapCut

  • Outils IA créatifs (Midjourney, Kling, ChatGPT…)

Ce que nous aimons

  • Les créatifs qui pensent en systèmes, pas en pièces isolées

  • Ceux qui savent donner du rythme à une idée simple

  • Les personnes rapides, précises, autonomes

positions.descriptionMarkdown:
