Chez Onoff, la marque est un produit à part entière.

Nous recherchons un·e Creative Designer capable de donner forme à notre identité visuelle et de la faire vivre à travers des contenus simples, justes et impactants.

Votre terrain de jeu : le digital.
Vos formats : social, vidéo, motion, design.
Votre mission : transformer des idées en images qui comptent.

Vous travaillerez directement avec le Team Lead Brand dans une logique de binôme créatif. Un rôle central, avec de l’espace pour créer, proposer, tester, et faire évoluer la marque au quotidien.

Ce que vous ferez

Créer. Tester. Itérer.

- Concevoir des assets pour nos produits et nos campagnes
- Produire des contenus social-first (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X)
- Décliner des campagnes sur plusieurs formats et plateformes
- Créer des visuels, des animations et des contenus vidéo courts
- Participer à la construction de l’univers visuel de la marque
Direction artistique & marque

Faire évoluer une identité.

- Contribuer à la direction artistique d’Onoff
- Maintenir une cohérence visuelle simple, claire et forte
- Explorer de nouveaux territoires créatifs
- Participer à la structuration de notre brand book et de notre plateforme de marque
- Donner du sens visuel aux campagnes et aux produits
Motion & vidéo

Penser mouvement.

- Produire des formats courts, pensés pour l’attention digitale
- Créer des animations et du motion design
- Monter des contenus rapides, efficaces, précis
- Tester différents styles et approches narratives
- Adapter les créations aux codes des plateformes sociales
Profil recherché

Nous cherchons avant tout un regard.

- 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en design, brand ou création de contenu
- Expérience en environnement startup ou SaaS appréciée
- Forte culture visuelle et sens du détail
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de création (After Effects, Premiere, Figma, Photoshop…)

- Capacité à produire vite, sans perdre en qualité
- Anglais professionnel (B2 minimum)

- Une vraie sensibilité créative

- Une envie de construire, pas seulement exécuter

- Figma
- Photoshop / Illustrator
- CapCut
- Outils IA créatifs (Midjourney, Kling, ChatGPT…)
Ce que nous aimons

- Les créatifs qui pensent en systèmes, pas en pièces isolées
- Ceux qui savent donner du rythme à une idée simple
- Les personnes rapides, précises, autonomes
- Les makers qui passent de l’idée à l’exécution sans friction

positions.title: Givaudan Careers Preservation Technologist (118717)
positions.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with passion and imagination, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. In France, discover the empowered passionate professionals who made history creating our legendary perfumery school. Feel the heritage. Acquire knowledge and experience, gained in our renowned European Creation Centre, or from any of our 17 innovative sites across the country. Every day, your commitment, your humility, and your risk-taking will shape our future. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.
 Nous recrutons un(e) Preservation Technologist sur notre site d'Avignon, votre mission sera de mener à bien des tâches de recherche modérément complexes selon des processus/instructions prédéfinis tout en respectant des normes de qualité spécifiques.
 
Missions:

Effectuer des tâches de laboratoire de recherche et développement de complexité modérée en suivant les procédures.
Savoir utiliser, entretenir et organiser le matériel de laboratoire.
Enregistrer les résultats expérimentaux, rédiger un résumé écrit des résultats et tenir un cahier de laboratoire électronique ordonné.
Savoir interpréter ses résultats et définir les étapes suivantes à effectuer. 
Effectuer des contrôles de maintenance et de sécurité de routine sur les équipements de laboratoire afin de s’assurer de leur bon fonctionnement.
Résoudre des problèmes techniques routiniers en utilisant des méthodes et protocoles définis
Effectuer la gestion des stocks.

Gestion de projet :

Exécuter les tâches assignées selon le calendrier.
Suggérer des améliorations des processus ou procédés

Collaboration et communication:

Contribuer à une bonne communication au sein et à l’extérieur de l’équipe.
Signaler toute déviation ou défaut de processus et/ou d’équipement. 
Respecter toutes les procédures opérationnelles écrites, procédures et politiques des installations et de sécurité.

Votre profil:

Diplôme d’études secondaires dans le domaine des sciences alimentaires, chimie, biologie, ou domaines connexes.
Idéalement deux ans d’expérience en laboratoire de développement de l’industrie de métier connexe, alimentaire, chimie, biologie, science analytique, cosmétique. 
Connaissances techniques et en équipement de laboratoire pour effectuer des fonctions S&T.
Connaissance des matériaux et fournitures nécessaires pour mener des expériences en laboratoire de S&T.
Capacité à résumer efficacement les données et conclusions à utiliser pour d’autres discussions de projet et des présentations internes/externes.
Maîtrise des logiciels de bureautique.
Idéalement maîtrise de l’anglais niveau scolaire et technique débutant. 

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.
We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.
Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.
Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Application Technologist H/F

Application Technologist  H/F

IMCD France – Food & Nutrition

A propos d'IMCD France

Rejoindre IMCD France, c'est intégrer une équipe à taille humaine de 200 collaborateurs, où l'esprit entrepreneurial et l'excellence sont au cœur de notre culture. Adossés à IMCD Group, groupe international de référence dans la distribution de produits chimiques et d’ingrédients de spécialité, nous offrons à nos collaborateurs des opportunités de développement uniques et un environnement de travail stimulant. Forts de 80 ans d'expérience, nous mettons notre expertise au service de nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets les plus ambitieux. Nos équipes d'experts techniques, dédiées à de nombreux marchés, répondent aux besoins de nos clients grâce à une offre de produits variés issus de longues et solides collaborations avec les fournisseurs les plus réputés dans le monde.

A propos d'IMCD Group

Le Groupe IMCD est un leader mondial du marché de la vente, du marketing et de la distribution de produits chimiques de spécialité et d’ingrédients. Ses professionnels, orientés résultats, apportent des solutions aux fournisseurs et aux clients à travers les zones EMEA, Amériques et Asie-Pacifique. IMCD propose un portefeuille de produits complet allant de l’entretien ménager, industriel et institutionnel, à la beauté et aux soins personnels, en passant par l’agroalimentaire, la nutrition et la pharmacie, jusqu'aux lubrifiants et à l'énergie, aux revêtements et à la construction, aux matériaux avancés et à la synthèse.

Le Groupe IMCD a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 4,7 milliards d'euros en 2024 avec plus de 5 000 employés répartis dans plus de 50 pays. L'équipe d'experts techniques et commerciaux d'IMCD travaille en partenariat étroit pour concevoir les meilleures solutions de leur catégorie et créer de la valeur, grâce à leur expertise, pour environ 60 000 clients et une gamme diversifiée de fournisseurs de classe mondiale. Les actions d'IMCD sont cotées sur Euronext Amsterdam.

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Technique Food & Nutrition, le/la Application Technologist contribue activement à l’ambition d’IMCD de devenir un leader des solutions de formulation.
Basé(e) au laboratoire Applications de La Plaine Saint-Denis, il/elle pilote les projets techniques, accompagne la stratégie de croissance et agit comme partenaire auprès des clients, des équipes commerciales et des fournisseurs.

Principales missions*

- Animer le pipeline de projets dont il/elle a la charge et en assurer l’animation permanente jusqu’à sa concrétisation commerciale.
- Apporter une expertise formulation à forte valeur ajoutée aux équipes commerciales et aux clients.
- Développer et mettre en œuvre des concepts innovants (boulangerie, produits salés, produits laitiers, boissons, nutrition, confiserie) valorisant le portefeuille d’ingrédients IMCD et en lien avec les tendances marché. Est à ce titre l’acteur clé de la collaboration entre les équipes techniques, le commerciales et le marketing.
- Développer et mettre en œuvre des concepts innovants (boulangerie, produits salés, produits laitiers, boissons, nutrition, confiserie) valorisant le portefeuille d’ingrédients IMCD et en lien avec les tendances marché. Est à ce titre l’acteur clé de la collaboration entre les équipes techniques, commerciales et marketing.
- Conduire et réaliser les essais de formulations en laboratoire (fonctionnalité des ingrédients, aromatisation, optimisation process) et garantir la qualité des recommandations techniques.
- Organiser et animer des dégustations événements clients et salons professionnels.

    • Sortir rapidement de nouveaux concepts pour les tester en conditions réelles et itérer vite

    • Collaborer avec les collègues data et l'agence partenaire pour affiner les orientations créatives
    • Intégrer les apprentissages dans chaque nouvelle production pour améliorer les performances en continu

  • Un environnement de travail jeune, collaboratif et stimulant où chaque idée peut être entendue
  • Des événements d’entreprise et activités de team-building réguliers
  • Une entreprise en forte croissance offrant de réelles perspectives d’évolution

positions.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

Location: Aimargues, France - near Montpellier (Occitanie region), with easy access to the Mediterranean coast and major transport hubs.

Segment: Royal Canin

Type of contract: Permanent

We are seeking a dynamic and hands-on R&D Prototyping Technologist to join our team. This role is crucial in supporting innovation from concept to reality, supporting the entire product development lifecycle across our technologies.

This role acts as a crucial link between early-stage innovation and later-stage industrialization, operating as a hands-on process technologist within project teams. It requires strong practical skills in a lab or pilot plant environment, good analytical abilities, and a collaborative mindset to work effectively across different functions.

What are we looking for?

  • Master degree in a scientific/Food/technical subject.

  • At least 5 years relevant experiences in technology development or implementation.

  • Processing experience.

  • Factory experience is a nice to have.

  • The ideal candidate will be involved in early-stage ideation and prototyping, as well as leading pilot tests, analyzing data, and ensuring a smooth transition to our Global Technology Implementation team.

What will be your key responsibilities?

Exploration phase (FEF initiatives/projects):

  • Prototype creative ideas and provide technical insights to support Demand and R&D initiatives.

  • Create practical prototypes for internal needs.

  • Assess the technical feasibility of new solutions in collaboration with the Solution Designer.

  • Explore new prototyping options aligned with Technical Center capabilities and compile a prototyping catalog for The Hive.

  • Supply the R&D Innovation team with necessary prototyping tools.

  • Collaborate with the Product Research team to integrate new technologies and process improvements.

Development phase (QuEST initiatives/projects):

  • Lead pilot tests and support the scale-up of pilot tests.

  • Ensure the complete and accurate transfer of data and deliverables to the Global Technology Implementation team.

  • Use and leverage existing data to make informed, objective, and rationalized decisions.

  • Work to improve the efficiency of pilot testing through better data utilization.

  • Help establish an industrialization Community of Practice (COP) to optimize workflows and define clear handover needs.

Collaboration:

  • Build a strong, collaborative partnership with the Research, Design and Deploy teams.

  • Interact with Demand teams, particularly in the context of the Idea Management steps (FEF), to ensure prototyping is concretely triggered and utilized.

  • Participate actively in QuEST project meetings and other cross-functional technical initiatives.

  • Participate and contribute to the Idea Management phases

  • Collaborate with the Design and Pilot Plant teams for the set up of the New Technical Center.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • At Mars, we believe in a relationship of mutual trust, dignity and respect between our company and Associates that is more meaningful than the standard employer/employee relationship.

  • As Associates, we can expect to be respected, supported and valued as individuals, to be treated fairly and equitably.

  • The opportunity to learn and develop, taking charge of your own career across Mars.

  •  You will work in a multicultural environment (more than 40 nationalities) and where your dog will be welcomed by more than 100 other Associates’ dogs at the office!   

  • You will work in a unique campus, which gathers more than 800 Associates working for: the international HQ, the French subsidiary, two laboratories, a kennel and a cattery with more than 200 cats & dogs, and finally the most important factory of the Royal Canin group

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Beerse, Antwerp, Belgium

Job Description:

Bij Johnson & Johnson geloven we dat gezondheid alles is. Onze innovatieve kracht in de gezondheidszorg stelt ons in staat te bouwen aan een wereld waarin complexe ziekten kunnen voorkomen, behandeld en genezen worden. Een wereld waarin behandelingen slimmer en minder invasief zijn en oplossingen op maat gemaakt zijn. Door onze expertise op het gebied van innovatieve geneesmiddelen en medische technologiebevinden we ons in een unieke positie om te innoveren in het volledige spectrum van de gezondheidszorg en zo doorbraken te realiseren die een grote impact hebben op de gezondheid van mensen wereldwijd. Meer informatie vind je op www.jnj.com

Over Innovatieve Geneeskunde

Onze expertise op het gebied van innovatieve geneeskunde wordt geïnformeerd en geïnspireerd door patiënten, wier inzichten onze wetenschappelijke vooruitgang voeden. Mensen met een visie zoals jij werken in teams die levens redden door de medicijnen van morgen te ontwikkelen.

Sluit je bij ons aan om behandelingen te ontwikkelen, genezingen te vinden en de weg te banen van het laboratorium naar het dagelijks leven, terwijl we patiënten bij elke stap van het proces ondersteunen.

Ga voor meer informatie naar https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

CAR-T is een innovatieve behandeling tegen bloedkanker, die gebruik maakt van de kracht van het eigen immuunsysteem van de patiënt. Het is een complexe en gepersonaliseerde technologie waarbij de eigen T-cellen van een patiënt uit het bloed geïsoleerd worden en opnieuw worden geprogrammeerd om kankercellen te herkennen en uit te roeien. Deze vooruitstrevende technologie biedt vooruitzichten voor patiënten bij wie andere therapieën geen of onvoldoende resultaat behalen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Instaan voor de eerste stap in het productieproces van CAR-T: jij voert de formulatie- en cryopreservatieprocessen uit voor witte bloedcellen.
  • Streven naar de hoogste kwaliteit na en past de geldende regelgeving en standaarden toe.
  • Meewerken aan de optimalisatie van onze processen. Jouw ervaring en input zijn cruciaal om onze aanpak verder te versterken.

Jouw Impact:

  • Je vormt een cruciale schakel in ons productieproces.
  • Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team dat borg staat voor topkwaliteit.
  • Je werkt in een dynamische omgeving die persoonlijke en professionele groei stimuleert.

Kwalificaties:

  • Een bachelor in laboratoriumtechnologie, biochemie, chemie, of een gerelateerd vakgebied of gelijkwaardig door relevante werkervaring in een sterk gereguleerde omgeving b.v. in de farmaceutische, voedingsmiddelen-, chemie- of biotechsector.
  • Bereidheid om in shiften te werken: verschoven werkweek (di – zat), gecombineerd met dag/late regime
  • Sterke aandacht voor detail en kwaliteit.
  • Verantwoordelijkheidszin in het toepassen van procedures en richtlijnen.
  • Goede communicatievaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

Ons sollicitatieproces

Bij Johnson & Johnson willen we dat elke kandidaat zich ondersteund voelt tijdens het sollicitatieproces. Ons doel is om de ervaring duidelijk, eerlijk en respectvol te maken voor jouw tijd.

Wat kun je verwachten:

  • Beoordeling van je sollicitatie: We bekijken je cv zorgvuldig om te zien hoe jouw vaardigheden en ervaring aansluiten bij de functie.
  • Kennismaking: Als er een goede match is, word je uitgenodigd voor een kort gesprek met een van onze recruiters om meer over jou te weten te komen en eventuele vragen te beantwoorden.
  • Op de hoogte blijven: We begrijpen dat wachten lastig kan zijn en dat processen kunnen veranderen; ons recruitmentteam houdt je op de hoogte en zorgt ervoor dat je weet wat je bij elke stap kunt verwachten.
  • Laatste stappen: Voor succesvolle kandidaten moeten land-specifieke controles worden afgerond voordat je aan je nieuwe functie begint. Wij begeleiden je hierbij.

Tot slot nodigen we je aan het einde van het proces uit om feedback te geven via een korte enquête — jouw input helpt ons om de ervaring voor toekomstige kandidaten te blijven verbeteren.

positions.title: AI Creative
positions.description: Company description At Publicis Groupe Belgium we are driven by the Power of One. That’s our raison d’être: to make brands relevant and interesting to people, to touch them and influence their behavior, to grow the business of the brands we work for. More than 200 diverse bright experts are organized in 4 interconnected métiers (strategy & data, creative experiences, media activation, and production) and are the drivers of our collective creativity. And ow, yeah, it’s “Groupe” with an “e”. With our group’s roots in la douce France you can expect loads of Liberté, Curiosité and Créativité. Overview We are looking for a highly creative AI-native talent who is passionate about shaping the future of visual storytelling through Generative AI. As an AI Creative, you will explore, create and develop cutting-edge visual concepts, campaigns and content using the latest GenAI technologies across image, video and motion. You will collaborate closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Designers and Production teams to transform ideas into innovative, visually striking and scalable creative outputs. Beyond execution, you will actively contribute to pushing creative boundaries, experimenting with new workflows, tools and AI capabilities to help evolve the future of creative production within Publicis Production. Responsibilities Develop innovative visual concepts using GenAI tools. Create high-end AI-generated visuals, motion and video content for campaigns, social media, digital experiences and brand content. Explore and experiment with emerging AI tools, workflows and creative technologies. Translate briefs and creative ideas into compelling AI-driven visual executions. Combine creative intuition with advanced prompting techniques to achieve strong artistic and brand-consistent outputs. Collaborate with Creative Directors and Designers to enhance and elevate campaign ideas through AI. Build visual worlds, moods, aesthetics and storytelling systems using GenAI. Contribute to the development of AI creative methodologies, workflows and internal inspiration libraries. Stay ahead of trends in GenAI creativity, visual culture, design, motion and digital innovation. Qualifications Required Experience 5+ years in creative roles such as Art Direction, Design, Motion Design, Digital Creation, Creative Technology or related creative fields. Strong hands-on experience with GenAI image and/or video tools (Runway, Veo, Kling, Freepik, ComfyUI, Flux, Stable Diffusion, etc.). Strong creative eye and understanding of composition, aesthetics, storytelling, visual culture and branding. Ability to move quickly from idea to visual exploration. Experience creating AI-enhanced campaign visuals, social content, motion or storytelling assets. Curiosity and passion for emerging technologies and AI-driven creativity. Comfortable working in a fast-evolving creative environment. Experience with motion, editing or 3D is a plus. Knowledge of prompting, workflows, fine-tuning or AI pipelines is a plus. Soft Skills Highly creative and curious mindset Strong visual sensitivity and trend awareness Experimental and innovation-driven mentality Positive collaborative attitude Agile and solution-oriented Passionate about the future of creativity and technology Additional information Why Join Us? At Publicis Production, we believe AI is not replacing creativity, it is expanding it. You will join a multidisciplinary team combining creativity, craft, technology and innovation to shape the next generation of content creation at scale. This is an opportunity to work on ambitious international brands while helping redefine the future of creative production. What can you expect? A key position in a resourceful and people obsessed organization. Ambitious clients in the middle of their business transformation. A competitive salary and benefits program. An inclusive organization that recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age,… A “great place to work” in the Manhattan Center, a modern building located right in the heart of Brussels and easily accessible by all means of transport. Our offices are set in an inspiring, future‑proof environment, certified as one of the world’s top 5% green buildings, reflecting our strong commitment to sustainability and well‑being at work. Interested? If this role resonates with your experience, creativity and ambition, we would love to hear from you! Click on apply and send your portfolio, CV and/or relevant AI creative work. We’re especially interested in seeing: • AI-generated visual work • Creative explorations and experiments • Campaigns or storytelling projects • Motion, image or hybrid AI workflows • Personal creative initiatives and innovation projects

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

We Elevate. Digitally.

SQLI is a European player and market leader in customer experience and digital transformation, helping major international brands create value through technology and digital innovation. From strategy to the effective implementation of technological solutions, we design and build robust, high-performance architectures and engaging digital experiences, combining advanced technologies, proven methodologies, and deep expertise.

To strengthen our teams (2,200 employees across 12 countries), we are looking for driven talent who share our values: Creativity, Engagement, and a Future-minded approach.

SQLI Ghent creative agency; that’s us: 50+ digital specialists working every day on projects that truly matter. For brands like Colruyt Group, Brustor, Pierre Fabre, and Jules Destrooper, we build digital strategies, campaigns, and platforms that make a real impact. As part of an international group, we have the scale and expertise of a large agency, while operating with the commitment and agility of a local team.

At SQLI, we work with digital leaders and CMOs who expect clarity, challenges, and results. Our mission is simple: outperform industry standards by uniting strategy, marketing, and design. 

Great ideas are only great if they work. 

At SQLI, we combine strategy, marketing, and design to create brand experiences that perform - across campaigns, platforms, and ecommerce. 

We’re looking for a Lead Art Director who not only elevates creative work, but also elevates the people creating it. 

Job Description:

You bring ideas to life -> visually, conceptually, and through people. 

  • Support the Creative Director in developing brand and campaign concepts 

  • Translate strategy into strong visual directions and creative ideas 

  • Create and oversee execution across digital, social, and ecommerce touchpoints 

  • Ensure consistency and quality across all deliverables

Team & coaching responsibilities 

  • Act as a day-to-day lead for designers and copywriters within the content team  

  • Provide ongoing feedback and hands-on creative guidance  

  • Elevate the quality of output by coaching the team toward stronger craft and thinking  

  • Support team members in their personal growth and career development  

  • Help define growth paths together with the Creative Director  

  • Follow up on performance, motivation, and development needs  

Collaboration & impact 

  • Collaborate with strategists, marketers, and performance teams  

  • Contribute to pitches and new business with compelling creative  

  • Help build scalable brand systems that work across channels 

You don’t just make things look good you make teams and ideas perform better. 

Qualifications:

 

  • Perfect English speaking is a must, Dutch (and French) are a plus, big one

  • Proven experience as an Art Director in an agency or similar environment (5 years) 

  • Strong portfolio showing brand, campaign, and digital work 

  • Experience leading or mentoring designers and/or copywriters 

  • Ability to move from idea to concept and from concept to execution 

  • Experience with digital-first and ecommerce environments 

  • Eye for detail and strong sense of visual consistency 

And just as important: 

  • You enjoy helping others grow and get the best out of a team  

  • You give clear, constructive feedback and know how to motivate people  

  • You balance creative ambition with pragmatism  

  • You take ownership not just of the work, but of the people behind it 

Additional Information:

You’ll join a welcoming, driven team where collaboration and team spirit matter.

We make time to (de)connect, regular drinks and events are part of the culture.

Our Sint-Martens-Latem office was recently redesigned, with more outdoor space, informal meeting spots, and comfortable areas to recharge.

We support flexible working, while encouraging time together with the team because the best ideas don’t happen in isolation. 

You’ll work with leading brands across industries (Nestlé, Colruyt, Pierre Fabre, Jaguar Land Rover), making your work varied and impactful.

You’ll play a key role in the company and be recognized for it.

Your package includes an Apple laptop, company car, phone subscription, and everything you need to do your job well.

We invest in continuous growth through R&D time, training, events, seminars, mentoring, and regular knowledge sharing.

You’ll shape your own path, supported by regular feedback and development conversations.

As part of SQLI Group, you’ll connect with colleagues across the globe and learn from an international network.

  • Ownership of high-impact, cross-disciplinary projects
  • Exposure to international clients and teams
  • The opportunity to shape how delivery works at SQLI
  • A culture that values honesty, ownership, and collaboration

We keep things simpleand focused on what works.

Interested?

If you’re someone who brings structure, clarity, and momentum we should talk

positions.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Medical Technologist at Medpace Reference Laboratories for our haematology department. Due to our recent growth, we are in need of qualified and focused driven individuals, who play a pivotal role in research-based drug development within the pharmaceutical industry. You would have the unique opportunity to work on the laboratory side of the fast-paced medical world by conducting tests on blood, urine. If you have an analytical mind set, and enjoy working in a laboratory setting, this could be the opportunity for you!


Responsibilities

  • Perform low, moderate, and high-complexity testing following applicable Standard Operating Procedures  (SOPs)
  • Train on different sets of automated instrumentation to learn maintenance and troubleshooting skills
  • Perform necessary quality control procedures, properly evaluate and interpret quality control data, and implement and document corrective action as needed.
  • Perform documentation, and routine lab system operations.
  • Problem solve and work alongside our team of Medical Laboratory Scientists and PhD Scientists to develop and validate new tests and methods for routine and biomarker testing in our expanding laboratory
  • Keep track of inventory
  • Strictly adhere to safety procedures
  • Working in rotation schedule: Monday - Friday and Tuesday – Saturday.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Biomedical Laboratory Technology, option Medical Laboratory Technology and Certification by the National-level professional evaluation organization;
  • Basic knowledge of drug therapy techniques and medical terminology;
  • Experienced working with haematology and chemistry;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and good command of both written and spoken of English;
  • Able to work in a team environment with effective interpersonal skills and able to work independently;
  • Professional demeanor and strong work ethic;
  • Sense of responsibility and being studious;
  • Working accurate, solution-minded and handle stress with grace;
  • Previous experience in a haematology area is a plus; and
  • Working in rotation schedule: Monday - Friday and Tuesday – Saturday.

We kindly ask to send applications in English.

 

The position is open to Entry & Experienced candidates!


Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 6,000 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

People. Purpose. Passion. Make a Difference Tomorrow. Join Us Today.

 

The work we’ve done over the past 30+ years has positively impacted the lives of countless patients and families who face hundreds of diseases across all key therapeutic areas. The work we do today will improve the lives of people living with illness and disease in the future.

 

Medpace Perks

  • Flexible work environment 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package
  • Competitive PTO packages
  • Structured career paths with opportunities for professional growth
  • Company-sponsored employee appreciation events
  • Employee health and wellness initiatives

Awards

  • Recognized by Forbes as one of America's Most Successful Midsize Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024
  • Continually recognized with CRO Leadership Awards from Life Science Leader magazine based on expertise, quality, capabilities, reliability, and compatibility

 

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your qualifications and, if interested, you will be contacted with details for next steps.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Gezocht: een creative die o.a. de politie FML, putain en shit laat zeggen.

Functieomschrijving

Beste Art Director,

Wij houden het graag scherp. En liefst ook slim. Misschien niet wat je verwacht van een employer branding agency. Maar wel wat volgens ons nodig is.

Want laat ons eerlijk zijn: onze sector zit vol fluff. Buzzwords zoals teamwork, purpose en impact. Klinkt goed, maar zegt meestal weinig. Dan heb je gewoon een stockfoto met een holle lijn. Daar geloven wij niet in.

Dat vloeken hierboven? Niet om te choqueren (of toch niet alleen), maar omdat het de uitkomst was van een goed idee. Een sterke insight, goed doorvertaald. En plots zegt de politie iets wat je totaal niet verwacht. Dat is voor ons impact, zonder het woord te gebruiken. Check de case hier: https://fantastic.be/work/federale-politie-cybercriminelen

Dat is wat we hier doen: de lat telkens hoger leggen. En daarvoor zoeken we iemand nieuw.

Iemand die tegen feedback kan. Iemand die snapt dat een idee zelden goed is van de eerste keer. Dat ‘nog eens proberen’ vaak nodig is. En dat een one-shot stunt zelden genoeg is.

Want mensen veranderen niet van job door één campagne. Je bouwt ideeën. Je laat ze groeien. Tot ze beginnen te werken.

Voor wie? Voor verschillende mensen. Van IT-profielen die bezig zijn met Kubernetes en security, tot winkelmedewerkers bij Lidl. Andere wereld, andere taal, andere aanpak. Net dat maakt het interessant voor jou als creatief.

We noemen onszelf trouwens liever geen employer branding agency meer. Wel een employer communication agency. Minder sexy, wel juister.

Want we doen meer dan employer branding alleen. Ook change communication. Bedrijven die door verandering gaan: fusies, nieuwe strategieën, andere manieren van werken. En hoe je mensen daarin meekrijgt. Niet met slides, maar met ideeën.

Onze opdrachten zijn uitdagend. Je gaat je hoofd breken. En je gaat teruggestuurd worden naar de tekentafel, dat kan ik met zekerheid zeggen. Maar je krijgt ook kansen, en een team dat ervoor gaat zonder ellebogenwerk.

Als je graag verder gaat dan het zoveelste HR-verhaal, ga je je hier amuseren.
We verwachten uiteindelijk maar één ding: dat je de standaard niet accepteert.

Dus Ditch The Default. Solliciteer als Art Director.

Groeten,
Ken Callebaut
Creative Director & Partner

PS: Wij zitten zelf ook midden in change.
Dus saai wordt het sowieso niet. ;)

positions.descriptionHtml:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Laboratory Setting

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Position Overview:
As a Lab Technician I at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll contribute to advancing scientific discovery and enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As Lab Technician I You'll perform essential laboratory procedures including sample processing, testing, and analysis while maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety.

You'll handle biological specimens, prepare solutions, operate analytical instruments, and maintain detailed documentation of all procedures. This position offers hands-on experience in a laboratory environment where attention to detail and adherence to protocols is critical.

Main Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Performs, reviews, and interprets complex, esoteric, and routine chemical, hematological, coagulation, renal, lipid, and hormonal analyses by manual, automated, and/or microscopic means.

  • Integrates analytical results with specific and highly varied clinical trial protocols to evaluate credibility, appropriateness and accuracy of test results in order to facilitate entry or exclusion of subjects from research programs.

  • Operates, maintains, troubleshoots and repairs clinical laboratory equipment, including routine preventative maintenance, calibrations, and safety checks.

  • Recognizes and pursues instrument problems and resolutions.

  • Evaluates analytical reagents, calibrators, and QC standards to ensure the accuracy of analytical results.

  • Evaluates quality control procedures, evaluates results, and implements corrective action when indicated.

  • Assists in carrying out ongoing statistical data analysis to detect trends and problems and undertakes corrective action.

Required Education & Experience:

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 0 to 2 years’).

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification in the following Preferred Fields of Study: Biological Sciences, Chemistry, or related field.

  • Relevant certifications in laboratory techniques.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of laboratory safety protocols and aseptic techniques

  • Proficiency in handling and processing biological specimens and hazardous materials

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation

  • Experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) preferred

  • Ability to operate standard laboratory equipment and analytical instruments

  • Good computer skills including Microsoft Office applications

  • Strong organizational and time management abilities to handle multiple tasks

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Physical ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work in temperature-controlled environments

  • Ability to work with hazardous materials and wear required PPE

  • Availability for overtime or alternate shifts as needed

  • Knowledge of GMP/GLP practices preferred

  • Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive tasks

  • May require working in cold environments with exposure to dry ice and liquid nitrogen

  • Must follow all safety protocols and maintain a clean, organized workspace

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Als Social Content Creative ben jij een creatieve storyteller die er als eerste bij is om social trends te spotten, en deze door te vertalen naar content met impact. Je bedenkt sterke social first concepten, presenteert je ideeën overtuigend en - nog belangrijker - maakt zelf de allerlekkerste content.

Wat je gaat doen

Met de 2-3 jaar werkervaring die je bij een bureau of merk hebt opgedaan weet je hoe je visual hooks inzet, een camera optimaal gebruikt en met slimme edits verhalen nóg krachtiger overbrengt. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het maken van social content op TikTok en Instagram, en werk je nauw samen met onze Social Brand & Activation Manager en andere creatieven. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Maken van scroll-stopping content voor Crisp op TikTok en Instagram – van idee tot uitvoering.

  • Spotten en vertalen van trends naar creatieve, on-brand social content.

  • In de rol kruipen van social reporter, in de video’s die je bedenkt en creëert.

  • Regisseren en creëren van stories, reels en statics, zowel voor als achter de camera.

  • Samenwerken met de Social & Brand Activation Manager om de food community verrassen en inspireren.

  • Inspelen op de actualiteit en zorgen dat Crisp opvalt binnen de social community.

  • Vertalen van 360 campagnes naar een social concept en uitwerking.

  • Schrijven van scherpe en pakkende teksten zodat we weten op te vallen op het platform, is een pre.

  • Deel uitmaken van ons creatieve team en rapporteren aan de Creative Director.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt 2-3 jaar werkervaring als (Social) Content Creative bij een (creatief) bureau of merk.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je hebt skills in filmen en editen van social videos, met oog voor kwaliteit, belichting en framing.

  • Je kunt snel schakelen - en ideeën bedenken die campagnes verdienen.

  • Je hebt een TikTok- en Instagram-schermtijd waar je je bijna voor zou schamen, maar waarmee je als eerste de nieuwste trends spot.

  • Je hebt werk gemaakt dat een bewezen succes was op de socials.

  • Je bent handig met Adobe Creative Suite en in-app editing tools zoals CapCut en Reels Editor.

  • Je houdt van eten en voelt je thuis in de keuken, maar hoeft geen keukenprins(es) te zijn.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Shape the digital face of an innovative wearable brand. Creative freedom, close collaboration, and the chance to build something award-worthy.

Job description

About NOWATCH

NOWATCH is an Amsterdam-based health innovation company for the curious. By blending cutting-edge technology with the leading science around mental health, we explore the frontiers of wellbeing. NOWATCH pioneers in the wearable market with new algorithms and sensors. Our hardware and software solution is part of a large and growing wearable industry.

Why Creative Developer?

We don’t believe in the hard line between design and development anymore. With AI accelerating the way we write code, the real differentiator is no longer technical output alone — it’s creative vision, taste, and the ability to think across disciplines.

We’re looking for a T-shaped creative who can concept in Figma over morning coffee and ship production code by the afternoon. Someone who sees design and engineering as one continuous workflow, not two separate handoffs.

The Role

As our Creative Developer, you'll own our headless e-commerce platform (Next.js on Shopify) and shape the digital brand experience that lives on it. You won't just implement designs — you'll influence them. From campaign landing pages to product storytelling, micro-interactions to conversion experiments, you'll be involved from concept to code.

This is a startup. You’ll wear multiple hats, move fast, and have an outsized impact on how the world experiences NOWATCH online.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build pages, components, and interactions for our headless Shopify webshop (Next.js + Tailwind CSS)

  • Move fluidly between Figma and code — concepting, prototyping, and shipping within the same workflow

  • Create animations, micro-interactions, and motion design that bring our brand story to life on the web

  • Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, product launches, and conversion experiments

  • Use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate your workflow and push the boundaries of what you can build

  • Maintain code quality and design consistency while iterating fast based on data and feedback

  • Help shape the visual direction of our digital presence alongside the broader creative team

Job requirements

Must-haves

  • A portfolio that shows both design thinking and front-end craftsmanship — we want to see your eye, not just your code

  • Proven experience building with Next.js and modern React

  • Comfort working with Shopify’s headless commerce architecture (Storefront API, Liquid awareness is a plus)

  • Strong sense of typography, layout, spacing, and visual hierarchy

  • Experience implementing animations and motion design on the web (Framer Motion, GSAP, CSS animations)

  • Ability to translate brand strategy and marketing briefs into compelling digital experiences

  • A growth mindset — you care about conversion, performance, and user experience as much as aesthetics

  • Fluency with AI-assisted development — you already use tools like Claude Code or Cursor in your daily work and aren’t afraid to experiment with new ones

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with WebGL, Three.js, or Spline for immersive 3D web experiences

  • Background working at a startup, agency, or in e-commerce

  • Familiarity with Figma’s developer mode and design-to-code workflows

  • Interest in creative coding, generative design, or interactive storytelling

Please note: candidates must have the legal right to work in the Netherlands without requiring visa sponsorship.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Job description

Why this role exists

At Cortena, we're building the AI execution layer for finance operations in SMEs. We have paying clients, real workflows running in production, and a product that is evolving fast — which means there is always something worth telling the market about, and never enough hands to tell it well.

Reach today is fragmented. Outreach lives in one tool, social in another, newsletters somewhere else, events in someone's calendar. Each channel works in isolation, but the story across them is inconsistent and a lot of it runs manually. Your job is to make our growth engine run — automate the repetitive outreach, keep our channels alive with content people actually want to read, and turn our events and partnerships into reach we can compound.

You bridge creative (what we say and how it looks) and systems (how it gets sent, tracked, and repeated). You will work directly with our founding team, own real channels from day one, and have your work in front of clients, investors, and partners every week.

This is not a content-calendar-filling role. You will have real ownership from day one.

What you will do

Outreach & automation (core)

  • Own outbound systems: set up and maintain outreach automations (sequences, enrichment, follow-ups) so the right people hear from us without manual sending every time.

  • Keep the pipeline clean: manage lists, segments, and CRM hygiene so campaigns target the right audience and we can actually measure what works.

  • Build repeatable flows: wire up tools (automation platforms, AI, CRM) so a campaign or sequence can be relaunched in minutes, not rebuilt from scratch.

  • Measure and iterate: track open / reply / conversion rates, flag what's underperforming, and improve copy and targeting based on real numbers.

Content & awareness

  • Plan and produce social and awareness content across LinkedIn and Instagram — written for each platform, not copy-pasted between them.

  • Write and ship our newsletter: shape the angle, draft it, keep it on a rhythm people can rely on.

  • Repurpose existing material (talks, podcast episodes, event recaps) into multiple formats so one piece of work earns reach many times.

  • Keep our brand voice consistent and recognizable across everything that goes out.

Events, webinars & partnerships

  • Help plan and run partnership events and webinars — from concept and guest outreach to promotion and follow-up.

  • Coordinate with partners and co-hosts so joint formats actually happen and both sides get reach out of them.

  • Turn every event into content: recaps, clips, posts, and follow-up sequences that keep the momentum after the room empties.

  • Track what each format returns (signups, attendance, leads) and feed that back into what we run next.

Job requirements

What we are looking for

Must-have

positions.title: PROCESSING TECHNOLOGIST - CONDIMENTS
positions.description:
We are recruiting a Processing Technologist for the R&D Foods - GDC Condiments, located at HIVE, Wageningen, The Netherlands.

The role reports into the Processing Lead Condiments. 

The Processing Technologist is responsible for R&D activities related to process development for new cutting edge technologies and innovation, enabling the design of globally superior products for our fast-growing brands. These process development activities include pilot plant trials planning and execution, analyzing data, drawing technically supported conclusions and presenting results. Supporting other teams and projects with process knowledge and on trials execution is also part of this role.

JOB SUMMARY
• Process development: establish appropriate process technology, either existing or new in partnership with processing team for manufacturing a product to specification at lab-scale and pilot-scale.
• Process scale-up: partner with processing team to establish technology developed at pilot-scale to enable commercial production and factory trials
• Product Development: New product development via translating ideas first into lab and pilot scale prototypes to finally scalable, cost-effective, shelf stable recipes and core design blocks in line with technical insights, consumer expectations and nutrition, regulatory and IP guidelines.
• Design of Experiments (DOE): Develop an experimental plan in consultation with the TPL or WL and conduct firsthand experiments in kitchens, laboratories and the pilot plant, analytical tests and measurements, application in ways of product consumption to draw inferences.
• Data Analysis: Conduct a thorough analysis of the data derived through the DOE, build on the inferences drawn from the experiments and plan future course of action.
• Product characterization: use appropriate measurement techniques to characterize key attributes of the product, using either existing or developing new techniques in partnership with Analytical team or external labs. 

KEY REQUIREMENTS
The Process Technologist is expected to have: 

Professional Skills
• (Foods) Product and process development
• Knowledge or hands-on experience on process basic unit operations (emulsification, mixing, heating, pumping, etc.)
• Building and executing experimental plans
• Conducting standard food analytical measurements
• Data analysis, assessments, and technical reporting
• Working knowledge on MS Office – Excel, PowerPoint for data analysis, visualization, and presentation.
• Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
Plus skills
• Food science and technology knowledge
• Basics of product and design safety in processed foods
• Basic awareness on commercial aspects of business, finance, marketing, regulatory and legal.
• Basic awareness on project management and agile WoW and tools.
Personal Skills
• Ability to seek, mine and process information from internal and external sources.
• Confidence in making presentations, demos and sharing the output of their work with others.
• Excellent team player with the right aptitude for working in a multi-cultural / global environment & with strong communication skills.

EXPERIENCE YOU SHOULD HAVE
• Professional technical education (minimum MBO 4, depending on subject and previous experiences), preferably HBO degree in the fields of Processing, Chemical Engineering, Food Science or related areas. 
• Previous experience of working on food ingredients and food matrices as well as process development of food products is a plus.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Job description

Channext is looking for a Creative Content Intern to support our Agency team with B2B content creation, campaign execution and day-to-day marketing activities. You’ll assist with content strategy and copywriting, working to deadlines to keep projects on track, and contribute to team reviews and reporting, helping us deliver seamless, high-quality campaigns with prominent tech clients such as Microsoft, Barco and Lenovo. The role is based in our central Utrecht office, with some flexibility to work from home.

About the job
You’ll support the execution of high-impact partner channel marketing content across our channels. You’ll help write and schedule campaign content, keep timelines moving, and ensure our messaging is polished, consistent and ready to go live. 

You’ll work with tools like the Google Workspace suite, ClickUp to prepare campaign materials, manage schedules, and support reporting. You’ll use the Channext platform to help coordinate and distribute campaign content. You’ll contribute to reporting and presentations by gathering insights that help the team make strategic content decisions. You’ll collaborate closely with a fast-moving, creative team, offering fresh perspectives during review cycles while also working within client expectations, brand guidelines and campaign structures.

Things move quickly, so you’ll need to be organised, proactive, detail-oriented and ready to adapt as priorities shift.

What you’ll do

  • Familiarise yourself with our client brands, messaging and campaign goals.

  • Support our Content Account Manager to develop client strategies for upcoming campaigns

  • Assist with copywriting and campaign creative direction aligning with client expectations

  • Help turn complex B2B and technology messaging into clear, concise and audience-ready content

  • Support with social content scheduling, helping the team plan and prepare posts across our channels

  • Assist in keeping an eye on social timelines and deliverables, making sure everything is moving along as expected

  • Work with translation tools and freelancers to seamlessly localise the campaigns for multiple markets

  • Help proofread content to ensure it’s accurate and ready to go live

  • Contribute to marketing reporting and presentations by gathering insights and supporting the team with preparation

  • Offer input during creative review cycles, sharing fresh perspectives and helping the team refine ideas

  • Learn how to work with agility in the Channext platform

Job requirements

Who you are

  • Some experience with writing, editing or adapting marketing content, ideally for social media, B2B, technology, SaaS or partner marketing. Able to turn complex information into clear, concise and polished campaign material.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working across multiple platforms and tools and trying new technologies and curious about how to optimise the way you work.

  • Ambition to work in digital marketing, content production and copy creation.

  • Proactive attitude and ability to work independently within a hybrid team setup.

  • Comfortable working with structured feedback from clients, internal teams and campaign briefs.

  • Available for a full-time internship starting in August (40 hours per week) for a minimum of 5 months

Why Channext?

  • A fast-growing scale-up with worldwide ambitions. The perfect place to develop yourself and kickstart your career!

  • Exposure to social media strategy, B2B campaign execution, and a high growth scale-up environment

  • Joining Channext means becoming part of a passionate community. You'll be surrounded by like-minded individuals who are committed to making a difference and driving success. Together, we'll celebrate achievements, support each other, and create a positive and uplifting work environment.

  • An internship compensation of €500 per month (based on a 40-hour week)

  • Hybrid working: Collaborating at our Utrecht office Mon, Wed and Fri and hybrid working days available Tuesday and Thursday

  • Healthy lunches when working from the office

  • Monthly team activities and annual company offsite

positions.descriptionHtml:
Brand, Marketing & Communications – Creative Studio

Duration: 20-25 weeks, starting 1 September 2026

We’re looking for an enthusiastic and hands-on Creative Design Intern to join our Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC) department. This is a Meewerkstage (hands-on internship). This is an opportunity to grow your design skills in a fast-paced, creative environment, working on real projects for one of the most recognisable brands in the Netherlands. If you’re passionate about visual storytelling, digital design, and bringing ideas to life through strong visuals, this internship will give you hands-on experience with a wide variety of creative productions, based on ING’s brand identity.

About the Opportunity

The Creative Studio develops high-quality creative content for ING’s internal and external audiences. From digital ads and social designs to motion graphics, video content, and presentation materials, the studio plays a key role in shaping the brand experience.

As an intern, you will work with the creative team on translating briefs into clear, engaging, and on-brand visual content across different, mostly digital channels.

Roles and Responsibilities

Design & Content Creation

  • Collaborate with the team on creating visuals for social media, online campaigns, presentations, and internal communications.
  • Work on image editing, retouching, layout design, and visual storytelling.
  • Support the development of simple motion graphics or video edits.
  • Prepare visual assets for various platforms and formats.

Creative Development & Brand Support

  • Help brainstorm and develop creative concepts based on creative briefs.
  • Participate in ideation sessions and contribute fresh ideas.
  • Work closely with copywriters, videographers, producers, and designers to deliver on-brand content.

What You Will Learn

  • How to design within a large global brand environment.
  • How creative workflows are managed within a professional studio.
  • How to adapt design work for different channels and audiences.
  • How to present, revise, and deliver design work professionally.

Objectives

By the end of your internship, you will:

  • Understand how a Creative Studio collaborates within a Brand, Marketing & Communications department.
  • Feel confident delivering creative productions in a professional setting.
  • Be able to create on-brand visual content.

How to Succeed

We value creativity, curiosity, and initiative. You’ll be encouraged to develop your skills with support from the team.

Preferred background:

  • Enrolled at a Dutch HBO or university in the area of Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Creative Business, Media, or similar.
  • Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects.
  • Bonus: familiarity with Figma.
  • Strong eye for layout, colour, imagery, and visual storytelling.
  • Eager to learn.

Rewards and benefits
This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.
 
You’ll also benefit from:

  • Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on 36 hours work week

  • Your own work laptop

  • Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation

  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities

  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

 
During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).
 
Questions?
Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.
 
About our internships
Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).
Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.

- Enrolled at a Dutch HBO or university in the area of Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Creative Business, Media, or similar.
- Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects.
- Bonus: familiarity with Figma.
- Strong eye for layout, colour, imagery, and visual storytelling.
- Eager to learn.
Rewards and benefits
This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.
 
You’ll also benefit from:

- Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on 36 hours work week
- Your own work laptop
- Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
- Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
- An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).
 
Questions?
Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.
 
About our internships
Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).
Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.

We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.

We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Binnen ons kantoor in Eindhoven zijn wij het creatieteam dat digitale campagnes nét dat beetje extra geeft. We mixen media, creativiteit en technologie om ideeën te maken die opvallen, raken en blijven hangen. Geen standaard banners of vluchtige clicks, maar slimme, opvallende en vaak verrassende creaties die écht aandacht trekken. Van interactieve formats tot dynamische campagnes: we zorgen dat merken niet alleen zichtbaar zijn, maar ook een glimlach, klik of wow-moment verdienen. Kortom, wij maken digitale media leuker, slimmer en effectiever.
De rol: (Medior) Creative Developer
Of moeten we zeggen: Javascript Developer? Front-end Developer? Hoe dan ook, wij zoeken voor ons team in Eindhoven een veelzijdige kracht met gevoel voor code én oog voor animatie en gebruiksvriendelijkheid. Iemand die al wat meters gemaakt heeft en collega’s kan inspireren om het onderste uit de kan te halen.

Als Medior Creative Developer ga je aan de slag met de digitale campagnes voor grote merken. Jij bent degene die storyboards tot leven laat komen met code, met interactie en animatie campagnes verrijkt, interne tools uit de grond stampt en de meest eye-catching Digital Out of Home (DOOH) uitingen maakt.
Als onderdeel van een van onze klantenteams werk je mee aan online display campagnes voor grote internationale merken als Odido, Audi, Kruidvat, Volkswagen, Porsche, KPN, NS en Action. Daarbij gebruik je ‘every trick in the book’ op het gebied van GSAP, Javascript, jQuery, HTML en CSS. Maar als de opdracht erom vraagt, durf je dit boekje ook aan de kant te gooien. Verder spot je kansen om processen te optimaliseren en bouw je tools of koppelingen om ons werk makkelijker en effectiever te maken.
Wat ga je doen?

Display ads ontwikkelen in Visual Studio Code met behulp van onze intern ontwikkelde extensie.
Aan de slag met ons dynamische content platform binnen WPP Open: “Creative Optimizations”.
In een team met projectmanagers, designers, motion artists, creative leads en creative developers bouwen aan campagnes voor grote klanten.
Snel schakelen en kortlopende projecten oppakken.
Werken aan interne tools ten behoeve van efficiëntie en innovatie.
AI integreren in je dagelijkse workflow (je krijgt toegang tot de nieuwste AI-modellen).

Wie ben jij?

Een enthousiaste Creative Developer of Front-end Developer met minimaal 3+ jaar ervaring in rollen die draaien om front-end of creative development.
Uitgebreide ervaring met Javascript (ES6).
Basiskennis van het Adobe Creative Cloud pakket (o.a. Photoshop, Illustrator).
Je benadert uitdagingen frontaal en met creativiteit.
Innovatie staat bij jou hoog in het vaandel.
Je bent een sociale teamplayer die ook buiten de eigen kaders durft te denken.
Je kunt je ideeën goed overbrengen op anderen en bent niet bang om tijdelijk andere teams uit te helpen.
Je bent gestructureerd, oplossingsgericht en hebt gevoel voor animatie en timing.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend.

Pré's:

Bekend met Git en Gitflow.
Ervaring met Google Sheets (en scripts).
Je bent bekend met Visual Studio Code.
Ervaring met GSAP (of een vergelijkbare animatie-library).
Je weet de weg binnen online marketing.
Werkervaring met een front-end framework (React, Vue, Angular, etc.).
Ervaring met AI Coding agents.

Wat bieden wij?

Flexibiliteit: Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).
Groeikansen: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team.
Salaris: € 3065 - € 4250 (op basis van 38,75 uur per week) en afhankelijk van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit. 
Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.
Mental Wellbeing: Toegang tot het platform Tellus.
Reiskostenvergoeding: Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.
Vakantie: 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).
Hybrid Working allowance: €30 netto per maand bij fulltime.
Bring Your Own Device (BYOD): Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto.
Alleo benefits: Via onze samenwerking met Alleo ontvang je maandelijks €10 persoonlijk budget dat je kunt besteden aan voordelen die passen bij jouw lifestyle en welzijn.
Lunchfaciliteiten: Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.
Zorgverzekering: Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering.

Waarom is dit jouw nieuwe baan?
Omdat geen dag hetzelfde is. Het ene moment schrijf je App scripts voor Google Sheets automatisering, het volgende moment ben je met een designer bezig om een storyboard te fine-tunen of een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen in de regio Eindhoven, waardoor je continu leert en groeit.Herken jij jezelf in dit profiel? Solliciteer direct via de knop hieronder!

positions.descriptionHtml:
Do you want to be part of our team? Join our Food Application Team in Bakel. We are investing in strengthening our capabilities to further accelerate growth. A key pillar of this strategy is delivering deep food application expertise, enabling our customers to produce high-quality, safe, and sustainable food in an efficient and reliable way. To support this ambition, we are looking for a Food Application Technologist

Responsibilities / Tasks

As a Food Application Technologist, you play a key role in supporting and advising customers on food processing applications. Your focus lies on further processing, preparation, and marination within segments such as meat, fish, and plant-based products. You will start as a broadly oriented generalist and gradually develop into a specialist within one of these focus areas. Most of your work will take place on-site at customer locations or via remote support, with occasional activities at our Technology Centre in Bakel.

Roles and responsibilities:                              

  • Act as a technical application expert and helpdesk, supporting customers with questions on processing, preparation, and marination equipment.

  • Translate production requirements into optimal process parameters, combining technical insight with hands-on process knowledge.

  • Analyze production results and communicate insights clearly to customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the sharing and development of application knowledge within your team and across the wider organization.

  • Advise customers on food safety, hygiene (HACCP / hygienic design), efficiency, and yield optimization.

  • Take a proactive role in innovation and development projects, supporting improvements in processes and products.

  • Support the sales organization by identifying opportunities and generating leads.

  • Act as a trusted partner and ambassador at customer sites.

Your Profile / Qualifications

  • Bachelor, higher education in food technology or knowledge by experience in Food Application (5+ years’ experience in relevant food manufacturing environment).

  • Willing to learn; hands-on mentality. Basic technical knowledge (mechanical) to be able to adjust machine setups.

  • The job requires regular frequent international travel to our customers.

  • Since travelling is big part of the job, base location is less important.

  • Excellent reporting and communication skills to customers and other stakeholders, self-supporting team player.

  • Fluency in English is required; additional languages are a plus.

Our offer:

  • Challenging position within a large international organisation

  • Competitive salary with 8% holiday pay

  • 25 days' holiday and 13 ATV days based on full-time employment (CLA)

  • Travel allowance

  • Contribution towards a gym membership

  • A position within a company with many opportunities for advancement

Our Values

At GEA we stand for Responsibility, Integrity, Diversity, Passion and Excellence. If you share the same values, we would like to hear from you. We will consider all equal and we welcome all applications.

What happens once your application is submitted?

You will receive an email l when your application has been processed. One of our Talent Acquisition Partners will review and verify that the applicant meets the qualifications criteria. Once your application has been successful verified and depending on the role you will be invited to a first interview either virtual or face to face. Usually after the second or third interview round we will make a decision.

Did we spark your interest?

Do you want to be part of our team? Join our Food Application Team in Bakel. We are investing in strengthening our capabilities to further accelerate growth. A key pillar of this strategy is delivering deep food application expertise, enabling our customers to produce high-quality, safe, and sustainable food in an efficient and reliable way. To support this ambition, we are looking for a Food Application TechnologistResponsibilities / Tasks

As a Food Application Technologist, you play a key role in supporting and advising customers on food processing applications. Your focus lies on further processing, preparation, and marination within segments such as meat, fish, and plant-based products. You will start as a broadly oriented generalist and gradually develop into a specialist within one of these focus areas. Most of your work will take place on-site at customer locations or via remote support, with occasional activities at our Technology Centre in Bakel.

Roles and responsibilities:

- Act as a technical application expert and helpdesk, supporting customers with questions on processing, preparation, and marination equipment.
- Translate production requirements into optimal process parameters, combining technical insight with hands-on process knowledge.
- Analyze production results and communicate insights clearly to customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.
- Contribute to the sharing and development of application knowledge within your team and across the wider organization.
- Advise customers on food safety, hygiene (HACCP / hygienic design), efficiency, and yield optimization.
- Take a proactive role in innovation and development projects, supporting improvements in processes and products.
- Support the sales organization by identifying opportunities and generating leads.
- Act as a trusted partner and ambassador at customer sites.
Your Profile / Qualifications

- Bachelor, higher education in food technology or knowledge by experience in Food Application (5+ years’ experience in relevant food manufacturing environment).
- Willing to learn; hands-on mentality. Basic technical knowledge (mechanical) to be able to adjust machine setups.
- The job requires regular frequent international travel to our customers.
- Since travelling is big part of the job, base location is less important.
- Excellent reporting and communication skills to customers and other stakeholders, self-supporting team player.
- Fluency in English is required; additional languages are a plus.
Our offer:

- Challenging position within a large international organisation
- Competitive salary with 8% holiday pay
- 25 days' holiday and 13 ATV days based on full-time employment (CLA)
- Travel allowance
- Contribution towards a gym membership
- A position within a company with many opportunities for advancement
Our Values

At GEA we stand for Responsibility, Integrity, Diversity, Passion and Excellence. If you share the same values, we would like to hear from you. We will consider all equal and we welcome all applications.

What happens once your application is submitted?

You will receive an email l when your application has been processed. One of our Talent Acquisition Partners will review and verify that the applicant meets the qualifications criteria. Once your application has been successful verified and depending on the role you will be invited to a first interview either virtual or face to face. Usually after the second or third interview round we will make a decision.
