Company Description:

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in transformation and innovation through technology. Present across five continents and in 21 countries, our Great Place to Work–certified group brings together more than 7,000 consultants. We support major organizations in navigating complex digital transformations.

In Belgium and internationally, Talan advises and supports companies and public institutions in delivering their transformation and innovation projects. The group expects to reach €600 million in revenue in 2024 and aims to exceed €1 billion in revenue by 2026.

At the heart of our strategy is our SAP Center of Excellence. We position ourselves as the partner of choice for designing, deploying, and optimizing the entire SAP suite :

  • S/4HANA Migrations & RISE with SAP: We guide our clients through their transition to the "Intelligent Enterprise," securing the move to S/4HANA and leveraging the full potential of the RISE with SAP offering.
  • Business Solutions: We hold recognized expertise in critical modules, including Finance (FI/CO), Logistics, and Human Capital Management via SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Cutting-edge Data & Analytics: We master modern data architectures through deep expertise in SAP Datasphere, BW/4HANA, and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
  • Cloud Innovation: We integrate AI and Data Intelligence within the SAP environment to transform data into a true performance lever.

In this context, we are looking for a SAP S/4HANA Functional Analyst & Developer Consultant to join Talan. 

 

Job Description:

We are seeking a talented SAP S/4HANA Functional Analyst & Developer to join our team and support SAP S/4HANA implementation, enhancement, and migrations (ECC to S/4HANA) while ensuring system longevity through a Cloud-First and Clean Core approach In this role, you will bridge business requirements and technical solutions, ensuring that SAP applications deliver maximum value and meet evolving business needs.

Key Responsibilities : 

  • Clean Core Architecture & Development: Design and implement "Upgrade-stable" extensions using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for Side-by-Side developments and ABAP Cloud for On-Stack extensibility.
  • Code Modernization: Transform legacy custom developments (Z) from ECC into modern models such as RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model) and CAP (Cloud Application Programming) to maintain a clean core.
  • Functional Analysis & Fit-to-Standard: Lead workshops to align business requirements with SAP best practices , prioritizing standard features to minimize technical debt.
  • Cloud Migration: Support the transition to S/4HANA (Public or Private Cloud) by ensuring data mapping and flow integrity via SAP Datasphere or SAP Integration Suite.
  • Configuration & Deployment: Configure critical modules (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, IS-U) while ensuring seamless integration with Cloud solutions such as SuccessFactors or Ariba.
  • User Experience (UX): Develop intuitive interfaces via SAP Fiori/UI5 and Low-Code/No-Code tools (SAP Build) to accelerate user adoption
  • Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain SAP applications, ensuring performance, security, and adherence to best practices.
  • Document functional specifications, technical designs, migration procedures, and end-user guides.
  • Participate in workshops, user acceptance testing (UAT), and change management activities to ensure smooth adoption.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in SAP S/4HANA functional analysis and development.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP ECC → S/4HANA migrations.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, IS-U) and S/4HANA architecture.
  • Proficiency in ABAP Cloud, CDS Views, Fiori/UI5, and a solid understanding of S/4HANA architecture.
  • Deep understanding of Cloud migration strategies (RISE with SAP) and the SAP Activate methodology.
  • Analytical mindset, problem-solving skills, and excellent communication with business stakeholders.
  • Professional proficiency in English and French (written and spoken); Dutch is a plus.
Additional Information:

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • At least one of Business SAP Certification on S/4HANA Cloud (FI, HCM,…)
  • Hands-on knowledge of SAP Build.
  • Familiarity with SAP integration with non-SAP systems.
  • Experience with Agile / Scrum in SAP projects.
  • Knowledge of integration with non-SAP systems via API Management. (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Why Join Us

  • Participate in high-impact SAP S/4HANA and ECC → S/4HANA migration projects that transform business operations.
  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team of experts across Europe and internationally.
  • Work with cutting-edge SAP technologies and methodologies.
  • Contribute to an organization committed to innovation, professional growth, and sustainability.

  • You’re comfortable in understanding complex environments and are willing to learn/invest in it

We are looking for a Web Developer (Python/CSS).

What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain a front-end web application (AskNRA) used for IP database reporting across multiple NATO security domains.

  • Build and implement modular, high-quality user interfaces using Python, CSS, and related technologies.

  • Ensure development follows strict constraints, avoiding third-party CDNs or unapproved external packages, relying only on NATO-approved libraries.

  • Participate in Agile sprint cycles, including sprint planning, execution, review, and reporting.

  • Support weekly in-person coordination meetings, workshops, and status reviews.

  • Deliver sprint reports and maintain accurate technical documentation aligned with configuration management practices.

  • Develop and enhance key application features such as responsive web pages, interactive dashboards, real-time data streaming, email integration, file upload functionality, and PDF generation.

  • Support data comparison activities (exception reports) and assist with integration and maintenance tasks.

  • Work closely with Service Delivery Managers and contribute to continuous improvement of development processes.

  • Ensure high-quality code delivery aligned with project standards and operational requirements.

What you will need to bring:

  • Strong experience (minimum 4 years) in developing WSGI-based web applications using Python and Flask.

  • Solid knowledge of Flask Blueprints, Jinja2, CSS (Bootstrap), JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, and SQLite.

  • Good understanding of frontend modularity, maintainability, and interface documentation best practices.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams and Agile environments.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and focused on delivering high-quality results.

  • Knowledge of NATO structures and working environments is considered an asset.

New Business Developer (NBD) for small & medium T&D Businesses is a key role in NIQ’s growth strategy. Focused on accelerating organic growth, the NBD generates short-cycle revenue opportunities by contacting leads & prospects, growing business within the own client portfolio and contribute in the longer-cycle revenue processes to win the key prospects not working with NIQ for their insights based on trended sales data. 

 

Responsibilities 

As a New Business Developer,

You will : 

  • own, meet and ‘smash’ the individual revenue target (forecast and report out of targets and budgets); 

  • target new clients via different channels and grow the business within the existing client portfolio, prioritize client visits based on sales potential and build a sustainable external network; 

  • identify upselling opportunities by creating leads for retail measurement data and more advanced / customized NIQ services enabling to transform ad-hoc relationships into continuous partnerships; 

  • execute end-to-end sales process from feasibility analysis; including and pricing, negotiating terms, writing proposals, and closing the sale; 

  • monitor progress against revenue target with tenacity and course correct quickly where necessary by making maximum use of the available CRM tools; 

  • utilize with creativity the tools available within the wider organization to generate leads and build your internal network; 

  • develop pragmatic engagement plans for the key prospects & clients in your portfolio; 

  • ensure that all sales materials, including proposals, software- & service demos are consistent and demonstrate best in class within the industry; 

  • initiate & drive projects to bring new product /market combination successfully to  

  • the market; 

  • work with other NIQ departments to ensure alignment and buy-in. 

A little bit more about you

Qualifications

Are you a high-energy self-starter, curious, passionate about sales, growth, building relationships and new business opportunities? 

Do you enjoy contributing to the great T&D Sales Team result by having individual impact to make the difference? 

 

Our new team member will have: 

  • good understanding of the dynamics of the Belgian T&D business; 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree; 

  • proven sales experience, with strong commercial and relationship management skills; 

  • experience gained in Market Research and/or T&D Trade/Category management is a plus but not mandatory; 

  • familiar with the specs and usage of retail tracking business services within the market; 

  • skillful in driving client interest and new business through creative proposal- and solution creation resulting in high client satisfaction level; 

  • easy connecting with (potential) clients and ability to build and maintain own network among assigned clients & prospects; 

  • both short-term and long-term results oriented; 

  • excellent communication skills, ability to read other’s styles and adapt behavior accordingly; 

  • language requirements: Dutch, English, French ideally but at least 2 of these ones. 

 

What we offer

       35 400 to 50 000 gross per year. This role might also be eligible for a sales-based incentive or performance-based bonus

Placement within the range will depend on objective criteria including experience, skills, and internal equity considerations. We are committed to equal pay and pay transparency. Remuneration decisions are made using gender-neutral and objective criteria.

positions.title: Integration Developer (Zedelgem, BE, 8210)
positions.description:
Kom werken bij Cebeo, de NR1 in elektrotechnisch materiaal en oplossingen!

Cebeo is veel meer dan een distributeur van elektrotechnisch materiaal. We zijn de NR1 partner voor professionele installateurs en bedrijven in heel België. 
Met een uitgebreid aanbod van innovatieve oplossingen en diensten bedienen we verschillende sectoren en zetten we de klant altijd centraal. Als onderdeel van de internationale Sonepar Group combineren we wereldwijde expertise met een persoonlijke, lokale aanpak.

Ontdek jouw toekomstige job
Heb je een passie voor integraties tussen verschillende applicaties? Ben jij sterk in het vertalen van architectuur- en businessnoden naar technische oplossingen? Zeggen Azure Integration Services en/of Dell Boomi jou iets?
 
Dan ben jij misschien de Integration Developer die wij zoeken om ons IT-team te versterken!
 
Binnen ons hoofdkantoor te Waregem, onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Team Lead Integrations, beheer je de integraties tussen de applicaties van Cebeo en Sonepar België. Daarnaast sta je ook in voor de EDI-integraties met klanten en leveranciers.
 
Als Integration Developer (M/V/X) zal dit jouw missie zijn:

Integratieontwikkeling: Je implementeert gedetailleerde en op maat gemaakte integratieprocessen.
Testing: Je voert integratietesten uit en ondersteunt tijdens gebruikersacceptatietesten (UAT).
Lifecycle management: Je beheert interne en externe integraties over hun volledige levenscyclus – van concept en development tot onderhoud en uitfasering.
Project & onderhoud: Je schakelt vlot tussen verschillende integratieprojecten en onderhoudsopdrachten.

Jouw profiel

Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring binnen integraties en/of technische oplossingen, bij voorkeur met Azure Integration Services, Dell Boomi of gelijkaardige platformen.
Je hebt een goede kennis van standaard businessapplicaties (CRM, ERP, WMS, …) en businessprocessen (aankoop, verkoop, transport, …).
Je bent leergierig en past je snel aan binnen verschillende projectteams.
Je hebt een sterke teamgeest en werkt gestructureerd en oplossingsgericht.
 
Wat mag je als NR1 bij Cebeo verwachten?

Vast contract
Fulltime 39 uur per week
Competitief loon
20 vakantiedagen en 6 ADV-dagen
Eindejaarspremie
Vakantiegeld
Mogelijkheid tot instappen in een voordelige DKV-hospitalisatieverzekering
Groepsverzekering
Jaarlijkse sectorpremie
Maaltijdcheques
Fietslease optie
Benefits@Work
Opleidingsmogelijkheden en interne mobiliteit

Waarom kiezen voor Cebeo?
Bij Cebeo, een familiebedrijf sinds 1922, staan we met duizend op NR1 en zijn diversiteit en inclusie essentiële bouwstenen van onze bedrijfsstrategie. We zetten al onze 1000 medewerkers op de eerste plaats, want zij zijn de belangrijkste schakels van ons bedrijf. Als familiebedrijf zetten we ons in voor een duurzame toekomst en zorg voor onze planeet. We creëren een veilige, gezonde, warme en respectvolle werkomgeving waar iedereen kan groeien als een NR1.
Sluit je aan bij Cebeo en word een NR1!
Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Dan kan je terecht bij onze Recruiter Myriam JELLOULI via myriam.jellouli@cebeo.be.

Met een uitgebreid aanbod van innovatieve oplossingen en diensten bedienen we verschillende sectoren en zetten we de klant altijd centraal. Als onderdeel van de internationale Sonepar Group combineren we wereldwijde expertise met een persoonlijke, lokale aanpak.

 
Ontdek jouw toekomstige job

Heb je een passie voor integraties tussen verschillende applicaties? Ben jij sterk in het vertalen van architectuur- en businessnoden naar technische oplossingen? Zeggen Azure Integration Services en/of Dell Boomi jou iets?

 
Dan ben jij misschien de Integration Developer die wij zoeken om ons IT-team te versterken!

 
Binnen ons hoofdkantoor te Waregem, onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Team Lead Integrations, beheer je de integraties tussen de applicaties van Cebeo en Sonepar België. Daarnaast sta je ook in voor de EDI-integraties met klanten en leveranciers.

 
Als Integration Developer (M/V/X) zal dit jouw missie zijn:

- Integratieontwikkeling: Je implementeert gedetailleerde en op maat gemaakte integratieprocessen.

- Testing: Je voert integratietesten uit en ondersteunt tijdens gebruikersacceptatietesten (UAT).

- Lifecycle management: Je beheert interne en externe integraties over hun volledige levenscyclus – van concept en development tot onderhoud en uitfasering.

- Project & onderhoud: Je schakelt vlot tussen verschillende integratieprojecten en onderhoudsopdrachten.

 
 
Jouw profiel

- Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring binnen integraties en/of technische oplossingen, bij voorkeur met Azure Integration Services, Dell Boomi of gelijkaardige platformen.

- Je hebt een goede kennis van standaard businessapplicaties (CRM, ERP, WMS, …) en businessprocessen (aankoop, verkoop, transport, …).

- Je bent leergierig en past je snel aan binnen verschillende projectteams.

- Je hebt een sterke teamgeest en werkt gestructureerd en oplossingsgericht.

- Fulltime 39 uur per week

- Competitief loon

- Eindejaarspremie

- Groepsverzekering

- Benefits@Work

Bij Cebeo, een familiebedrijf sinds 1922, staan we met duizend op NR1 en zijn diversiteit en inclusie essentiële bouwstenen van onze bedrijfsstrategie. We zetten al onze 1000 medewerkers op de eerste plaats, want zij zijn de belangrijkste schakels van ons bedrijf. Als familiebedrijf zetten we ons in voor een duurzame toekomst en zorg voor onze planeet. We creëren een veilige, gezonde, warme en respectvolle werkomgeving waar iedereen kan groeien als een NR1.

positions.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.Business Developer / FX Sales Associate
Ebury Antwerp - Office based
Launch Your FinTech Career as a Business Developer / FX Sales Associate at Ebury. 
You'll be among the initial hires to conquer the dynamic Antwerp market, especially as this will be a new Ebury office. 
Kickstart a meaningful sales career in the world of international finance while earning uncapped commission. You’ll get expert training, supportive mentorship, hands-on experience and a clear path to becoming a top salesperson in FX and global payments.
Every call you make will sharpen your sales skills and build your network across international markets. You’ll work with cutting-edge financial solutions that help businesses trade globally, giving you deep industry knowledge that will open doors to future management positions.
Along the way, you’ll be supported by experienced mentors and have access to structured development programmes designed to accelerate your career. Whether you aim to lead a team or specialise in high-level account management, you’ll have the tools and guidance to get there.
What you’ll do
Drive new business opportunities by connecting with decision-makers across various industries. You’ll research prospects, understand their needs, and tailor your approach to introduce them to international payment and FX solutions.
Your ability to present, negotiate and close deals will directly impact your earnings and career progression. You’ll also collaborate with internal teams to ensure new clients have a smooth onboarding experience.
What you’ll need

Enthusiastic, highly motivated recent graduate 
Desire or experience working in B2B sales or a client-facing environment
No prior FX experience? No problem! We prioritise potential above your CV. Our comprehensive training program will equip you with everything you need to thrive.
Fluency in Dutch and strong business-level English
A genuine interest in financial markets and how global trade works
Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the drive to hit ambitious targets

Why Ebury? Your Accelerated Career Path
At Ebury, we're one of the fastest-growing FinTechs worldwide. Our success is built on our proven model of nurturing talent and offering clear, accelerated career progression:

Fast-Track to Sales Management (Head of Desk): Join a career track where a typical promotion occurs within your first 12 months.
Becoming an FX Expert (Client Portfolio Manager): Excel at building client relationships and providing financial advice to manage key client portfolios as a trusted advisor.

What You'll Gain (Our Investment in You):

Competitive Starting Salary with an uncapped commission structure that truly rewards your performance from day one.
Comprehensive, Structured Training Programme: Ebury Business Developer Academy, providing you with foundational knowledge and advanced sales skills.
Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced Heads of Desk and seasoned Account Managers who are invested in your success.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.
Clear, Accelerated Career Progression: Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.
Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.
Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.
Central Antwerp Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.

Ready to launch your career with a global FinTech? Click the ‘Apply’ Today and discover your potential at Ebury!
You can also connect with me on LinkedIn - Ray Farncombe

Word Applicatie Engineer bij Matrix Fitness en optimaliseer onze interne IT-systemen voor een efficiëntere en innovatievere organisatie!

Functieomschrijving

💥 Klaar om jouw IT-skills in topvorm te brengen?

Ben jij technisch sterk, denk je graag mee over slimme oplossingen én wil je werken bij de snelst groeiende fitnessorganisatie van de Benelux?

Dan hebben wij jouw perfecte match gevonden!

Bij Matrix Fitness werk je in een sportieve en energieke omgeving waar technologie, innovatie en teamwork centraal staan.

🏋️‍♀️ Wat je gaat doen

Als Applicatie Engineer ben jij de spil tussen onze gebruikers en onze IT-systemen.

Je zorgt ervoor dat bedrijfsapplicaties zoals CRM en SAP optimaal functioneren en continu worden verbeterd. Je inventariseert gebruikerswensen, implementeert upgrades en denkt actief mee over innovatieve oplossingen. Jouw werk heeft directe impact op de efficiëntie van onze organisatie.

👉 Een paar highlights van je taken:

  • Beheren, onderhouden en optimaliseren van CRM- en SAP-applicaties;

  • Inventariseren van gebruikersbehoeften en vertalen naar technische oplossingen;

  • Implementeren van updates en verbeteringen;

  • Verslagleggen van werkzaamheden en afstemmen met stakeholders;

  • Zorgen dat systemen compliant blijven met wet- en regelgeving;

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en processen slimmer maken.

Vereisten

De ideale kandidaat heeft:

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau met een afgeronde IT- of informaticaopleiding;

  • Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring met CRM- en SAP-processen;

  • Kennis van SQL, C# en JavaScript;

  • Ervaring met Microsoft Visual Studio IDE (pré);

  • Kennis van ITIL en Python (pré);

  • Goede beheersing van de Engelse en Chinese taal, zowel schriftelijk als verbaal
    (kennis van Nederlands is een pré);

  • Ervaring met CRM- en ERP-systemen zoals Microsoft Dynamics 365 en SAP;

  • De mentaliteit van een topsporter: jij gaat ervoor! 💪

Je kunt bij ons rekenen op:

  • Een uitstekend salaris;

  • Een uitstekend pensioen waarbij Matrix het grootste deel voor haar rekening neemt;

  • Digitaal leerplatform voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

  • 25 vakantiedagen met de optie om er 5 bij te kopen;

  • Gratis fitnessfaciliteiten op kantoor;

  • Gezellige kantine met complete keuken;

  • Jaarlijkse sportdag en diverse interne events;

  • Veel ruimte voor nieuwe initiatieven en ideeën;

  • Vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid – de basis van onze Matrix Mentaliteit;

  • De juiste middelen om je functie uitstekend uit te oefenen;

  • Een job bij de leukste en snelst groeiende fitnessorganisatie van de Benelux;

  • Een inspirerend en enthousiast team waarin je elke dag blijft leren.

🏠 Hier ga je aan de slag

Welkom in Houten – de thuisbasis van Matrix Fitness! Wij zijn de snelst groeiende leverancier van professionele fitnessapparatuur in de Benelux. Onze toestellen vind je overal: van sportscholen en fysiopraktijken tot scholen, hotels, bedrijven en topsportlocaties.

Als onderdeel van het wereldwijd opererende Johnson Health Tech. (opgericht in Taiwan) combineren we internationale slagkracht met de warmte van een lokaal en betrokken team.

En ja: sporten tijdens werktijd mag gewoon. 💥

Wil je meer weten over deze vacature of ons bedrijf? Ik vertel je er graag meer over!

positions.description:
Job Introduction
Serco is a trusted partner of European Institutions and International Organisations, providing ICT services and Contact Centre management across Europe. Our expertise ranges from information systems support to consultancy services delivered under governmental frameworks, supporting key entities such as the European Commission and its Executive Agencies. As a leader in Service Integration and Management, we ensure the seamless delivery of services across multiple platforms, reflecting our strong commitment to quality and operational excellence.
We are currently seeking a COAV Developer to join our team supporting the EuroControl in Maastricht, Netherlands, as well as in other locations across Europe. Background
The time-based support for software developer will be embedded in the Innovation (SII/ADI/INNO) team which is a specialised team dealing with next-generation systems, exploring new technologies and paving the path towards their implementation in a safety-critical environment. Within this context, the requested time-based support will work in the COAV (Contrail Avoidance) project and help design, implement, and evolve the required software components and associated technical documentation to enable timely experimentation and delivery of project outcomes. 
Tasks will include maintaining and evolving the COAV ecosystem, including related dashboards and statistics. New developments will focus on deploying a ground-based camera network to cover the MUAC area, implementing the backbone server and image storage, and further developing the AI components for contrail detection and flight attribution. These data will be correlated with multiple weather forecasts and intersected with flight trajectories. There will be scientific reporting about findings.
In addition, the existing COAV server and its contrail-avoidance algorithms will be enhanced, visualisations will be developed, and initial integrations will be carried out in the non-vital operational partitions of the MUAC flight data systems. This system needs to run at high availability and feeds a to-be-enhanced dashboarding for climate metrics. There will be AI-generated documentation about the system.
The proposed candidate may be either (i) a software developer with strong data science and machine learning skills, or (ii) a data scientist with strong software development and software engineering skills, provided all mandatory requirements in this specification are met.Education Requirement
Mandatory:Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information technology, with a focus on Software Engineering, or equivalent professional knowledge. In the absence of a diploma, the proposed candidate shall demonstrate minimum 4 years of relevant professional experience in Software Engineering.Language requirement
Mandatory:The Tenderer shall confirm that the proposed candidate has ability to Listening-Reading-Writing-Speaking in English at level C1/B2/B2/C1 (the English skill levels may be further evaluated during an interview).Technical/Professional qualification
The candidate must present evidence of relevant technical and professional expertise, including the creation and upkeep of comprehensive technical documentation throughout the development process, as well as the ability to work collaboratively within delivery teams and engage effectively with internal stakeholders in innovative or prototyping contexts. Equivalent experience with alternative technologies will also be considered, and minimum years of experience should be specified for all requirements. The candidate must have practical experience with modern web UI development, microservices and container platforms, Python programming and key libraries, neural networks, image segmentation, AI-assisted development, agentic approaches, and hands-on familiarity with cloud and data science environments. The candidate will be evaluated on basis of the following mandatory and desirable requirementsMandatory:

Minimum 1 year experience with Web UI development using Vue, React, or Angular.
Minimum 1 year experience with Node.js development.
Minimum 1 year experience with Microservices / container platforms, such as OpenShift, Docker, or equivalent.
Minimum 1 year experience with Python-based services, e.g. Pandas, FastAPI, Polars, NumPy, Flask.
Minimum 1 year experience with Data platforms / cloud environments, preferably Azure.
Minimum 1 year experience with Data Lakehouse technologies, preferably Databricks.
Minimum 1 year experience with drafting high-quality technical documentation and communication, including specifications, design notes, test descriptions, and user or operational documentation, using tools such as Confluence and Jira.

Desirable:

Minimum 1 year experience with Web UI development using Vue, React, or Angular.
Minimum 1 year experience with Node.js development.
Minimum 1 year experience with Microservices / container platforms, such as OpenShift, Docker, or equivalent.
Minimum 1 year experience with Python-based services, e.g. Pandas, FastAPI, Polars, NumPy, Flask.
Minimum 1 year experience with Data platforms / cloud environments, preferably Azure.
Minimum 1 year experience with Data Lakehouse technologies, preferably Databricks.
Minimum 1 year experience with drafting high-quality technical documentation and communication, including specifications, design notes, test descriptions, and user or operational documentation, using tools such as Confluence and Jira.
Other requirement(personal charachteristics)

Ability to identify, analyse and solve problems and to present key issues and possible/recommended solutions in a clear, structured and concise way (the longer the relevant experience, the better).
Experience in working as a team player and desire to work in a multi-cultural team, positive and open minded, committed to getting a job done.
Experience in acting as a business analyst where required for example to seek missing information and clarify requirements in a pro-active way. 
Hands-on-approach

  • Minimum 1 year experience with Web UI development using Vue, React, or Angular.

  • Minimum 1 year experience with Microservices / container platforms, such as OpenShift, Docker, or equivalent.

  • Experience in acting as a business analyst where required for example to seek missing information and clarify requirements in a pro-active way. 
  • Hands-on-approach

positions.descriptionHtml:
Our developers build the systems our customers use to shop for groceries — as well as the software that runs our warehouses, supports last-mile, and helps our purchasing and commerce teams operate effectively.

 

What you'll do

We build software in a lean and pragmatic way, and care about choosing the right abstractions for our domain and continuously balance delivery speed against long-term complexity.

Our stack includes Typescript, React Native, modern PHP and PostgreSQL. We prefer to work with people who have seen—or want to learn—different technologies, as we consider our tools a means to an end.

You will:

  • Work with a small team of product owners and product designers to implement new app features.

  • Help validate features work as intended, from analysing technical telemetry to joining customer interviews.

  • Code across our stack — frontend and backend.

  • Ship often and take responsibility for your code “in the field”.

We invest heavily in automated testing and code readability. Refactoring is part of the job. Abstractions are revisited when the business changes.

We use LLMs as productivity tools where appropriate, but every line of code shipped to production is understood and owned by the developer who commits it.

 

What you bring

You likely:

  • Have several years of experience with developing for mobile.

  • Have real experience with a general-purpose language (Python, JavaScript, PHP, Go, ...).

  • Care about code quality and long-term maintainability.

  • Enjoy working directly with product designers and our customers.

  • Are comfortable taking responsibility for production systems.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience chasing and solving delicate performance issues on Android or iOS.

  • Experience operating systems serving a large user base.

Don’t worry if you don’t match every point above. We hire for long-term potential, curiosity and the ability to learn quickly.

A minimum of B2 level Dutch working proficiency and a full-time availability of 36-40 hours per week are required.

 

What we offer

  • The chance to leave your mark on our food system and have real impact with your commitment and experience.

  • Working with the best: a high-profile team experienced in building and scaling ventures from the ground up, with diverse backgrounds.

  • The ability for you to learn quickly from others on the team.

  • A team culture based on modesty, openness and excellence.

  • Plenty of opportunity to take responsibility from day one.

  • The opportunity to shape the culture of a well established company in a new, vibrant location.

  • A competitive salary and equity/stock.

  • Regular hackweeks to work on anything you find worthwhile.

  • Time to get to know your colleagues during sports, events and tastings.

 

Interested?

We would love to hear from you! Our process starts with a technical assignment, followed up by an on-site interview in Amsterdam.

Should you have any questions, please contact us on jobs@crisp.nl.

A reference check is part of our selection process.

 

At Crisp, we strive for an inclusive and diverse work environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of their background, gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, or ability. We encourage applicants with diverse perspectives and backgrounds to apply and believe in equal opportunities for all. We value the unique contributions each employee can bring and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and appreciated.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Jouw energie in de plus

Als SAP Developer bouw je mee aan één geïntegreerd systeem waarmee collega’s onze hoogspanningsstations beter kunnen plannen en beheersen en zo de energietransitie versnellen.

Waarom werken bij Stedin jou energie oplevert:

  • Werken aan complexe SAP‑vraagstukken die direct impact hebben op het energienet.

  • Hybride werken met veel ruimte om thuis te werken.

  • Flexibele werktijden die je werk‑privébalans versterken.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als SAP Developer zorg je voor de IT-oplossingen voor de collega’s die hoogspanningsstations bouwen. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt een geïntegreerd systeem op basis van SAP-PS, SAP-PPM en SAP Logistics met koppelingen naar Relatics (SEIS) en Oracle Primavera Cloud. Samen met procesregisseurs en business consultants worden de bouwprocessen zo optimaal mogelijk ondersteund, zodat projecten in de uitbouw van de hoogspanningsnetten beter te plannen en te beheersen zijn. Daarmee lever je direct een bijdrage aan de energietransitie.
 

Een dag als SAP Developer:

  • Met een kop koffie of thee van de ‘gebarista’ start de dag met de daily stand-up, waar prioriteiten en mogelijke obstakels worden doorgenomen. Daarna ga je aan de slag met je ontwikkelwerk.

  • Aan het begin van de sprint bespreek je met het DevOps-team en de Product Owner de doelen voor de komende twee weken en help je de waarde van het product te maximaliseren, met afwisselend planning, refinement en uitvoerend werk.

  • In de loop van de ochtend voer je kennismakingsgesprekken om de businesscontext van de applicatie goed te begrijpen en heb je korte online meetings om integraties af met andere DevOps-teams. Je werkt samen aan user stories, zoals een ontwerp voor implementatie van congestieoplossingen.

  • Lunchen doe je in het bedrijfsrestaurant op de 18e verdieping met uitzicht over Rotterdam of tijdens een wandeling door de stad. ’s Middags staat een refinement voor de volgende sprint op de agenda en wordt wekelijks verdiepend gekeken naar user stories voor het komende kwartaal.

  • Aan het einde van de dag stem je met de Epic Owner de volgende stappen in de productontwikkeling af, pak je waar mogelijk enkele beheerverzoeken op in het ticketsysteem en loop je zo naar station Blaak om snel weer thuis te zijn.

Hier laad jij van op

Alle financiële arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rij, weet je meteen waar je aan toe bent:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.548,05 en maximaal € 7.267,09 (bij 40 uur en afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring), 24,5 vakantiedagen en pensioenopbouw bij ABP waarbij wij 70% van de premie betalen.

  • Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een persoonlijk budget van 24% (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). Jij kiest wat je met het budget doet: bijvoorbeeld extra salaris of (tot max. 35,5) verlofdagen. In onze rekentool zie je hoe het werkt.

  • Jaarlijks € 700,- (bruto) om te besteden aan je eigen energie, bijvoorbeeld voor je sportabonnement of je nieuwe sportkleding.

Daar komt dit nog bovenop:

  • Moderne thuiswerkfaciliteiten en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,40 per dag. Bij Stedin werken we 50% thuis en 50% op kantoor.

  • Reizen naar kantoor doe je met de ov-vrijregeling. Dat is een ov-kaart die je ook in je vrije tijd kan gebruiken. Of met de flexibele reisregeling, waarbij je zelf kiest, combineert en varieert hoe je naar je werk reist en een extra vergoeding krijgt als je met de fiets komt.

  • Een laptop en telefoon, of € 30,- netto per maand als je je eigen telefoon gebruikt.

Vol energie vooruit met team Zakelijk Complex

Je sluit aan bij de Agile Release Train (ART) ‘Zakelijk Complex’, midden in de energietransitie. Het team bestaat uit ongeveer tien collega’s, onder wie business analisten en applicatie engineers. Samen werken jullie 2 dagen per week op kantoor, dit kunnen de locaties Delft en Rotterdam (Blaak en/of Coolse Poort) zijn, dat stemmen jullie onderling af.

Met deze kwaliteiten groei jij hier verder

Als SAP developer ben je enthousiaste teamspeler die graag met verschillende afdelingen samenwerkt aan het verbeteren van bedrijfsprocessen. Met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden schakel je makkelijk tussen stakeholders en collega’s. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en oplossingen, altijd met een klantgerichte en analytische blik om complexe SAP-vraagstukken op te lossen.

Verder heb je:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als SAP Developer.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met ABAP, SAP S/4HANA en Fiori/UI5 en brede kennis van het SAP BTP Platform en integraties zoals SAP PI/PO, API’s en interfaces. 

  • Je hebt ervaring om te werken in een Agile-SAFe-omgevingen en je beschikt over uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse taal (niveau C1/C2).

Zet de stap naar jouw volgende uitdaging

We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten.

Dit is nog goed om te weten:

  • Je mag een motivatiebrief meesturen, dat hoeft niet.

  • Je werkt in principe 40 uur per week. Maar wil je 32 of 36 uur werken, dan is dat ook een optie.

Het is een gezellig team dat actief bijdraagt aan de energietransitie.

Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team met developers, een Scrum Master en een Product Owner. Samen werken jullie aan applicaties die bedrijfsprocessen ondersteunen en verbeteren.

Om samenwerking te bevorderen, werken we met een ‘Big Room Planning’. Collega’s uit de IT en de business komen elk kwartaal bij elkaar om in deze twee gezellige dagen met elkaar te bepalen wat er komend kwartaal ontwikkeld wordt.

We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten.

Dit is nog goed om te weten:

positions.descriptionHtml:
Job Title

Intern AI Application Developer

Job Description

Start Date: As of August 2026

Duration: at least / 6 months

Type: Internship (non-thesis)

Weekly Presence: 40h (minimum 32h)

Location: Best

Internship Title

AI Application Developer Intern

Your role:

The Healthcare Consultancy Service team at Philips helps healthcare organizations improve care delivery through operational planning, digital transformation, and healthcare technology solutions. As an AI Application Intern, you contribute to this mission by developing scalable, production-ready AI applications and intelligent workflows that improve how healthcare data is utilized globally. The role focuses on building reliable and secure AI-driven systems using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, workflow orchestration, and structured automation rather than simple prototypes. Working within a global consultancy environment, you help bridge advanced AI technologies with real healthcare and business challenges, supporting innovation, efficiency, and smarter decision-making across international healthcare systems.

Key Responsibilities

Must have: AI Application Development

  • Interactive UI Prototyping: Design, code, and deploy user-friendly web applications utilizing Python to turn complex AI logic into accessible scenario-planning hubs.
  • Production Interface Integration: Build and maintain web application components, bridging Python-based AI backends (e.g., FastAPI, Flask) with modern software platform frontends (e.g., React, Vue.js, or cloud-native UI components).
  • UI/UX for Complex Workflows: Create intuitive interfaces tailored for professionals, balancing extreme interface flexibility with deterministic system control.

Good to have: Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Architecture

  • Design Agentic Systems: Architect, deploy, and test advanced autonomous AI agents and Multi-Agent task-handling systems using enterprise frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.
  • Inter-Agent Communication & MCP: Implement agent-to-agent communication patterns, tool-calling mechanisms, and modular integrations utilizing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to securely connect LLMs with external data pipelines and application tools.
  • Orchestration & Control: Develop generalizable patterns for prompt optimization, structured output control, and robust model routing across multiple cloud LLM providers (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LLaMA).
  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Design evaluation logic, validation methods, and safety guardrails (including "Human-in-the-loop" mechanisms) to manage the limitations of probabilistic systems and ensure application reliability.

1. You're the Right Fit If:

  • Education: You are studying towards your University Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Sciences, AI/Robotics, Software Engineering.
  • AI & Software Integration: You have practical experience building AI-powered applications, understanding prompt design, output validation, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture, and AI Agent design patterns.
  • Software Engineering Toolkit: Highly proficient in Python (and/or C#, Java). Comfortable working with APIs, backend systems, web frameworks, and cloud environments—specifically Azure.
  • Data Foundations: Experience working with databases (Python, SQL) and data manipulation/visualization tools (Excel, PowerBI).
  • Production Mindset: You think beyond basic demos. You care about application scalability, maintainability, CI/CD pipelines (DevOps), and balancing agent autonomy with strict business guardrails.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

We offer you:
A non-stop growth opportunity within a global multinational company. In addition, we also want to renumerate you well for the opportunity. This includes:

  • Monthly full-time allowance between €500 - €700 gross, depending on your education level and if you need to relocate to The Netherlands. Part-time internships receive the allowance pro-rata. 
  • Housing compensation. Should you need to relocate to near our office, we’ll offer you a monthly allowance of €300,- net if location is in the vicinity of Amsterdam, €255,- net for all other Philips locations. To be eligible, we’ll just ask for the rental contract from your landlord, and your usual home-work travel distance needs to be more than 50 km or 1.5 hours of travel time (for a one way trip). 
  • Travel compensation, if you are not eligible for a free public transport card; you will receive max. €192,- net as a monthly allowance. 
  • Paid holidays per internship term. 
  • The opportunity to buy Philips products at our Philips shop. 

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

• Learn more about our business.

• Discover our rich and exciting history.

• Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion here.

#LI-OFFICE

positions.description:
At a glance
At ABN AMRO Core Transactions, we are looking for an enthusiastic Java Developer who is passionate about payments. Our systems are a key part of the stability of the bank. Do you picture yourself working on applications that handle millions of requests every day? Working with the latest technologies and connecting that to what our clients and business needs? Then we are looking for you!Your job
As a Java Developer, you play a key role in realizing ABN AMRO's strategy of being a personal bank in a digital age. You are responsible for developing, maintaining and transforming our payment system landscape. You will contribute to the development of applications and microservices running on Java 25 and Spring Boot 4, deployed in the Azure cloud environment. You work in a DevOps team responsible for analysis, design, development, testing and maintenance of software to automate and support business processes. You make sure crucial bank processes can be executed efficiently, securely and are sustainable.Working environment
Financial institutions are facing disruptive market developments, among others sparkled by instant payments and technological innovations. It is our ambition to ensure that ABN AMRO continues to be able to offer high quality and relevant services to our clients by opening to partners and clients. You will be part of the Core Transactions department, which is at the heart of the innovation and growth strategy of our Personal & Business Banking business line. Our teams are a multidisciplinary group of ambitious colleagues working with an Agile mindset and responsible for the entire payment chain. In this team we work hard, learn a lot by challenging ourselves every day, while embracing humour for a good atmosphere. Openness, transparency, quality and ownership are key values.Your profile

3-5 years of experience in Java development (Java 17 or newer)
Hands-on experience with modern frameworks such as Spring and Spring Boot
Experience with public cloud platforms, particularly Azure and Azure DevOps
Experience with testing frameworks like JUnit, Mockito, and JMeter
Nice to have: knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and AKS

Research shows that men apply for a job when they meet only 60% of the qualifications, while women apply only if they meet 100% of them. If you feel like you might be the right fit, but don't fulfill all the requirements, do respond and give yourself an opportunity!We are offering
We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.
 
In addition, we offer:

An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget.
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.

You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.Interested?
Do you have the right profile and are you interested? Please apply. We look forward to getting to know you!Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable
At ABN AMRO, we believe in "Banking for better, for generations to come." Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of being a personal bank in the digital age aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future. If you want to apply for the B-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume. Disclaimer external recruitment agencies
External recruitment agencies need to have a signed agreement with ABN AMRO BANK N.V., executed by a Talent Acquisition Specialist, when submitting a resume to a vacancy. In addition, a recruitment agency can only submit a resume when invited by a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join the search for a right candidate. All unsolicited resumes sent to us will be considered property of ABN AMRO BANK N.V. In this case, ABN AMRO will not be held liable to pay a placement fee

positions.description:
HAUPTAUFGABEN​
Als Electronics Engineer erweiterst und optimierst du die elektronischen Baugruppen der Geberit Produkte, wobei Qualität, Funktion, Konformität und Wirtschaftlichkeit stets im Fokus stehen. Die Bandbreite erstreckt sich von kleinen Korrekturen hin zu komplizierten, mehrere Jahre dauernden Änderungsprojekten. Dies beinhaltet insbesondere folgende Tätigkeiten:

Leitung und Koordination von Projekten zur Umsetzung von Änderungen und Optimierungen an elektronischen Baugruppen (Projektmanagement)
Weiterentwicklung und Überarbeitung elektronischer Schaltungen (Elektronikdesign und Layout)
Weiterentwicklung der Embedded-Software für unsere Produkte (Embedded-Firmware)
Durchführung systematischer Analysen sowie Behebung von Störungen zur Sicherstellung der Produktqualität (Fehlersuche und Fehleranalyse)
Verantwortung für die Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung der Lieferkette (Supply Chain Management)
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern aus Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Qualitätsmanagement, Einkauf und Produktion zur Erzielung gemeinsamer Erfolge
PROFIL
Du verfügst über einen Abschluss im Bereich Elektrotechnik auf Stufe BSc/MSc oder eines vergleichbaren Studienganges und Elektronik ist deine grosse Leidenschaft. Zudem zeichnen dich folgende Eigenschaften und Fähigkeiten aus:
 
• Ausgeprägte interdisziplinäre Fähigkeiten, hohe Kommunikationskompetenz sowie Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen • Selbstständige Fehleranalyse (HW und FW) und Bug-fixing von defekten elektronischen Baugruppen • Kenntnisse im Design von analogen und digitalen Schaltungen mit Mikrocontrollern• Programmierkenntnisse, insbesondere in C und praktische Erfahrung mit RTOS• Kenntnisse in Bluetooth-Technologien und mit STM32-Prozessoren von Vorteil • Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation deiner eigenen Arbeit • Selbständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise • Interesse an kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung und persönlicher Entwicklung • SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil • Stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse
 WIR BIETEN

Unternehmenskultur: Basierend auf unserem Kompass
Entlohnung: Marktgerechter Lohn, Bonus und Aktienprogramm sowie attraktive Lohnnebenleistungen (REKA-Pay, Mobilitätsbeitrag und vieles mehr)
Arbeitszeiten: 40h Arbeitswoche und mind. 5 Ferienwochen pro Kalenderjahr
Förderung: Individuelle Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen 
Verpflegung: Abwechslungsreiche, vergünstigte Verpflegung im hochwertigen Personalrestaurant in Jona
Und vieles mehr: Erfahre hier alles über unsere Benefits

BEWERBUNG & KONTAKT
Teilst du unsere Werte und fühlst du dich in einem kollegialen sowie bodenständigen Umfeld wohl? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!
Für diese Position berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

positions.description:
📍Luzern Rösslimatt, Luzern
 Was du bewirkst

Du verbindest Business, IT und Security, priorisierst wirkungsorientiert und übersetzt strategische Ziele in konkrete, umsetzbare Features und Lösungen.
Mit einer überzeugenden Vision und einer klaren Roadmap gestaltest du die Zukunft unserer Workplace Plattform und treibst Themen wie Cloud, Automatisierung und Security aktiv voran.
Im PI Planning koordinierst du teamübergreifende Abhängigkeiten, förderst die Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Disziplinen hinweg und schaffst die Grundlage für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung.
Für Teams, Stakeholder und Management sorgst du für Transparenz und Orientierung, damit Prioritäten, Zielbilder und Risiken jederzeit nachvollziehbar bleiben.
Du stellst sicher, dass unser Workplace mit rund 3500 Geräten stabil, serviceorientiert und entlang klar definierter Service Levels betrieben wird und koordinierst die monatlichen Releases bis zum termingerechten Rollout.

Was du mitbringst

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Business Analyst in einem agilen Umfeld wie Scrum oder SAFe sowie fundierte Praxis in der Verantwortung für Produktvisionen, Roadmaps und PI Planning.
Eine abgeschlossene höhere Ausbildung in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik auf Stufe HF, FH oder Universität oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet die Grundlage für diese Funktion.
Es gelingt dir, Stakeholder aus Business, IT und Security zusammenzubringen, unterschiedliche Interessen einzuordnen und fundierte Entscheidungen aktiv herbeizuführen.
Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für komplexe IT Landschaften, technische Abhängigkeiten und organisatorische Schnittstellen hilft dir, auch in anspruchsvollen Umfeldern den Überblick zu behalten.
Fundierte Erfahrung im Workplace oder Endpoint Management, idealerweise in einem grösseren Organisationsumfeld, sowie ein solider technischer Background, beispielsweise in Windows 11, Intune, Defender oder Systems Engineering, runden dein Profil ab.

 Wie du bei uns wächst

Ein Team, das dich begleitet: Lerne von anderen und entwickle dich fachlich und persönlich weiter.
Ein Umfeld für Neues: Bring frische Ideen und Lösungen ein – für uns, unsere Versicherten und die Schweiz.
Eine sinnvolle Aufgabe: Du weisst, was du tust und warum. 

Klingt gut? Sende uns deine Bewerbung.
Du hast Fragen? Nico Joller, Talent Acquisition Manager, steht dir zur Verfügung:📞 041 419 5843

positions.descriptionHtml:
About Alohi

Alohi is an AI-first SaaS scale-up on a mission to simplify how businesses work. Our products (Sign.Plus, Dial.Plus, Fax.Plus, and Scan.Plus) serve 5M+ customers worldwide, from small businesses to global enterprises. We're building category-defining tools that people actually love to use.

We started with seed support from FONGIT (Fondation Genevoise pour l'Innovation Technologique), backed by the State of Geneva. Since then, we've chosen to bootstrap our growth. This keeps us financially independent, customer-focused, and able to move fast without external constraints.

We're a lean, fast-growing team based in Geneva with strong traction across global markets. This is an entrepreneurial environment where you'll have high ownership, broad responsibilities, and direct impact from day one.

The Role

As a Product and Brand Designer at Alohi, you will play a critical role in shaping the visual identity and user experience of our products. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that our brand is consistently represented across all platforms, while also focusing on creating intuitive and engaging product designs. This position is based in our Geneva office.

Responsibilities

Product Design:

• Create innovative and user-centric designs for our suite of products.

• Collaborate with product managers and developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

• Conduct user research and testing to gather feedback and refine designs.

• Maintain and evolve the design system to ensure consistency across products.

Brand Identity:

• Develop and maintain the visual identity and brand guidelines of Alohi.

• Develop and maintain a brand platform and an assets library

• Create marketing materials that effectively communicate our brand story and value proposition.

• Collaborate with the marketing team to design engaging campaigns and promotional assets.

• Ensure brand consistency across all customer touchpoints.

Collaboration:

• Work closely with marketing and product teams to align on goals and strategies.

• Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate creative ideas and solutions.

• Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders for feedback and approval.

Trend Analysis:

• Stay updated on design trends and industry best practices to inform your work.

• Analyze competitor designs to understand market positioning and identify opportunities.

• Continuously seek ways to enhance user experience and brand engagement.

Requirements

• Minimum 3 years of experience in both brand and product design

• Excellent experience using Figma for prototyping and designing

• Experience using other design tools, such as Adobe Photoshop, as well as AI tools

• Fluent in English

Nice to have

• Experience in designing for SaaS products

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS for better collaboration with developers

• Knowledge of user research methodologies and usability testing

What We Offer

• Office First: We believe the best collaboration happens in person. You'll be based at our Geneva office, working alongside a lean, high-calibre team where ideas flow freely and decisions happen fast.

• AI-First Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel, including access to cutting-edge AI tools and a modern tech stack.

• Personal Development: We invest in your growth with a dedicated learning budget for training programmes, conferences, courses, and professional development opportunities.

• Quarterly Events & Annual Retreats: Regular team events and company-wide retreats to connect, celebrate wins, and have fun together.

• Award-Winning Culture: We're proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work and Best Workplace.

• Perks & Wellbeing: Weekly yoga sessions, plus discounts on gym memberships, restaurants, and Apple products.

positions.description:
About VAT Group
At VAT, we change the world with vacuum solutions. As the world’s leading supplier of high-performance vacuum valves, we have been driving innovation for more than 60 years. With over 3,200 employees worldwide, we operate from our headquarters in Haag, Switzerland, with manufacturing sites in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania, as well as sales and service hubs around the world. We are guided by our passions integrity, teamwork, customer centricity, and innovation – always working together as #oneVAT.
Joining us means becoming part of a passionate, international team where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your career growth is supported.GSE Product Manager – BU Global Services
For its Global Services Business Unit (GSE), VAT is looking for a talented Product Manager with profound knowledge in market/business development, product portfolio management and customer strategy execution in an international high tech business environment, preferably in the aftermarket. positions.title: Product Manager, 80-100% (Tägerwilen, TG)
positions.description:
Dem Credo «Mehr Natur geht in keine Flasche» verpflichtet, stellt die Biotta Manufaktur seit 1957 in Tägerwilen am Bodensee 100% naturbelassene, biologische Gemüse- und Fruchtsäfte her. Bei Biotta leben wir eine offene, familiäre Firmenkultur, handeln unternehmerisch und engagiert und packen jederzeit mit an. Wir freuen uns auf begeisterungsfähige Menschen, die unser Team von rund 60 Mitarbeitenden verstärken. Biotta ist ein Unternehmen der Schweizer Food & Beverage Gruppe ORIOR mit rund 2300 Mitarbeitenden.
 
Gestalte die Zukunft natürlicher Getränke mit uns!
 
Product Manager, 80-100% (m/w/d)
 
Deine Mission – Bio-Produkte erfolgreich im Markt positionieren

Lead von Innovationsprojekten in Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktentwicklung für Detailhandel, Fachmärkte und Gastronomie
Verantwortung für das Lifecycle Management sowie die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Sortiments auf Basis von Performanceanalysen, Marktpotenzialen sowie Umsatz- und Margenzielen
Analyse von Markt-, Wettbewerbs-, Kunden- und Konsumentenbedürfnissen sowie Ableitung erfolgreicher Produkt- und Sortimentskonzepte
Verantwortung für Budgeteinhaltung und Kostenkontrolle der verantwortlichen Sortimente
Koordination und Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams
Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Organisation und Teilnahme an Messen und Events 

Das bieten wir – Für Deinen beruflichen Geschmack

Spannende Aufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem zukunftsorientierten Schweizer KMU
Vertrauensvolle und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur
Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen inklusive grosszügiger Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Biotta-Produkte

Dein Profil – Marketingkompetenz trifft Bio-Leidenschaft

Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, idealerweise in der Food-&-Beverage-Branche
Gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Konsumgütermarktes und aktueller Trends
Erfahrung in der Leitung interdisziplinärer Projekte
Analytische, organisationsstarke und unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit hoher Teamorientierung
Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit und Affinität zu biologischen Produkten

Appetit bekommen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.
 
Bei Fragen gibt Dir Eva Hofacker, Leiterin Personal, gerne Auskunft: 071 466 48 82.
 
Wir freuen uns auf neue Impulse – und auf Dich.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

Sur l’Assistance comme ailleurs, Free ne fait rien comme les autres. L’innovation est permanente, avec une ambition claire : toujours plus de proximité, toujours plus de confiance, au service de nos 23 millions d’abonnés.

La Direction Support & Excellence au sein de l'Assistance Free crée et garanti cette relation abonné unique, au travers de solutions rapides et efficaces. A chaque interaction, au-delà de simplement répondre aux questions de nos abonnés, nous nous assurons d’anticiper ses besoins, afin de lui apporter satisfaction, confiance & fidélité. 

Ceci grâce à un écosystème omnicanal, des parcours « customer centric » et la force d'une expérience collaborateur augmentée permettant de se concentrer sur une relation humaine et empathique envers nos abonnés.

Job Description:

En tant que Product Manager, tu seras le gardien du produit central de notre omnicanalité : celui qui relie les canaux, anticipe les besoins, et libère du temps pour la relation empathique.

Ce que tu porteras :

  • La vision stratégique et la roadmap du produit omnicanal, alignée sur les besoins des abonnés et des collaborateurs.
  • La conception, le pilotage et l’amélioration continue du produit, de la feuille de route jusqu’à la livraison.
  • La traduction des besoins métiers en priorités produit, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes ops, data et techniques.
  • L’animation des sprints Agile, le suivi des livraisons, et la mesure de l’impact (adoption, satisfaction, efficacité).
  • Le management d’une équipe

Tu seras à la fois visionnaire et passe-partout : capable de penser la stratégie et de plonger dans les détails pour améliorer l’expérience utilisateur.

Qualifications:

Le profil qu’on cherche :

  • Une expérience en gestion de produit digital, idéalement dans un environnement client ou support.
  • Une maîtrise des méthodes Agile, des priorisations et de la gestion de roadmap.
  • Une forte empathie pour les utilisateurs finaux – abonnés comme collaborateurs.
  • Une capacité à prioriser entre court, moyen et long terme.
  • Une première expérience managériale

 

Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour toi :


Tu veux construire un produit qui change la donne, pour les abonnés comme pour nos équipes. Tu crois que le bon outil, c’est celui qu’on oublie parce qu’il marche. Tu veux être au cœur de l’innovation de l’Assistance Free, là où technologie, humain et performance se rencontrent.

Additional Information:
  • Intéressement & participation (Groupe Iliad-Free)
  • Prime variable attractive
  • Prime d’ancienneté
  • Prime panier repas de 6€ par jour
  • Remboursement des frais de transport (pouvant aller jusqu'à 75%), forfait mobilité
  • Prise en charge jusqu'à 50€/mois de votre facture Freebox
  • Mutuelle avantageuse prise en charge à 55% par l’entreprise et Prévoyance
  • 1% logement
  • CSE

positions.title: Specialist - Application Designer (m/f/d) (MU)
positions.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Application Designer to join our Agile Delivery Centre. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality applications, with a strong emphasis on SAS development, business analysis, and technical design. The successful candidate will collaborate with diverse stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions, ensure compliance with enterprise strategies and regulations, and support the lifecycle of applications and projects.
This position requires fluency in French and English, follows the French calendar, and operates within CET working hours.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Application Design & Development

Design, develop, and maintain SAS applications for operational reporting and analytics.
Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) using SAS.
Analyze technical impacts of functional requirements and propose innovative solutions.
Optimize existing code and technical stacks for performance improvements.
Design and develop unit and integration tests to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including specifications and implementation processes.
Configure solution components and ensure compliance of delivered solutions.

Business Analysis & Functional Expertise

Collect, analyze, and challenge business needs with a focus on simplification and enhancement of Group and local solutions.
Model, describe, and document end-to-end solutions in collaboration with business and IT stakeholders.
Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including user guides, process documentation and change management materials 
Propose process simplifications and explain envisaged changes to stakeholders. 
Lead end to end process design, from requirements gathering to solution implementation 
Ensure compliance with enterprise strategy, regulations, security rules, and architectural coherence.
Formalize requirements and functional specifications (solution user stories).
Provide functional expertise for maintenance, support, and testing alignment with business needs.

Agile Methodology & Collaboration

Work within Agile (SAFe/Scrum) frameworks to deliver incremental value.
Conduct Agile rituals and meetings as required.
Use tools like Jira, Confluence, and ServiceNow for task management and documentation.
Plan and monitor team workloads and project portfolios.
Report and communicate on squad realizations.

Incident Management & Support

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents in production environments.
Ensure timely correction of bugs and implementation of user-requested enhancements.
Map and document solution developments and interventions in a knowledge base.

Required Skills and Experience:
Technical Expertise

Strong hands-on experience with SAS Base, SAS Macros, SAS SQL, and SAS Enterprise Guide.
Proficiency in Python, PySpark, Spark, and SQL for data access and calculations.
Experience with data modeling tools like dbt and version control systems like Git/GitHub.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, Databricks) and deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/CD).
Knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Unix), virtualization (Citrix, VMware), and schedulers (HPC).
Understanding of Solvency II regulations (preferred).

Soft Skills

Strong communication skills in French and English (both written and oral).
Analytical thinking, problem-solving, and conceptual skills.
Ability to work autonomously while collaborating with distributed teams.
Collaborative leadership, initiative, and a sense of synthesis.
Good interpersonal skills to engage with diverse stakeholders effectively.

positions.description:
Company Description:MAAF est une des marques leader de l’assurance en France, fidèle à des valeurs de simplicité et d’accessibilité ; une entreprise où par ailleurs il fait bon vivre.Sa signature « La Préférence Client » donne à la dimension relationnelle une force qui se concrétise à tous les niveaux de l’entreprise.Job Description:Et si vous rejoigniez l’équipe Espaces Digitaux en tant que Chargé de projets marketing digital /PO F/H ?- Le poste est basé sur Niort- Au sein de la Direction Marketing de MAAF- Dans une équipe composée de 15 collègues (UX, UI, PO, CRO), équipe animée par @NicolasVos responsabilités : Faire évoluer votre ligne de produits digitaux pour toujours mieux répondre aux attentes de nos clients.
Votre mission :Vous portez la responsabilité d’une ligne de produits digitaux :- Animation de la relation avec les acteurs partenaires (DMC, DIARD, DSP, DAV, DDEV, …) : Collecte et identification des besoins, animation d’ateliers métier, …- Gestion d’une ligne de produit sur maaf.fr : Roadmap / déclinaison de la stratégie- Alimentation et priorisation du Backlog- Accompagnement de la fabrication des produits en lien avec l’équipe Solutions Digitales MAAF :Préparation et contribution au Sprint PlanningEcriture et validation des US, des démosProduction de KPI sur la satisfaction client et la qualité des produits- Veille technologique et marché sur l’évolution des besoins
Encore une hésitation sur les atouts de ce poste ?- Travailler dans un contexte Agile et dans un environnement dense par la multiplicité des sujets et la variété des intervenants- Contribuer à l’amélioration de l’expérience digitale des clients MAAFQualifications:Et si c'était vous ?- Formation supérieure en marketing digital- Expérience confirmée requise en tant que Product Owner digital, dans l'idéal dans le domaine des Services et au sein de grandes organisations impliquant un travail en éco systèmes complexesVotre expérience sur les applications mobiles serait un plus. - Orientation client / #UXMaîtrise de la chaîne de valeur d’un produit digital :Collaboration avec les UX UI et CRO interne à l’équipeLogique d’amélioration continue (avec les outils AB tasty, ContentSquare, Skeepers)Travail dans une Squad agileConnaissance des outils spécifiques utilisés : Outil collaboratif Figma1er niveau d’utilisation de Piwik Pro (ou expérience sur un outil équivalent)Confluence pour le partage des spécifications fonctionnellesJIRA pour la tenue du backlog (rédaction et suivi des US)Vous maitrisez et appliquez les concepts de l'UX design, vous êtes sensible au respect de l'accessibilité numérique. Compétences/Qualités :- Organisation/rigueur/priorisation- Analyse /synthèse- Qualités de communication, d'écoute et d'expression (écrite et orale), facilitant le dialogue avec les multiples interlocuteurs avec lesquels vous collaborez- Adaptabilité et curiosité dans un environnement évolutif- Force de proposition Additional Information:Covéa est un groupe mutualiste engagé, constitué des marques MAAF, MMA, GMF et du réassureur PartnerRe. Acteur économique majeur des territoires, grâce à ses 24 000 collaborateurs, Covéa protège plus de 11 millions de clients et sociétaires en France. Rejoignez le leader de l’assurance, contribuez à sa réussite : votre talent, notre engagement !

positions.descriptionHtml:
Description de l'offre d'emploi

Localisation : Rennes (Bureaux Gare)
Rythme : Présentiel 3 jours/semaine + télétravail
Rémunération : Package 40 - 60k€ selon profil
Contrat : CDI

L'entreprise

Rejoignez une entreprise innovante spécialisée dans les solutions SaaS B2B de mobilité intelligente, en forte croissance, basée à Rennes et composée d'une trentaine de collaborateurs. PYSAE développe un logiciel pour rendre le transport public plus performant et attractif. Nous accompagnons plus de 100 clients, dont des opérateurs majeurs comme Transdev, Keolis ou la RATP, et équipons plus de 10 000 bus, en France métropolitaine, DOM-TOM, Italie et Arabie Saoudite.

Votre Mission

Vous rejoignez l'équipe Produit pour piloter la réalisation de solutions innovantes, afin de faciliter la vie des opérateurs de réseaux de transport public. De la découverte des besoins terrain jusqu'au suivi des livraisons avec l'équipe technique, vous êtes le fil conducteur entre les utilisateurs, le business et les développeurs.

Ce poste s'adresse à quelqu'un qui aime aller chercher les problèmes là où ils se trouvent — chez les clients, sur le terrain — autant qu'à quelqu'un capable de les traduire en décisions produit claires et bien priorisées.

Nos processus de conception, de design produit, de spécification et de développement sont en cours de transformation profonde, portée par l'intégration de l'IA — aujourd'hui principalement Claude. Cette évolution a déjà permis d'accélérer significativement notre vélocité sur plusieurs dimensions. Vous rejoignez une équipe qui expérimente activement ces nouveaux modes de travail et qui attend de ses membres qu'ils s'en emparent avec curiosité et pragmatisme.

Vos Responsabilités

Lancement de nouvelles applications & refontes majeures

  • Prendre en charge le cycle de vie complet de plusieurs initiatives produit en parallèle, de la phase de discovery jusqu'à la mise sur le marché

  • Définir la vision, les objectifs et les critères de succès de chaque application ou refonte

  • Arbitrer les priorités en lien avec la stratégie plateforme de PYSAE

Discovery & compréhension terrain

  • Aller à la rencontre des clients et utilisateurs pour comprendre leurs problématiques en profondeur

  • Traduire les insights terrain en spécifications actionnables pour l'équipe technique

  • Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration au-delà des demandes explicites

Collaboration & suivi

  • Travailler au quotidien avec les développeurs pour assurer la bonne exécution des sujets en cours

  • Animer les rituels produit, rédiger des spécifications claires, challenger les choix techniques quand nécessaire

  • Être l'interlocuteur produit de référence pour les parties prenantes internes et externes

Votre Profil

  • Anglais courant indispensable ; l'italien est un plus

  • 2 à 6 ans d'expérience dans un rôle produit — le profil et la motivation comptent plus que les années

  • À l'aise dans un environnement SaaS B2B, avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux techniques sans nécessairement coder

  • Expérience sur des lancements de produit ou des refontes significatives, idéalement dans un contexte de forte croissance

  • À l'aise pour aller chercher l'information directement sur le terrain, chez les clients

  • Autonome dans l'organisation, rigoureux(se) dans le suivi, capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle sans perdre le cap

  • Adaptable : vous savez faire évoluer vos priorités sans vous déstabiliser. Dans une structure agile où les rôles ne sont pas figés, vous contribuez volontiers au-delà de votre périmètre (Evénements, réponses à appel d'offres, dossiers de financement innovation)

  • Curieux(se), pédagogue, bon(ne) communicant(e) avec des interlocuteurs aussi bien techniques que métier

  • À l'aise avec l'IA comme outil de travail quotidien : ouvert(e) à expérimenter de nouvelles pratiques assistées par IA (conception, specs, recherche utilisateur...) ; une expérience antérieure avec ces outils est un plus

Modalités pratiques

  • Basé(e) à Rennes

  • 3 jours de présentiel par semaine (bureaux Gare)

  • Déplacements clients (2/mois) à prévoir en France et en Europe
