positions.title: Industrial Designer - F/H (Les Clayes-sous-Bois, FR)
positions.description:
A propos de Bull 
 
Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA.
Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques.
Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique.
Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients.
 
 Qui sommes-nous ?
 
Chez Bull, nous concevons et fabriquons les technologies qui façonnent le futur de la puissance de calcul, du calcul haute performance (HPC) et de la souveraineté numérique. Notre division Manufacturing en France est le cœur réacteur industriel où nos innovations hardware prennent vie, de l’assemblage de cartes complexes jusqu’à l'intégration de supercalculateurs de rang mondial.
 
Nous renforçons aujourd'hui nos équipes au sein de la Direction marketing et Communication en recrutant un(e) Industrial Designer Global pour notre activité Manufacturing. Rattaché(e) à une équipe hautement technique et multiculturelle, vous serez le pont créatif et industriel entre nos équipes de production, la R&D et les Product Marketing Managers (PMM).
 
Votre mission : Allier excellence esthétique, rigueur de la CAO mécanique et vision UX/UI pour concevoir les architectures physiques, les stencils techniques et les interfaces des prochaines générations de produits Bull.

Responsabilités principals
 
Vous êtes le garant de la cohérence visuelle, de l'ergonomie physique et de la faisabilité industrielle de nos infrastructures matérielles. Votre rôle combine le design de produits hardware complexes et la création d'assets numériques.
 
Design Industriel, Modélisation et Faisabilité Manufacturing

Vous assisterez notre département R&D, sur des solutions d'ergonomie. 
Vous développez et ajustez les modèles volumétriques complexes avec les équipes d'ingénierie.
Vous prenez en charge la création de stencils précis sous Visiopro pour la modélisation de nos configurations de baies et l'implantation de nos systèmes.

Identité de Marque et Assets Visuels (Product Branding)

Création d'assets 2D : Vous concevez les illustrations, icônes et chartes visuelles spécifiques à nos produits pour enrichir notre bibliothèque d'assets de marque et standardiser nos documentations techniques.
Animation produit : Vous réalisez des animations 3D réalistes de nos équipements pour valoriser notre ingénierie auprès des équipes internes et des clients.

Compétences Et Qualifications Requises
 
Formation et expérience

Diplôme supérieur (École de Design Industriel, Master ou Diplôme d'Ingénieur en Conception de Produits).
Minimum 5 ans d’expérience confirmée en design industriel avec une expérience éprouvée de produits matériels passés en production de série.
Expérience de travail au sein d'environnements industriels complexes et d'équipes multiculturelles.

Compétences techniques

CAO Volumétrique : Maîtrise complète de Solidworks ou Creo Dynamic (Must-have).
Animation 3D : Pratique experte de Keyshot (obligatoire) ; Cinema 4D (C4D) est un plus.
Design Digital : Connaissance de Figma pour le prototypage et l'UX/UI.
Outils Graphiques & Techniques : Maîtrise de la Suite Adobe (illustrations) et expérience opérationnelle sur Visiopro.

Langues : Anglais courant impératif (Fluent) pour comprendre les requis de contenus et échanger au sein de nos équipes internationales.
 
Soft skills

Esprit créatif affirmé doublé d'une forte sensibilité aux contraintes d'usine et de production de cartes/châssis.
Rigueur absolue, sens aigu du détail, respect des processus industriels et des échéances (deadlines).
Excellente communication interfonctionnelle pour collaborer avec des ingénieurs R&D, des opérateurs de production et des équipes marketing.

Environnement et enjeux

Poste clé : Remplacement pour sécuriser la continuité de multiples projets stratégiques et de projets clients directs.
Localisation : Idéalement basé en France, en étroite proximité avec nos pôles de R&D et notre usine de Manufacturing (Angers).
Salaire : 50-58k€

Pourquoi postuler ?
 
Ce poste offre l'opportunité rare de travailler sur du hardware de très haute technologie (HPC/Supercalculateurs) au sein de la marque historique Bull. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du spectre du design : de la tôle et de la mécanique lourde d'une baie serveur jusqu'à son interface logicielle sur Figma. C'est un rôle à forte visibilité industrielle et à dimension internationale.
 
Pourquoi ne pas postuler ?
 
Si le secteur du hardware informatique lourd et les contraintes d'usine ne vous passionnent pas, si vous préférez le design de produits de grande consommation purement "grand public", ou si la création de schémas techniques rigoureux sous Visiopro vous semble rébarbative, ce poste ne répondra pas à vos attentes.

Processus de recrutement

Entretien de cadrage avec le Talent Acquisition Business Partner
Entretien technique approfondi avec le Responsable Product Engineering (Revue de portfolio, maîtrise Solidworks/Keyshot).
Entretien final de validation

Merci de bien intégrer votre portfolio à votre candidature.____________________________
 
Rejoignez notre communauté! Ici, vos idées, votre curiosité et votre excellence technique contribuent directement à façonner la prochaine ère du calcul avancé - en créant de la valeur pour les entreprises, en accélérant le progrès scientifique et en générant un impact positif pour la société.

Nous renforçons aujourd'hui nos équipes au sein de la Direction marketing et Communication en recrutant un(e) Industrial Designer Global pour notre activité Manufacturing. Rattaché(e) à une équipe hautement technique et multiculturelle, vous serez le pont créatif et industriel entre nos équipes de production, la R&D et les Product Marketing Managers (PMM).

 

Votre mission : Allier excellence esthétique, rigueur de la CAO mécanique et vision UX/UI pour concevoir les architectures physiques, les stencils techniques et les interfaces des prochaines générations de produits Bull.

Responsabilités principals

 

Vous êtes le garant de la cohérence visuelle, de l'ergonomie physique et de la faisabilité industrielle de nos infrastructures matérielles. Votre rôle combine le design de produits hardware complexes et la création d'assets numériques.

 

Design Industriel, Modélisation et Faisabilité Manufacturing

 

  • Vous assisterez notre département R&D, sur des solutions d'ergonomie.
  • Vous développez et ajustez les modèles volumétriques complexes avec les équipes d'ingénierie.
  • Vous prenez en charge la création de stencils précis sous Visiopro pour la modélisation de nos configurations de baies et l'implantation de nos systèmes.

 

Identité de Marque et Assets Visuels (Product Branding)

 

  • Création d'assets 2D : Vous concevez les illustrations, icônes et chartes visuelles spécifiques à nos produits pour enrichir notre bibliothèque d'assets de marque et standardiser nos documentations techniques.
  • Animation produit : Vous réalisez des animations 3D réalistes de nos équipements pour valoriser notre ingénierie auprès des équipes internes et des clients.

 

 

Compétences Et Qualifications Requises

 

Formation et expérience

 

  • Diplôme supérieur (École de Design Industriel, Master ou Diplôme d'Ingénieur en Conception de Produits).
  • Minimum 5 ans d’expérience confirmée en design industriel avec une expérience éprouvée de produits matériels passés en production de série.
  • Expérience de travail au sein d'environnements industriels complexes et d'équipes multiculturelles.

 

Compétences techniques

 

  • CAO Volumétrique : Maîtrise complète de Solidworks ou Creo Dynamic (Must-have).
  • Animation 3D : Pratique experte de Keyshot (obligatoire) ; Cinema 4D (C4D) est un plus.
  • Design Digital : Connaissance de Figma pour le prototypage et l'UX/UI.
  • Outils Graphiques & Techniques : Maîtrise de la Suite Adobe (illustrations) et expérience opérationnelle sur Visiopro.

 

Langues : Anglais courant impératif (Fluent) pour comprendre les requis de contenus et échanger au sein de nos équipes internationales.

 

Soft skills

 

  • Esprit créatif affirmé doublé d'une forte sensibilité aux contraintes d'usine et de production de cartes/châssis.
  • Rigueur absolue, sens aigu du détail, respect des processus industriels et des échéances (deadlines).
  • Excellente communication interfonctionnelle pour collaborer avec des ingénieurs R&D, des opérateurs de production et des équipes marketing.

 

Environnement et enjeux

 

  • Poste clé : Remplacement pour sécuriser la continuité de multiples projets stratégiques et de projets clients directs.
  • Localisation : Idéalement basé en France, en étroite proximité avec nos pôles de R&D et notre usine de Manufacturing (Angers).
  • Salaire : 50-58k€

 

Pourquoi postuler ?

 

Ce poste offre l'opportunité rare de travailler sur du hardware de très haute technologie (HPC/Supercalculateurs) au sein de la marque historique Bull. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du spectre du design : de la tôle et de la mécanique lourde d'une baie serveur jusqu'à son interface logicielle sur Figma. C'est un rôle à forte visibilité industrielle et à dimension internationale.

 

Pourquoi ne pas postuler ?

 

Si le secteur du hardware informatique lourd et les contraintes d'usine ne vous passionnent pas, si vous préférez le design de produits de grande consommation purement "grand public", ou si la création de schémas techniques rigoureux sous Visiopro vous semble rébarbative, ce poste ne répondra pas à vos attentes.

 

Processus de recrutement

 

  1. Entretien de cadrage avec le Talent Acquisition Business Partner
  2. Entretien technique approfondi avec le Responsable Product Engineering (Revue de portfolio, maîtrise Solidworks/Keyshot).
  3. Entretien final de validation

 

Merci de bien intégrer votre portfolio à votre candidature.

____________________________

 



Rejoignez notre communauté! Ici, vos idées, votre curiosité et votre excellence technique contribuent directement à façonner la prochaine ère du calcul avancé - en créant de la valeur pour les entreprises, en accélérant le progrès scientifique et en générant un impact positif pour la société.

positions.title: Legal Counsel - Global Product Strategy and Human Resources (M/W) (Suresnes, Ile-de-France, FR, 92150)
positions.description:
.
Job Description
This position plays a key role in supporting and securing the Group’s global strategy by partnering closely with Global Product Strategy and Human Resources teams.The role requires balancing legal risk management with pragmatic, solution-oriented support in a dynamic, international environment, directly contributing to business performance and organizational transformation.
 
CHALLENGES OF THE POSITION
Within the Worldwide Operations, Global Product Strategy and Human Resources Legal Affairs Department, reporting hierarchically to the Director of the Department, you will be responsible for the legal support of the Global Product Strategy and Human Resources functions.
You will operate in a highly transversal, fast-paced, and international environment, combining legal rigor with business pragmatism, strategic insight, and a clear ability to take positions and guide decision-making.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
1) Strategic Legal Partner – Global Product Strategy & Human Resources

Act as a trusted legal advisor and strategic business partner, with a strong operational focus:

to Global Product Strategy teams across key strategic activities, including marketing and promotional activities, pricing and market access, market research, competitive intelligence, and digital/data initiatives;
to Global Human Resources teams across core operational activities, including workplace and general services (catering, facilities management, cleaning, security and workplace operations), headhunting and executive search, training and coaching services, employee mobility, and other HR-related support services.

Support and advise Global Product Strategy and Human Resources projects from a legal and risk management perspective, clearly articulating legal positions and recommendations.
Draft, negotiate, and manage a broad range of agreements (including agency agreements, market research and consulting agreements, data licensing and digital platform services agreements, facility management and workplace services agreements, headhunting and executive search agreements, master services agreements and related statements of work), ensuring alignment with internal policies, business objectives, internal governance, and compliance requirements.
Structure, assess, and frame global collaborations with external partners and service providers.
As needed, support other global functions on strategic services-related negotiations (e.g., public affairs, IP agent mandates, insurance brokerage).
.
2) Contracting Excellence & Legal Tools

Develop, maintain, and continuously improve contract templates, playbooks, and master framework agreements for Global Product Strategy and Human Resources.
Contribute to contract lifecycle management, legal process optimization, and the delivery of high-quality, consistent legal documentation.

3) Business Partnering & Training

Support key requests for proposals (RFPs) and tender processes, ensuring legal robustness and commercial clarity.
Design and deliver pragmatic legal training sessions on contracting best practices, competition law, confidentiality and data risks, staff secondment, and related topics.
Act as a proactive and solution-oriented legal partner, putting forward clear proposals and practical alternatives to enable informed and timely decision-making.
Ensure transparent communication on timelines and deliverables, and commit to respecting agreed deadlines.

4) Governance, Risk & External Counsel Management

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, internal policies, and ethical standards.
Coordinate with Compliance, Data Protection, Procurement, and Digital/IT teams on transversal matters.
Manage external counsel, balancing quality, efficiency, cost control, and effective knowledge sharing.

 Candidate Profile
PROFILE & QUALIFICATIONS

Master’s degree in Law (Business Law, International Law, or equivalent).
4 - 5+ years of experience in an international legal department and/or law firm.
Demonstrated expertise in commercial and services agreements, strategic advisory and consulting contracts, and cross-functional projects.
Experience supporting product/business strategy functions and/or HR (excluding employment law), including facility and workplace services, is a strong asset.
Strong negotiation skills with a business-oriented mindset and sound judgment.
Ability to work autonomously in a complex, multicultural environment, with exposure to senior stakeholders.
Fluency in English is mandatory; French is a strong asset.

KEY COMPETENCIES
In line with the Mission of the Legal Department, the role requires embodying the following core attitudes and competencies:

Taking a stand: Ability to formulate and defend clear legal positions, provide reasoned recommendations, and guide business partners toward sound decisions.
Being a source of proposals: Proactive, solution-driven mindset, offering practical alternatives and value-adding legal strategies.
Listening to Business Partners: Strong active listening skills, with the ability to understand operational constraints and strategic priorities.
Clear communication with Business Partners: Ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, concise, and business-oriented guidance, both orally and in writing.
Communicating timelines (and respecting them): Reliable planning, transparency on deliverables, and commitment to agreed deadlines.

Additionally:

Strategic thinking and pragmatic risk management.
Strong stakeholder and project management skills.
High level of integrity, confidentiality, and ethical standards.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.
Curiosity, resilience, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Whatever your area of expertise, your work within the Servier Group helps advance therapeutic progress for the benefit of patients. You will be part of teams recognized for their scientific excellence and reach your full potential in a professional environment that encourages you to develop yourself. Tailor-made onboarding journeys, mobility opportunities, quality trainings, responsible management, team spirit... All this and more in a workplace focused on your well-being.

At Servier, we are committed to therapeutic progress to serve patient needs. We put the diversity of our employees as a source of richness for the fulfillment of this vocation.

positions.description:
Req ID:520363 

Leading societies to a low carbon future, Alstom develops and markets mobility solutions that provide the sustainable foundations for the future of transportation. Our product portfolio ranges from high-speed trains, metros, monorail, and trams to integrated systems, customised services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility solutions. Joining us means joining a caring, responsible, and innovative company where more than 70,000 people lead the way to greener and smarter mobility, worldwide
PURPOSE OF THE JOB

Take part to major developments by proving that the design is fit for its intended use, through implementation and execution of Verification, Integration and Test activities, fitting the targets in terms of Quality, Cost and Delivery.
Detail and perform all the in-house activities related with Verification, Integration and Testing performed by the V&V team, and interface experts delegated in other departments. Identify if activities need to be exported to Projects or site execution, and follow-up results. Interface with design teams to share and detail the results of V&V activities.

Agree with Verification & Validation manager on strategy, scheduling and budget, and share progress, results and issues during execution.

ORGANISATION
Organisation structure (job belongs to..)
 Development Centers
 
Reports directly to:
V&V Department Head / Group Manager
 
Other reporting to:
Dotted line reporting to Program Verification & Validation Manager
 
Direct reports:
N/A
 
Network & Links
Internal

Internal : Program team (Engineering, Safety, RAM, …)

External

Suppliers (if any)
Auditors and assessors

MAIN RESPONSABILITIES
Key accountabilities:

Contribute to the definition of the Program Verification and Validation strategy in the V&V Plan, and act proactively for its implementation;
Define verification methodology for selected deliverables, when requested in V&V strategy;
Define test plans and test descriptions for in-house activities.
Perform and report allocated verification, integration and test activities;
When Safety is involved, share and justify the results with Safety Assurance Manager to feed the safety demonstration.
Interface with experts in other department to align on selected V&V activity methodology;
Represent Alstom in front of customers or partners, for instance to provide overview of test progress, issues, risks and opportunities;
Specify, procure, develop, setup and configure assets such as testbenches and instrumentation;
Provide data to maintain applicable KPIs;
Provide valuable feedback for REX sessions and continuous improvement;
Manage configuration and change management cycle related with V&V activities (simulation configuration, anomaly tracking etc.);
In Projects, follow-up with T&C for tests exported to site execution.

Performance management:

DNDR (Defect non-Detection Rate)
CPI (Coverage Progress Indicator)
Cooperation and support to KPI Root Cause Analysis

 MAIN REQUIRED COMPETENCES
Educational Requirements
Mandatory:Master’s degree in engineering or scientific topics
 
Experience
Mandatory:

Good analytical skill is required.
Experience in Product development.
Understanding and experience in Software coding.
Knowledge of at least one Alstom platform.

Knowledge of more than one Alstom platform.

positions.description:
Req ID:517855 
 
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
 
 Could you be the full-time Verification, Integration, and Validation Engineer in Charleroi we’re looking for?
 
Your future role
 
Take on a new challenge and apply your verification and validation expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and detail-oriented teammates.
You'll ensure that Alstom’s designs are fit for their intended use by implementing and executing Verification, Integration, and Test activities, all while meeting targets in terms of quality, cost, and delivery. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, safety, RAM, and other departments), align with experts on methodologies, and represent Alstom in discussions with customers, partners, and auditors.
You’ll specifically take care of defining test plans and methodologies, performing allocated verification activities, and managing configurations, but also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and provide valuable feedback during REX sessions.
 
We’ll look to you for:

Contributing to the definition and implementation of the Program Verification and Validation strategy.
Defining verification methodologies and test plans for in-house activities.
Executing and reporting verification, integration, and test activities.
Interfacing with other departments to align on methodologies and share results.
Representing Alstom in discussions with customers, partners, and auditors.
Specifying, procuring, and configuring test assets like testbenches and instrumentation.
Providing data to maintain applicable KPIs and supporting root cause analysis.
Managing configuration and change management cycles related to V&V activities.
Coordinating with T&C for tests exported to site execution.

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
A degree in engineering or a related scientific field (a master’s degree is a plus).
Experience in product development and understanding of software coding.
Good analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of at least one Alstom platform (knowledge of multiple platforms is a plus).
Experience in systems or sub-systems integration, embedded equipment, or electrotechnical product development in a complex and regulated environment (e.g., railway signalling, aerospace, defense, or nuclear) is a significant advantage.
Strong communication skills with proficiency in English (both written and spoken).
An open-minded and entrepreneurial mindset with a sense of urgency.

Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from monotonous routines.
Work with innovative security standards for rail signalling.
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
Contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of mobility.
Utilise our dynamic and inclusive working environment.
Steer your career in whichever direction you choose across functions and countries.
Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning programs.
Progress towards roles such as Program Verification & Validation Manager.
Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).
 
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

positions.description: Fluxys is een internationale energieinfrastructuurgroep met 1.300 personeelsleden actief in gasvervoer en -opslag en terminalling van vloeibaar aardgas. positions.descriptionHtml:
Fluxys is een internationale energieinfrastructuurgroep met 1.300 personeelsleden actief in gasvervoer en -opslag en terminalling van vloeibaar aardgas. 

Als purpose-gedreven bedrijf engageren we ons om snel te schakelen naar een koolstofneutrale wereld. We verkennen nieuwe technologieën en we investeren in infrastructuur om waterstof, biomethaan, CO2 en andere moleculen voor een klimaatneutrale toekomst te vervoeren.

 

Het departement Engineering ondersteunt de activiteiten van Fluxys door o.a. het realiseren van studiedossiers voor zowel de aardgastransportinstallaties, als de installaties voor de andere molecules zoals waterstof en CO2.

Voor het departement Engineering op onze hoofdzetel in Brussel zijn wij op zoek naar een Designer Piping (m/v/x).

 
 
 
 
 
Your responsibilities

 

  • Je voert de ontwerpstudies uit voor onze transportinstallaties (aardgas, waterstof, CO2…) uitgaande van de projectgegevens en de geldende technische standaarden en codes
  • Je staat in voor het opmaken van de piping plannen zoals inplantingsplannen, materiaallijsten, vergunningsdossiers, constructieplannen, isometrieën, …
  • Bij het ontwerp, hou je rekening met aspecten als ergonomie, praktische haalbaarheid, veiligheid en kostprijs
  • Je staat in voor de opvolging en de kwaliteit van verschillende studies
  • Je werkt mee aan het standaardiseren van concepten en materialen; en aan het verwerken van technische feedback
  • Je verzekert mee de kwaliteit van asset data via de as-built dossiers
 
 About you
  • Je hebt een bachelor in een technisch domein of gelijkwaardig door ervaring
  • Minimum 2 jaar relevante ervaring en een ruime, multidisciplinaire technische kennis, bij voorkeur in een industriële of chemische omgeving
  • Ervaring in het domein van piping/pipelines in (Petro-) chemische of industriële installaties is een pluspunt
  • Goede sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden en de capaciteit om zowel in team als zelfstandig te functioneren
  • Een resultaatgerichte, gestructureerde en nauwgezette aanpak
  • Een goede stressbestendigheid en de capaciteit om meerdere projecten gelijktijdig op te volgen
  • De grootste aandacht voor veiligheid
  • Een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands en een goede kennis van het Frans en het Engels
  • Een degelijke kennis van 2D en/of 3D tekenpakketten (Microstation en/of AutoCAD, Plant 3D, …)

Verder vraagt deze functie om:

  • Een rijbewijs B en bij voorkeur een persoonlijk voertuig
 
 Why should you apply?

We offer a very attractive package of extra-legal benefits including a.o.: collective premiums, meal vouchers, hospitalisation and outpatient care insurance for the whole family,  33 holidays, intervention of 30% on your energy bill, pension plan, as well as the possibility of teleworking (depending on the role).

But above all:

  • Contribute and innovate towards a carbon-neutral world
  • Develop and shape a brilliant career in a fast-growing international group
  • Showcase your strong appetite to contribute towards an array of dynamic projects that challenge your intellect

positions.descriptionHtml:
What activities in our department? Starting from a high level description or set of requirements, we do:

  • Architecture design and feasibility

  • HW circuit design (digital/analog design): design circuit diagrams, do board layout, perform all kinds of thermal, signal integrity, high speed, … simulations

  • HW verification to confirm functionality over environmental conditions (e.g. voltage and temp range).

  • Technical follow up of HW qualification and certification according international standards

  • Industrialization and link to manufacturing

NIFN2026

Responsibilities

As an engineer, you will join our HW board designs teams to:

  • Participate in the overall product development cycle from electrical product conception until start of mass production

  • Be part of a multidisciplinary team consisting of system architects, SW engineers and other HW disciplines with daily interaction to third parties, procurement and industrialization teams

  • Help develop the hardware solutions for telecom operators around the world

  • Strengthen the Hardware Design team, showing a strong technical interest

  • Perform feasibility studies
     


 

Qualifications

 You have:

  • Engineering degree or a degree in Electronic (or final-year student)

  • Broad interest in HW design - Broad interest in the Telecom sector

  • Knowledge of qualifications standards (ANSI, ETSI, MII), ECAD design tools (Mentor Graphics/ Valor) and lab experience will be considered an asset

  • Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast paced working environment

  • Creativity and high efficiency

  • “Out-of-the-box” thinking

  • Team-working skills, but also ability to work independently

  • Good reporting skills

  • Passion to work in an international environment across countries and cultures

  • Willingness to travel for regular short-term trips depending on project/customer

  • Fluency in English (oral and written)


 

About Company

Some of our benefits in Belgium:
  • Medical and life insurance plan for health and financial security
  • Flexible working arrangements and additional flex benefits (based on eligibility) to support work–life balance
  • A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
  • Meal allowance to support daily needs
  • Company Car/Car allowance based on eligibility
  • Mobility plan (Parking place, Bike allowance, Subscription to public transport)
  • Transport allowance for convenient commuting
  • Well-being programs to support your mental and physical health
  • Opportunities to engage with Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs), as well as access to mentors, coaches, and Employee Growth Solutions
  • A learning culture that promotes continuous personal and professional growth – for your role and beyond

ontwikkelen en uitdragen van een heldere productvisie voor Container & CI/CD als platformdiensten, met focus op schaalbaarheid, veiligheid en self‑service. 

opstellen en bewaken van een integrale roadmap en backlog voor de twee Product Teams, inclusief prioritering over containerplatformen, CI/CD‑platform capabilities en migratie‑initiatieven. 

afwegen en prioriteren van nieuwe initiatieven, verbeteringen en technische schuld, in nauwe afstemming met de teams en stakeholders. 

zorgen voor samenhang in jouw scope, zodat platformkeuzes elkaar versterken en consistent zijn binnen Automation & Platform Services. 

actief stakeholdermanagement richting stakeholders zoals, platform‑ en applicatieteams en architecten, waarbij je verwachtingen, afhankelijkheden en impact helder maakt.

richting geeft aan een technisch platformdomein, met focus op Developer Experience, platformwaarde en herbruikbaarheid. 

inhoud, prioriteiten en afhankelijkheden scherp houdt in een omgeving met meerdere teams en stakeholders. 

rust en voorspelbaarheid brengt in planning en samenwerking, ook wanneer belangen en tijdsdruk oplopen. 

Daarnaast heb je aantoonbare ervaring en kennis van: 

een Product Owner‑rol binnen platform‑, infrastructuur‑ of CI/CD‑omgevingen. 

werken met container‑ en CI/CD‑platformen (bijv. OpenShift, GitHub), vanuit platform‑ en productperspectief. 

het prioriteren van werk in een technisch specialistische omgeving, in samenhang met architectuur en strategische kaders. 

sterk stakeholder‑ en procesmanagement, inclusief het zelfstandig organiseren van agile werkwijzen. 

samenwerken met Principal Engineers als inhoudelijke sparringpartner, waarbij jij productrichting en prioriteit bewaakt. 

het zelfstandig organiseren van agile werkprocessen.

Goed is goed genoeg    

Je weet wanneer iets goed genoeg is om door te pakken. Je bewaakt de balans tussen kwaliteit en voortgang, maakt onderbouwde keuzes en voorkomt dat perfectie de snelheid of impact vertraagt. Je stimuleert je team om pragmatisch te werken, te leren in het proces en samen continu beter te worden.   

Je werkt met volledig end‑to‑end ownership: je pakt vraagstukken van begin tot eind op, houdt overzicht over het hele proces en zorgt dat resultaten daadwerkelijk landen in de organisatie. Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen strategie, uitvoering en impact en neemt verantwoordelijkheid totdat het écht werkt voor de business.   

Je durft de business en teams actief te challengen, stelt kritische vragen en prikkelt om anders te denken. Je brengt een duidelijke visie mee, combineert ambitie met executiekracht en weet verandering niet alleen te initiëren, maar ook daadwerkelijk te realiseren. Je stimuleert beweging, doorbreekt patronen en zorgt dat verbeteringen echt landen in de organisatie.

positions.title: Product Researcher (Data)
positions.description: In deze rol zorg je dat we minder bouwen op aannames en meer op bewijs. Inzichten verdwijnen niet in een rapport, maar werken direct door in betere productbeslissingen. Je toetst hypotheses, maakt impact meetbaar en helpt teams digitale producten bouwen die echt waarde toevoegen.Word onderdeel van ons teamBij Framna bouwen we digitale producten die ertoe doen, voor marktleiders en organisaties die dat willen worden. We geloven in win by product: ons werk stopt niet bij livegang, maar pas bij aantoonbare impact voor de business van onze partners. Daarom zoeken we mensen die niet alleen meten wat er gebeurt, maar ook valideren of het waarde toevoegt.Als Product Researcher (Data) versterk je een groeiende product discipline waarin onderzoek, experimentatie en meetbaarheid de standaard zijn. Je werkt direct samen met onze Senior Product Researcher, die je coacht in hypothese-gedreven werken en als inhoudelijke sparringpartner naast je staat. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met Product Owners, Designers en Developers aan producten voor partners in onder andere luchtvaart, retail, gezondheidszorg en financiële dienstverlening.Wat je gaat doenIn deze rol zorg je dat productbeslissingen worden genomen op basis van gevalideerd inzicht, niet op gevoel. Je vertaalt businessvragen naar scherpe onderzoeksvragen, daagt aannames uit met bewijs en zorgt dat nieuwe features meetbaar worden opgeleverd.Je werkt mee over de volle breedte van de productcyclus:Bij projectstartJe helpt onderzoeksvragen en toetsbare hypotheses scherp te krijgen, samen met de Senior Product ResearcherJe sluit aan bij product alignment-sessies en helpt succesdefinities en KPI’s concreet te makenJe gebruikt prioriteringsmodellen zoals RICE om scopediscussies van mening naar onderbouwing te brengenTijdens uitvoeringJe begeleidt tracking-implementaties samen met development, bijvoorbeeld in GA4, Firebase en GTMJe schrijft SQL-queries in BigQuery voor data-extractie, funnelanalyses en cohortanalysesJe ontwerpt en draait zelfstandig A/B-tests en gebruikersonderzoeken op basis van heldere hypothesesJe bouwt dashboards in Looker Studio die teams en partners ook echt gebruikenBij afronding en doorwerkingJe vertaalt onderzoeksuitkomsten naar heldere verhalen en concrete aanbevelingenJe bewaakt dat features meetbaar worden opgeleverd en dat learnings terugkomen in het teamJe draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze interne aanpak voor product research en experimentatieWie jij bentKlaar om deze rol echt eigen te maken? Dan denken we dat je goed bij ons past als je:3 tot 5 jaar ervaring hebt met product research, digital analytics of een vergelijkbare data-gedreven productrolSterk bent in GA4 of Firebase, BigQuery en Looker Studio, of vergelijkbare toolingVloeiend bent in SQL en zelfstandig queries schrijft voor extractie, funnelanalyses en cohortanalysesZelfstandig A/B-tests kunt opzetten en interpreteren, en statistische basisprincipes zoals significantie, power en sample size begrijptHypothese-gedreven werkt en start vanuit de vraag wat je wilt weten en waaromSterk bent in data storytelling en analyses altijd vertaalt naar een duidelijke conclusie en concrete vervolgstapStevig genoeg in je schoenen staat om tegenspraak te geven als onderzoek iets anders laat zien dan de heersende aannameNieuwsgierig bent naar de business van partners en pragmatisch werkt: liever een goede beslissing op basis van goed bewijs dan een perfecte analyse waar niemand iets mee doetMooi meegenomenErvaring met GTMErvaring met server-side trackingErvaring met Python, bijvoorbeeld pandas, scipy of statsmodels, voor diepere statistische analysesOver FramnaFramna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega’s aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.Wat je krijgtEen bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.200 en €4.600, afhankelijk van je ervaringPensioenbijdrage van 67%27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen of te verkopenVergoedingen voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerkenEen MacBook en telefoon in bruikleenDagelijkse lunch op de studioPersoonlijke coaching door onze Senior Product ResearcherEen helder ontwikkelpad richting Senior niveauGoed om te wetenVoor deze rol zoeken we een collega die vloeiend Nederlands spreektWij bieden geen visa sponsorship aanHet sollicitatieprocesWil jij meebouwen aan digitale producten waar onderzoek en data echt het verschil maken? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. Binnen vijf werkdagen neemt Ilse of Léon van ons recruitmentteam contact met je op.Klikt het? Dan starten we met een korte online kennismaking. Zijn we daarna allebei nog steeds enthousiast, dan nodigen we je uit in een van onze studios voor een vakinhoudelijk gesprek met de Senior Product Researcher. Klikt het daarna nog steeds? Dan doen we je een aanbod.Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.

In deze rol zorg je dat we minder bouwen op aannames en meer op bewijs. Inzichten verdwijnen niet in een rapport, maar werken direct door in betere productbeslissingen. Je toetst hypotheses, maakt impact meetbaar en helpt teams digitale producten bouwen die echt waarde toevoegen.

Word onderdeel van ons team

Bij Framna bouwen we digitale producten die ertoe doen, voor marktleiders en organisaties die dat willen worden. We geloven in win by product: ons werk stopt niet bij livegang, maar pas bij aantoonbare impact voor de business van onze partners. Daarom zoeken we mensen die niet alleen meten wat er gebeurt, maar ook valideren of het waarde toevoegt.

Als Product Researcher (Data) versterk je een groeiende product discipline waarin onderzoek, experimentatie en meetbaarheid de standaard zijn. Je werkt direct samen met onze Senior Product Researcher, die je coacht in hypothese-gedreven werken en als inhoudelijke sparringpartner naast je staat. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met Product Owners, Designers en Developers aan producten voor partners in onder andere luchtvaart, retail, gezondheidszorg en financiële dienstverlening.

Wat je gaat doen

In deze rol zorg je dat productbeslissingen worden genomen op basis van gevalideerd inzicht, niet op gevoel. Je vertaalt businessvragen naar scherpe onderzoeksvragen, daagt aannames uit met bewijs en zorgt dat nieuwe features meetbaar worden opgeleverd.

Je werkt mee over de volle breedte van de productcyclus:

Bij projectstart

  • Je helpt onderzoeksvragen en toetsbare hypotheses scherp te krijgen, samen met de Senior Product Researcher

  • Je sluit aan bij product alignment-sessies en helpt succesdefinities en KPI’s concreet te maken

  • Je gebruikt prioriteringsmodellen zoals RICE om scopediscussies van mening naar onderbouwing te brengen

Tijdens uitvoering

  • Je begeleidt tracking-implementaties samen met development, bijvoorbeeld in GA4, Firebase en GTM

  • Je schrijft SQL-queries in BigQuery voor data-extractie, funnelanalyses en cohortanalyses

positions.descriptionHtml:
Join us at a pivotal moment in our digital transformation journey. As Product Manager for Workday Platform & Extend, you will shape how one of our most important HR platforms creates value across ING. This is a role for someone who loves turning platform capability into real adoption, scalable outcomes, and better experiences for teams and users across the bank.

The team
You will join the Workday Platform & Extend product team, which supports both the GHR Digital People Solutions and GHR Data Management product families through the management of Workday as a platform. The team is responsible for the base Workday platform and includes Workday Extend development capability. It serves areas such as Workday integrations, Extend apps, Kainos Extend apps, and Workday architecture. The team works across product families, which makes this role highly connected, cross-functional, and central to how value is delivered at scale.

You will work in a product-led environment alongside engineering, architecture, and employee journey expertise, helping translate strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and practical delivery. The team culture is built around collaboration, continuous improvement, strong ownership, and a shared ambition to create secure, reliable, and scalable digital products that make life easier for employees and the business.
 

Roles and responsibilities
In this role, you will lead the product direction for Workday Platform & Extend and help ensure the platform delivers value in a scalable, reusable, and productized way.

  • Shaping the vision and OKRs for the Workday Platform & Extend product team, and translating them into clear priorities and outcomes

  • Prioritising the sprint backlog and day-to-day work, ensuring the team focuses on the highest-value platform opportunities

  • Leading stakeholder engagement with CoEs, consumers, and partner teams to align demand, ownership, and product decisions.

  • Driving adoption of Workday Extend as a reusable internal product capability, moving away from one-off solutions such as Excel-based workarounds, tickets, or fragmented tooling.

  • Ensuring the platform evolves in line with a product-led model, with clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and strong governance.

  • Overseeing delivery in a regulated enterprise environment, with attention to security, permissions, audit requirements, and controlled deployments

  • Steering the quarterly business review process for the product team, consolidating performance metrics and maintaining product visibility through Obeya.

  • Guiding platform and integration choices so Workday can effectively support downstream consumers, including modern integration patterns, APIs, and scalable platform capabilities.


How to succeed
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

To succeed in this role, you will:

  • Create a clear product direction and translate it into strong OKRs, priorities, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Build trusted relationships across product teams, CoEs, and consumers to align demand, ownership, and delivery.

  • Balance innovation with security, compliance, auditability, and platform stability in a large regulated environment.

  • Recognise where reusable platform capabilities can create more value than one-off local solutions, and help teams adopt them.

  • Lead backlog and delivery decisions with confidence, bringing focus to what matters most for the product and its consumers.

  • Understand platform integrations, data flows, and emerging technology well enough to make thoughtful, responsible product decisions, including around AI-enabled capabilities.

  • Experience leading teams is a strong plus.

Rewards and benefits
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. Find out more about our employment conditions.


The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • 25-28 vacation days depending on contract

  • Pension scheme

  • 13th month salary

  • 8% Holiday payment

  • Hybrid working

  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities

  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
    About us
    Curious about how ING empowers people and businesses to move forward?

Discover what we do and what we can offer you.

Questions?
Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.

positions.title: Product Safety Specialist
positions.description: Location: Hengelo, NetherlandsAbout usThe people we all rely on to make the world go round – they rely on Thales. In a world that is increasingly fast-moving, unpredictable and full of opportunities, they come to us with big ambitions: to make life better and to keep you safer. Combining a unique diversity of expertise, talents and cultures, our employees design and deliver extraordinary high-tech solutions. With 68.000 talents working in 54 countries, 2000 employees are based in the Netherlands. We are one of the biggest high-tech employers in the field of safety and security.We help our customers think smarter and act faster in the fields of transportation, defence , space, aerospace and cyberspace, mastering ever-greater complexity and every decisive moment along the way. We are therefore leading the digital transformation, focusing on artificial intelligence, big-data & data analytics, connectivity, mobility and internet of things and cybersecurity.In the Netherlands, we are located in four cities: Huizen, Delft, Eindhoven and Hengelo (HQ). Together with an extensive ecosystem of knowledge partners, customers and suppliers, we work on radars for naval vessels, cyber security solutions, transportation systems, communication equipment for land forces, cryogenic cooling solutions, research & development for radar tech (in collaboration with TU Delft) and research & development for serious gaming (in collaboration with the University of Twente).Product Safety SpecialistAbout the job:Safety engineering is an important and integral part of the development process of our high-end products and composite systems.The Thales safety specialist has the task of analyzing how to ensure the safety of our systems for end users and the on-board maintenance people. Environmental aspects are also taken into account throughout the life cycle of the complex systems we develop.We currently have 25 specialists in the field of safety engineering. As a product safety specialist, you become the first point of contact for the product safety of one or more radar systems or for another product developed in Hengelo. You will not only cover electrical and mechanical safety, but also, for example, functional safety and environmental safety.You will be involved in the quotation phase so that you can determine how legislation, standards, policies and customer requirements affect the safety aspects of the system to be developed. In the specification phase, you start the hazard analysis and record the first safety-related requirements. During the design phase, you will continue with the risk assessment, provide requirements for the product, define mitigations and make recommendations to designers, the product team and project management to bring the design safety risks to an acceptable level.There is a natural linkage between safety requirements and all kinds of other design considerations, but it is up to you to stand up strongly for a system that must meet the safety acceptance criteria. You will continue the actions until delivery of the product to the customer and you will ensure that the burden of proof for product safety is complete. At the end of the development you have created a complete safety case dossier.Thales delivers to customers around the world in different complexity, your playing field is very diverse. You will be faced with both specific customer requirements and generic product requirements. You work with engineers from other disciplines like electrical, mechanical, software and IVVQ engineers during design, development, testing and qualification of Thales systems. Furthermore you work with other safety colleagues, project managers and sometimes directly with the customer or with engineers from other Thales sites or subcontractors. Tenacity, persuasiveness and pragmatism are not strange to you.Because we deliver our systems to customers around the world, your playing field is very diverse. You will be faced with both specific customer requirements and generic product requirements. You work with other engineers from development teams, your safety colleagues, project managers and sometimes directly with the customer or with engineers from other Thales sites or subcontractors. Tenacity, persuasiveness and pragmatism are not strange to you.Thales follows military and internationally recognized standards (such as MIL-STD, DEF-STAN, IEC, EN) and laws and regulations (such as CE, REACH, RoHS) in the field of safety engineering. You know your way in this world and you are able to explain and apply it. Within the field of safety engineering it is possible to further specialize in product safety, functional safety, project safety management, product HSE, safety assurance, and eco-design.Your main tasks are:analyzing customer requirements and translating to safety system requirements;developing a safety management plan;maintaining a hazard log;performing fault tree analyzes;carrying out safety risk assessments related to the design phase;analyzing the system in relation to hazardous substances;advising designers on safety engineering;monitoring developments in the field and to contribute to the development process;collecting safety verification evidence and providing a safety assessment report.About you:We are looking for a new colleague who:Has a completed HBO, WO, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an Engineering domain,;has worked for several years in a safety engineering context and is able to apply safety engineering methods;Is familiar with safety standards, such as IEC 61508, IEC 62368-1, MIL-STD-882;Is familiar with safety legislation, such as LVD, REACH and RoHS.Has a thorough system engineering knowledge and knowledge in the field of electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, software engineering and/or system testing;Is able to see the broad lines, but at the same time has technical depth;Finds it interesting to understand a complex design of hardware and software;Has good analytical and conceptual skills;Is capable of communication and initiative, easy to talk to different people, persistent and persuasive;Is a team player and likes to work in multidisciplinary teams;Dutch nationality is required due to security and defense project regulations;Security screening (AIVD-B) is mandatory.Fluent in Dutch and EnglishWhat's in it for you ?A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.Valuable international collaboration with coworkers from 68 different countries around the globe.A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.You can usually work where and whenever you want. Within Thales, we aim for a 60/40 balance, where you work from home at least two days a week, when your role allows this.A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions: for instance, you can trade PTO for internet costs, our bicycle plan, company fitness and relocation costs.40 days off per year (PTO).Interested?Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.Diversity StatementWe actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.Security RequirementsIn line with Thales' Baseline Security requirements, candidates will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in The Netherlands and employment and/or education history. This vacancy requires a security clearance which can require further evidence to be provided. For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please refer to the General Intelligence and Security Service.#LI-AB4

The Thales safety specialist has the task of analyzing how to ensure the safety of our systems for end users and the on-board maintenance people. Environmental aspects are also taken into account throughout the life cycle of the complex systems we develop.

We currently have 25 specialists in the field of safety engineering. As a product safety specialist, you become the first point of contact for the product safety of one or more radar systems or for another product developed in Hengelo. You will not only cover electrical and mechanical safety, but also, for example, functional safety and environmental safety.

You will be involved in the quotation phase so that you can determine how legislation, standards, policies and customer requirements affect the safety aspects of the system to be developed. In the specification phase, you start the hazard analysis and record the first safety-related requirements. During the design phase, you will continue with the risk assessment, provide requirements for the product, define mitigations and make recommendations to designers, the product team and project management to bring the design safety risks to an acceptable level.

There is a natural linkage between safety requirements and all kinds of other design considerations, but it is up to you to stand up strongly for a system that must meet the safety acceptance criteria. You will continue the actions until delivery of the product to the customer and you will ensure that the burden of proof for product safety is complete. At the end of the development you have created a complete safety case dossier.

Thales delivers to customers around the world in different complexity, your playing field is very diverse. You will be faced with both specific customer requirements and generic product requirements. You work with engineers from other disciplines like electrical, mechanical, software and IVVQ engineers during design, development, testing and qualification of Thales systems. Furthermore you work with other safety colleagues, project managers and sometimes directly with the customer or with engineers from other Thales sites or subcontractors. Tenacity, persuasiveness and pragmatism are not strange to you.

Because we deliver our systems to customers around the world, your playing field is very diverse. You will be faced with both specific customer requirements and generic product requirements. You work with other engineers from development teams, your safety colleagues, project managers and sometimes directly with the customer or with engineers from other Thales sites or subcontractors. Tenacity, persuasiveness and pragmatism are not strange to you.

Thales follows military and internationally recognized standards (such as MIL-STD, DEF-STAN, IEC, EN) and laws and regulations (such as CE, REACH, RoHS) in the field of safety engineering. You know your way in this world and you are able to explain and apply it. Within the field of safety engineering it is possible to further specialize in product safety, functional safety, project safety management, product HSE, safety assurance, and eco-design.

Your main tasks are:

  • analyzing customer requirements and translating to safety system requirements;
  • developing a safety management plan;
  • maintaining a hazard log;
  • performing fault tree analyzes;
  • carrying out safety risk assessments related to the design phase;
  • analyzing the system in relation to hazardous substances;
  • advising designers on safety engineering;
  • monitoring developments in the field and to contribute to the development process;
  • collecting safety verification evidence and providing a safety assessment report.

About you:

We are looking for a new colleague who:

  • Has a completed HBO, WO, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an Engineering domain,;
  • has worked for several years in a safety engineering context and is able to apply safety engineering methods;
  • Is familiar with safety standards, such as IEC 61508, IEC 62368-1, MIL-STD-882;
  • Is familiar with safety legislation, such as LVD, REACH and RoHS.
  • Has a thorough system engineering knowledge and knowledge in the field of electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, software engineering and/or system testing;
  • Is able to see the broad lines, but at the same time has technical depth;
  • Finds it interesting to understand a complex design of hardware and software;
  • Has good analytical and conceptual skills;
  • Is capable of communication and initiative, easy to talk to different people, persistent and persuasive;
  • Is a team player and likes to work in multidisciplinary teams;
  • Dutch nationality is required due to security and defense project regulations;
  • Security screening (AIVD-B) is mandatory.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English

What's in it for you ?

  • A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.

  • Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.

  • Valuable international collaboration with coworkers from 68 different countries around the globe.

  • A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.

  • You can usually work where and whenever you want. Within Thales, we aim for a 60/40 balance, where you work from home at least two days a week, when your role allows this.

  • A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions: for instance, you can trade PTO for internet costs, our bicycle plan, company fitness and relocation costs.

  • 40 days off per year (PTO).

Interested?

Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.

To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.

A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.

Diversity Statement

We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.

Security Requirements

In line with Thales' Baseline Security requirements, candidates will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in The Netherlands and employment and/or education history. This vacancy requires a security clearance which can require further evidence to be provided. For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please refer to the General Intelligence and Security Service.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.
 


About the team

QCS (Quality and Customer Satisfaction) is responsible for assuring the quality of operational activities (such as bids, projects, products and services) and supporting the maturity growth and performance improvement of the organisation. We do this to improve customer satisfaction and to drive competitiveness.

QCS enhances the ownership of operational teams for the quality of their output and strengthens the learning, improvement and problem-solving capabilities of these teams. QCS develops the maturity of the organisation as a whole by leveraging operational best practices and provides an independent view on operational performance to senior management.

About your future job

As a QAM, you contribute to bids, projects and products through assuring the quality thereof and motivating, coaching and supporting the relevant teams in execution of their tasks in line with relevant processes/governance, risk and opportunity management and problem solving.

The main tasks are:

  • Makes sure that the technical and non-technical requirements of the Customer are recorded, understood and managed efficiently by all the members of the Project team.

  • Ensures that the project deliverables comply with the customer’s requirements and with the applicable norms and standards.

  • Guides the Project team in defining and adjusting the Project reference system, and validates the resulting plans. Adjusts Quality Assurance actions to make sure they focus on the risks, taking into account the maturity of the Project team.

  • Assesses the execution of the Project (in relation to the plans): Evaluates deliverables through peer reviews, and ensures visibility through QA assessments, that features in the monthly project dashboards.

  • Makes sure that measures are planned and taken to reduced risks and make the most of opportunities relating to outsourced work.

You will have autonomy to fulfil your activities while maintaining the perspective of the customer and ensure that products, systems and processes meet the highest quality standards.

In addition, you will be involved in (transversal) problem solving and Root Cause Analysis, internal assessments and other improvement initiatives. Training in tools and practices will explicitly be part of your onboarding program and personal development

Why you'd be a good match

  • Bachelor or Master degree in technology, engineering and/or (business) management.

  • Profound interest in risks, processes, quality, problem solving and improvement.

  • Strong knowledge of Engineering process steps (Hardware and Software lifecycle).

  • Experience with Agile Software development.

  • An analytical thinker with an open and curious mind and excellent communication and writing skills.

  • Ability to work in a dynamic, complex and multi-national environment wherein you connect with and influence various stakeholders in order to create (quality) awareness and challenge the status quo.

  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues and teams in all layers of our organization.

What's in it for you 

  • A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.

  • Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills. 

  • Valuable international collaboration with coworkers from 68 different countries around the globe. 

  • A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.

  • You can usually work where and whenever you want. Within Thales, we aim for a 60/40 balance, where you work from home at least two days a week, when your role allows this.

  • A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions: for instance, you can trade PTO for internet costs, our bicycle plan, company fitness and relocation costs.

  • 40 days off per year (PTO).

Location

The role is current based in Huizen. In December 2026 the office will relocate to Amsterdam Zuidoost.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

About the team
The Product Line Manager Mission Systems reports to the Product Segment Manager Mission Systems team and the Product Line Manager of the Above Water Systems Business Line. The role itself is part of the Segment Systems in the One Naval business.

About your future job

The goal of the Product Line Manager (PLM) Mission Systems is to maximize competitiveness for the mid segment product portfolio in the Mission Systems market, contributing to the overall performance of the Product Line Above Water Systems (AWS). With the approved Product Line Strategic Plan as guidance, the PLM safeguards the attractiveness of the product line Mission Systems in the global market. A mid segment Mission System is offered for patrol vessels, corvettes and frigates including system engineering, Mission System Integration services and Integrated Logistic Support. An Integrated Mission System itself comprises a Combat Management System, sensors, effectors, communication and navigation systems.


The PLM Mission Systems has a proven experience in product management and demonstrable knowledge of systems-of-systems. The PLM is able to translate market and customer needs to an attractive and competitive Mission System. The PLM communicates clearly with a wide range of stakeholders and is able to manage the product in all its phases throughout the lifecycle.
The PLM Mission Systems will contribute to the AWS Strategic Business Plan.

The main tasks of the PLM Mission Systems
From market studies to product withdrawal, the PLM Mission Systems is responsible for the entire Mission System lifecycle. Tasks include but are not limited to:

  • Analyzing the global market, customer needs and trends, competition from marketing data and business intelligence;
  • Maintaining the standard solution offering for the mid segment of the Mission System Market; 
  • Proposing innovations on Systems level and presents the Mission Systems roadmap;
  • Supporting the marketing, business development and sales teams for the product promotion and marketing activities;
  • Working closely with the PLM AWS on Business Line AWS level.

Competences (based on the Thales leadership model)

The PLM Mission Systems:

  • Anticipates future customer requirements and reflects these in standardized products offerings for multiple customers and projects;
  • Deals well with complexity, is able to assess both operational and strategic outcomes and turn this into clear decision-making information;
  • Engages with the diverse stakeholders to deliver business goals using effective communication strategies;
  • Drives accountability within the product team for delivering innovative and compelling products & services in line with promised delivery schedules and quality;
  • Continuously challenges & inspires the team and their surroundings to look for smarter and more competitive product, services and solutions to create the best value for our customers.

Why you'd be a good match
You are a recognized professional in a complex technical environment with solid business acumen and an ability to engage easily with various stakeholders in the Defense & Security domain. Your drive to improve and succeed helps the Naval business develop new potential in the global Mission Systems market. 

We are looking for a new colleague who:

  • Brings Mission Systems to the next level with a clear business vision 
  • Has multi-year experience in bids and/or projects and/or products in the defense and/or security domain
  • Has a proven experience in product management and demonstrable knowledge of systems-of-systems
  • Has a strong understanding of the global defense and security market and can demonstrate a good technical understanding  
  • Demonstrates a strong self-direction with a high level of commitment and drive 
  • Obtained a Bachelor or Master degree in a relevant study area

Level of responsibility: LR 10 VKG 80

What's in it for you 

  • A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
  • Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills. 
  • Valuable international collaboration with coworkers from 68 different countries around the globe. 
  • A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.
  • You can usually work where and when you want to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
  • A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions: for instance, you can trade days off for internet costs, our bicycle plan, company fitness and relocation costs.
  • 40 days off per year (PTO). Yes, really.


Interested?
Reach out for more information to our Talent Acquisition Partner Gerlof Jan Heck, via gerlofjan.heck@thalesgroup.com or +31 (0) 638697390.

Would you like to apply directly? Then click on the link to show your interest.

To ensure that we are a good match, we can ask you to participate in an assessment.

positions.description: Company Description:Wat doe je als Product Owner bij Coolblue?Je bent als Product Owner verantwoordelijk voor een product dat je gebruikers vooruit helpt. In een multidisciplinair scrum team werk je intensief samen met Analisten, Developers, Customer Journey Specialists en andere Product Owners. Samen werk je aan ideeën om je product te verbeteren. Je prioriteert deze ideeën en verdeelt ze met je development team in behapbare stukken om maximale waarde voor de klant te leveren. Tegelijkertijd presenteer je jouw visie en de roadmap voor de komende kwartalen op directieniveau.Er staan meerdere vacatures open en we bepalen samen welk domein het beste bij je past. Company Description:

Wat doe je als Product Owner bij Coolblue?

Je bent als Product Owner verantwoordelijk voor een product dat je gebruikers vooruit helpt. In een multidisciplinair scrum team werk je intensief samen met Analisten, Developers, Customer Journey Specialists en andere Product Owners. Samen werk je aan ideeën om je product te verbeteren. Je prioriteert deze ideeën en verdeelt ze met je development team in behapbare stukken om maximale waarde voor de klant te leveren. Tegelijkertijd presenteer je jouw visie en de roadmap voor de komende kwartalen op directieniveau.

Er staan meerdere vacatures open en we bepalen samen welk domein het beste bij je past. Als één van de +-40 Product Owners focus jij je op een onderdeel van de klantreis, een data product, tooling voor collega's en/of onze infrastructuur.

Ook Product Owner worden bij Coolblue? Lees hieronder of het bij je past.

  • Stakeholdermanagement: Hoe bereik je het beste resultaat binnen jouw domein?
  • Op een snelle manier aannames valideren 
  • Impactvolle keuzes maken door te bepalen wat we nu moeten doen en wat ook later kan.
  • Wensen op waarde beoordelen door te bepalen welke verzoeken echt belangrijk zijn.

  • Op dit moment werken wij hybride: dat betekent een combinatie tussen werken op kantoor en werken vanuit huis. Natuurlijk zorgen we dat je thuis een top werkplek hebt. Inclusief bureaustoel, laptop en blauwe slingers.
Qualifications:
  • Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring als Product Owner van meerdere teams in een agile werkomgeving.
  • Zeer fanatiek op data-driven decisions en ronduit fan van technologie.
  • Bouwt gemakkelijk een goede band op met stakeholders en development teams. 
  • Bewaakt grenzen en weet de juiste afwegingen te maken bij business verzoeken.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

Wat doe je als Product Journey Manager bij Coolblue?

Als Product Journey Manager bepaal je welke informatie écht telt voor klanten in hun zoektocht en verwerk je dit in de productreis. Je zorgt ervoor dat productinformatie klopt en duidelijk op de site staat, zodat klanten nooit om de tuin worden geleid. Je doet zoekwoordonderzoek om SEO-resultaten en verkeer te verbeteren en ontdekt nieuwe kansen in het assortiment. Je werkt samen met Media Consultants, Commercial Product Managers en Product Redacteuren om de klantreis steeds slimmer te maken. Zo help je klanten sneller het juiste product te vinden en maak je het team elke dag een beetje beter.

Dit vind je leuk om te doen  

  • Contentpagina’s bijwerken zodat klanten de juiste keuze kunnen maken.
  • SEO-strategieën bedenken die zorgen voor meer organisch verkeer.
  • Navigatie en filters aanpassen om klanten sneller naar hun product te leiden.
  • Storefronts bouwen en onderhouden met advies dat écht helpt.
  • Klantgedrag analyseren om conversie en klanttevredenheid te verhogen.
Job Description:
  • Geld.
  • Ongekend goede werksfeer. Waar we met elkaar omgaan als vrienden en je gewoon jezelf kan zijn. 
  • Maandelijkse borrels, versbereide happen, legendarische Coolblue-feesten en de leukste teamactiviteiten.
  • Een fijne combinatie van werken op kantoor en vanuit huis. Natuurlijk zorgen we dat je thuis een top werkplek hebt. Inclusief bureaustoel, laptop en blauwe slingers.
  • Alle ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën, initiatieven en keuzes. Jij doet je werk op jouw manier.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding, pensioenregeling en een vergoeding voor als je thuiswerkt.
  • 25 vakantiedagen. Als je belooft dat je terugkomt.
  • Een kantoor waar je foto's van wilt maken op een toplocatie. Vanaf Rotterdam Centraal is het 3 keer vallen voor je er bent. Oké, het is 2 minuten lopen.
Qualifications:
  • Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in de richting van Commercie of Marketing.
  • Minimaal een jaar ervaring in een klantreisgerichte functie
  • De Nederlandse taal beheers je tot in de puntjes.
  • Goed met cijfers. Je weet data te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en actiepunten. 
  • Verkoopkansen herken je als geen ander want je bent strategisch en commercieel.
  • Ambitieus in het stellen van doelstellingen en het pakken van de verantwoordelijkheid om dit te realiseren.
  • Inleven in klanten om hun (product)behoeften te achterhalen.
Additional Information:

Als Product Journey Manager zorg je voor een complete en consistente productreis van het productassortiment. Je trekt de juiste klanten aan, helpt hen kiezen en zorgt ervoor dat ze het juiste product kopen. Je schakelt snel, behoudt het overzicht en maakt keuzes die het verschil maken. Zo maak je Coolblue elke dag een beetje beter.
