positions.descriptionHtml:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The CXSD (Customer Experience and Solution Design) team at Roche Diagnostics is seeking a passionate Product Designer Intern. The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of Graphical User Interface Design and experience with electronics integration in physical products (e.g., Arduino/Electronics).


As an Interaction Designer Intern, you will support product design teams on different projects and design tasks. You will learn how senior designers translate business/technical requirements and user needs into design decisions. You will experience how to navigate and apply a complex design system to Graphical User Interfaces. You will grasp how to design for customer centricity by validating your design output through continuous user testing.

Last but not least, you will be part of a design team of more than 80 professionals who aim to transform the healthcare industry for the better.

The Opportunity

  • Working on projects with focus on making healthcare professionals work life more safe and easy

  • Building and orchestrating user experiences beyond screens

  • Being involved in ideating, building, iterating and preparing user experiences until hand-over stage for engineers to integrate it in a product

  • Support usability testings with planning, preparation, conducting and analyzing activities

  • Learn how to involve different persons from business roles to engineering to test participants and more to build the best UX ever

  • Building software and Arduino prototypes

  • Integrate electronics for human  interaction and machine feedback into medium-high-ultra fidelity physical prototypes/mockups

  • Joining a highly motivated and very kind team

  • There will be at least one business trip to Germany

Who You Are

  • EU/EFTA Students: You are currently enrolled in your Bachelor's studies or a Master’s program in Computer Science, UX design, Human Computer Interaction Design, visual design or technical science or similar 

  • Non-EU/EFTA students: Due to regulations, you have to provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory and upload it together with your application documents. Furthermore, you have to be enrolled during the entire internship period.

  • You have experience with Figma (showcasing a project is required)

  • You have experience with Arduino and processing (showcasing a project is required)

  • You have skills in design for User Experience, User Interfaces and User Interaction with hardware and software projects, 

  • You are fluent in English

Additional Information

  • The internship will take place in Rotkreuz, Switzerland.

  • The preferred start date of the internship is August 2026 or upon availability for 12 months.

  • Part-time employment is not possible. 

  • This internship is not suitable for a Master's thesis.

  • We are looking forward to receiving your portfolio and CV. 

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

 

 

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Last but not least, you will be part of a design team of more than 80 professionals who aim to transform the healthcare industry for the better.

The Opportunity

- Working on projects with focus on making healthcare professionals work life more safe and easy
- Building and orchestrating user experiences beyond screens
- Being involved in ideating, building, iterating and preparing user experiences until hand-over stage for engineers to integrate it in a product
- Support usability testings with planning, preparation, conducting and analyzing activities
- Learn how to involve different persons from business roles to engineering to test participants and more to build the best UX ever
- Building software and Arduino prototypes
- Integrate electronics for human interaction and machine feedback into medium-high-ultra fidelity physical prototypes/mockups
- Joining a highly motivated and very kind team
- There will be at least one business trip to Germany
Who You Are

- EU/EFTA Students: You are currently enrolled in your Bachelor's studies or a Master’s program in Computer Science, UX design, Human Computer Interaction Design, visual design or technical science or similar
- Non-EU/EFTA students: Due to regulations, you have to provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory and upload it together with your application documents. Furthermore, you have to be enrolled during the entire internship period.
- You have experience with Figma (showcasing a project is required)
- You have experience with Arduino and processing (showcasing a project is required)
- You have skills in design for User Experience, User Interfaces and User Interaction with hardware and software projects,
- You are fluent in English
Additional Information

- The internship will take place in Rotkreuz, Switzerland.
- The preferred start date of the internship is August 2026 or upon availability for 12 months.
- Part-time employment is not possible.
- This internship is not suitable for a Master's thesis.
- We are looking forward to receiving your portfolio and CV.
Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

 Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to play a major role in the company. The position entails a high level of responsibility within the Product team. Your contribution will have a significant impact on the satisfaction of hundreds of our happy customers. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Define the user experience for new and existing product capabilities.
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers as well as customers across multiple agile teams.
  • Develop wireframes and prototypes to communicate interaction and design ideas.
  • Create effective design solutions to complex problems—easy to understand, aesthetically appealing and consistent user experience.
  • Spend time meeting customers and users to discover their needs and test both early prototypes and released features.
  • Collaborate with visual designers to improve and augment the design system.
Qualifications:
  • 7+ years of experience as a product designer, user experience designer, interaction designer, or in a similar role
  • BSc in design, human-computer interaction (HCI), or equivalent professional experience
  • Technical background or experience designing technical products is a plus.
  • Experience designing complex enterprise applications (not just websites) is a must
  • Expert knowledge of Figma
  • Experience developing and maintaining good design system components in Figma is a plus
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and workflows (e.g., Figma Make, code↔design features, MCP) and experience using them to accelerate ideation, prototyping, and handoff is preferred
  • Excellent attention to detail, with a commitment to putting the user first
  • Effective communicator, presenter, and negotiator
  • Full professional proficiency in English (spoken and written), French is a plus
  • Online portfolio or work samples demonstrating a variety of user-centered design solutions

If you are highly motivated and result-driven, have a high sense of product ownership, constantly learning and enhancing your skills, are open to feedback, and like being accountable and working within a team, do not hesitate to apply.

Please apply with a copy of your CV in English and a link to your portfolio.

Additional Information:

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Join Nexthink, a global leader in enterprise software and part of Switzerland’s world-renowned Deep Tech powerhouse. You’ll work in a thriving innovation hub recognized for cutting-edge technology, world-class talent, and groundbreaking projects shaping the digital workplace of the future. Check what we offer:  

  • 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package. 
  • 📍 Beautiful office with a view of Lake Geneva, conveniently located next to the Prilly-Malley train station. 
  • 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work. 
  • 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 25 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days. 
  • 🤸 Free access to a fitness centre inside the building. 
  • 🚞 Reimbursement of the half-fare travel card for public transport.  
  • 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement up to 50% of the cost of French classes. 
  • 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, and soft drinks as well.  
  • 🤝 Regular company and team events like Voluntary Days, Pizza talks, Team Building activities, hosting Meetups at the office and more! 
  • 📣  Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment. 
  • 🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country. 

Please note that NOT all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

positions.descriptionHtml:
icebreaker is looking for an exceptional Global Apparel Designer to join our Product team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Driven by the belief that nature has the answers, we provide natural performance alternatives to synthetic-based apparel, to create a healthier and more sustainable future for our species and the planet. We're passionate about connecting people to natural alternatives.

We continue to launch campaigns and activities to enable people to better understand how their clothes are made, what they are made of and how moving to natural alternatives can make a positive impact. The constant pursuit of better is what drives our progress. We're not perfect, but we're looking for solutions that make a positive difference. 

Let’s Talk about the Role

Be part of the Global Apparel Product Creation team at icebreaker. The primary responsibilities of the Global Apparel Designer are to conceptualize, design and execute creative projects for the global product and creative department's needs. This includes Men's and Women's apparel.

Utilize design skills to create product that meets expectations in terms of value and cost.

Interact constantly with category team members in development and product management to deliver the appropriate execution for the target consumer audience.

Ensure design practicality and meet merchandising business needs.

Strive to create styles which meet relevant trends, whilst also staying true to brand. 

You will be responsible for designing technical apparel using natural fibres.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

  • Support seasonal storytelling and colour direction, by thorough trend, market and competitor research which informs creating mood and concept boards.

  • Work in close partnership with the Product Director, Senior Design manager, Developer, Tech Designer and Merchandiser on the designated category / style.

  • Support in the design, development, approval and usage of all trims.

  • Collaborate with the product development team to ensure style, fit, quality, detail requirements.

  • Meet expectations on accuracy and on-time delivery along product calendar.

  • Facilitate agile decision making on prototype review and revision.

  • Produce thorough tech packs in illustrator with detailed drawings to convey direction for the development team to understand with ease.

Skills for Success

You should be collaborative, flexible, positive and a problem solver, with:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of apparel product design with similar brand(s) or organization(s).

  • Languages: Fluent English essential; additional language is a plus.

  • Portfolio of work which demonstrates; various skills, design and development knowledge, relevancy, and consumer awareness

  • Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Proficiency in 3D Product Creation Software eg: Browswear, CLO.

  • Microsoft Office.

  • Knowledgeable in construction and pattern cutting executions.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast environment and the flexibility to manage and adapt to change.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills.

  • Ability to work within a cross-functional team which supports project management and development.

  • Strong collaboration skills with cross functional teams, finding solutions with the consumer always at forefront of mind.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Strong presentation skills.

A University Bachelor or Master’s degree in in Fashion / Product Design or equivalent is required.

About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

  • A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

  • An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

  • Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

  • On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

  • A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

  • Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity 

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

positions.description: icebreaker is looking for an exceptional Technical Designer to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.Driven by the belief that nature has the answers, we provide natural performance alternatives to synthetic-based apparel, to create a healthier and more sustainable future for our species and the planet. We're passionate about connecting people to natural alternatives.Let’s Talk about the RoleAs Technical Designer, you will be accountable for creating tools to support the execution of the icebreaker product line through the GTM process from concept to finished goods ensuring alignment with the brand strategy, global business needs, sourcing capabilities and quality standards.This role plays a critical part in the precise execution of industry leading product to design intent, collaborating cross functionally with a multi-season time horizon perspective.A key member of the product creation team you will support and enable the Manager, Technical Design’s vision on product fit, applying technical know-how in patternmaking construction and precision digital modelling tools transforming product concepts into reality to drive business growth.How You Will Make a DifferenceConcept Translation & Technical Realisation: Work closely with the Design and Product Development teams to interpret and translate creative concepts into accurate physical and digital patterns using advanced pattern-making techniques. Leverage CAD and digital pattern tools to create detailed and scalable patterns. Develop digital 3D product samples that enable virtual fittings and iterative adjustments. Utilize 3D modelling software to simulate garment behaviour, ensuring that design intent aligns with technical feasibility and ergonomic performance. Your work will ensure that every idea is effectively translated into products that meet the brand’s strategic and commercial objectives.End-to-End Product Excellence: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine patterns, troubleshoot fit challenges, and implement innovative solutions ensuring that the design intent is accurately realised in every product. positions.descriptionHtml:
icebreaker is looking for an exceptional Technical Designer to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Driven by the belief that nature has the answers, we provide natural performance alternatives to synthetic-based apparel, to create a healthier and more sustainable future for our species and the planet. We're passionate about connecting people to natural alternatives.

Let’s Talk about the Role

As Technical Designer, you will be accountable for creating tools to support the execution of the icebreaker product line through the GTM process from concept to finished goods ensuring alignment with the brand strategy, global business needs, sourcing capabilities and quality standards.

This role plays a critical part in the precise execution of industry leading product to design intent, collaborating cross functionally with a multi-season time horizon perspective.

A key member of the product creation team you will support and enable the Manager, Technical Design’s vision on product fit, applying technical know-how in patternmaking construction and precision digital modelling tools transforming product concepts into reality to drive business growth.

How You Will Make a Difference

  • Concept Translation & Technical Realisation: Work closely with the Design and Product Development teams to interpret and translate creative concepts into accurate physical and digital patterns using advanced pattern-making techniques. Leverage CAD and digital pattern tools to create detailed and scalable patterns. Develop digital 3D product samples that enable virtual fittings and iterative adjustments. Utilize 3D modelling software to simulate garment behaviour, ensuring that design intent aligns with technical feasibility and ergonomic performance. Your work will ensure that every idea is effectively translated into products that meet the brand’s strategic and commercial objectives.

  • End-to-End Product Excellence: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine patterns, troubleshoot fit challenges, and implement innovative solutions ensuring that the design intent is accurately realised in every product. Seek manufacturing improvement initiatives with an emphasis on fit and optimal garment performance to ensure they are continually upgraded, enhanced and the best they can be.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise between internal departments (Innovation, Design, Product Development,) and external stakeholders (Vendor base). Establish strong working relationships, facilitate transparent communication and collaboration to ensure seamless integration of design aesthetics with technical precision. Communicate effectively to relay fit issues, propose adjustments, and align on quality benchmarks.

  • Project Management: Manage project timelines for assigned seasonal and non-seasonal products, following critical paths to ensure cross functional alignment and on-time delivery of on-time delivery of digital patterns, virtual prototype samples and SMS across all categories. Use agile methodologies to manage timelines while proactively troubleshooting challenges to keep projects on time, to a precise standard of execution.

  • Data Management: Maintain and regularly update the digital pattern and virtual samples database, ensuring integrity and accuracy across all product lines facilitating seamless, on-time communication between the Product Development, Design, Merchandising, and Sourcing teams.

  • Product Fitting: Prepare for sample reviews by measuring, pre-fitting and scheduling fit sessions. Guide the Product Development and Design Teams in fit sessions to assess and refine product fit, function, and construction towards desired outcomes without compromising comfort, performance or sustainability. Complete pattern revisions on-time, that enable vendors to execute products efficiently and at cost (SMS & Bulk production).

  • Continuous Improvement & Feedback: Analyse market feedback and wear-test and product performance data to continuously refine existing products and influence future development efforts towards process improved product fit, comfort, and functionality. Actively seek opportunities for personal growth, with a focus on developing product category knowledge & expertise.

Skills for Success

  • Vision: A trained eye for proportion and balance as well as aesthetic detail. Identify and anticipate evolving trends in fit, performance, and digital prototyping, ensuring that patterns meet both current market demands and future innovations that keep icebreaker at the forefront of the industry.

  • Values: A commitment to sustainability, ethical production practices, together with a meticulous approach to ensuring precise execution in fit and quality construction.

  • Expertise: A robust understanding of garment engineering, traditional and digital patternmaking/grading, 3D modelling and fit optimisation to support the design and development of innovative, performance apparel.

  • Collaboration: Demonstrated success working in cross-functional teams. Ability to effectively partner with, Designers, Product Developers, and external parties to turn creative visions into production-ready realities.

  • Communication: Able to succinctly translate complex pattern and fit details into clear, actionable guidance for internal teams and external vendors towards pre-determined project objectives.

  • Agility: Able to organise and prioritise workload across multi-phase product development projects with an understanding of critical path and process management. Flexibility to work and travel in an international context across regions and associated time zones, at times requiring meeting attendance early mornings or evenings.

  • Professionalism: Exceptional time management and good interpersonal skills with an emphasis on embracing an inclusive culture of excellence and respect within the team and across all stakeholder relationships. Deals with conflict and challenges with an objective and calm approach.

Education & Experience

  • A University Bachelor or Master’s degree in Fashion Technology, Industrial Design, or equivalent combination of education and experience a related field is required. Advanced degrees or certifications in digital patternmaking and 3D prototyping are advantageous.

  • Good level of computer literacy is essential; proficient in Microsoft Office & Adobe CC with experience in CAD software (Gerber, Lectra, Optitex) and 3D modelling simulation tools (CLO 3D, Browzwear).

  • A few years of experience in technical pattern engineering and digital product creation roles within the apparel industry. Experience in the outdoor performance or sustainable apparel sector is highly preferred.

About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

  • A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

  • An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

  • Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

  • On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

  • A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

  • Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity 

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

positions.descriptionHtml:
The North Face EMEA is looking for a Digital Designer to join our eCommerce Content team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Live the Brand

The North Face is the premier exploration company in the world. We spark curiosity. We dare to disrupt. We create communities. And we lead with integrity. We are a community of explorers and are constantly looking for new ideas, places and people to connect with.

Let's Talk about the Role

As a Digital Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the visual and UX expression of The North Face’s digital presence across EMEA.

This role is responsible for creating high‑quality digital assets, supporting UX‑driven page experiences, and ensuring consistent, premium brand executions across our eCommerce platforms. You will collaborate closely with content, creative, brand and development teams to deliver visually compelling, on‑brand digital experiences that inspire exploration and drive performance.

The ideal candidate is a hybrid thinker—both creative and detail‑oriented—who brings strong digital design skills, a solid understanding of UX/UI principles, and a passion for translating brand storytelling into elevated digital executions.

What You Will Do:

Digital Design

  • Create digital assets for The North Face EMEA websites, including homepage modules, landing pages, campaign banners, and graphic elements for paid media, digital loyalty activations and newsletters.

  • Apply UX/UI principles to ensure designs are user‑centric, responsive, aligned with WCAG conformance levels and best‑in‑class digital experiences.

  • Maintain digital consistency by upholding visual guidelines, typography, and design systems across all touchpoints.

Content Production & CMS Management

  • Work hands‑on in our Content Management System (CoreMedia) to support content creation across site experiences.

  • Ensure all designed assets are optimized for desktop and mobile, following platform and performance requirements.

  • Support content implementation and troubleshoot design‑related issues during publishing cycles.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with eCommerce, Brand, Creative, and Development teams to align on design briefs, requirements, and campaign needs.

  • Work with content & production teams to test, refine, and quality‑check assets before going live.

  • Collaborate with developers to resolve design discrepancies and submit JIRA tickets for bugs, refinements, or layout fixes.

Skills For Success:

Education

Bachelor’s or master's degree in Digital Design, Graphic Design, Communication Design, or a related field.

Experience

  • A few years of experience in digital design, graphic design, or UX/UI design—ideally within eCommerce, retail, or lifestyle brands.

  • Proven portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, layout, and digital experience creation.

Core Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Illustrator, and Adobe Creative Cloud.

  • Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, digital typography, responsive design, and visual hierarchy.

  • Organized, detail‑oriented, and able to manage multiple projects in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to work collaboratively across technical and creative teams.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and ticketing systems within production workflows (e.g. JIRA).

  • Experience in outdoor, sports, fashion, or lifestyle brands.

  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS is a plus (not required).

  • Passion for The North Face brand, creativity, and the outdoor world.

What's in it for you?

  • Be part of iconic lifestyle brands

  • Join a multi brand and multi countries organization to drive you career forward

  • International and challenging working culture

  • On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

  • Discount 50% on all VF brands

  • Subsidized canteen as well as break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

positions.descriptionHtml:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Senior Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to create the design of equipment, systems, or installations or modifies the pre-engineered designs for assignments by applying standard design concepts. Each day, you will assist in designing engineering solutions, including drawings and calculations according to specification. You will also showcase your expertise by participating in design reviews and design verification and modifying the design, as necessary.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supporting the preparation of specific aspects of design assignments to meet the contractual obligations, adhering to safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.

  • Ensuring that Bill of Materials for the project meets contractual obligations.

  • Assisting technical risk assessments and implements the resulting actions in their projects.

  • Participating in workshops pertaining to engineering design, tools, and processes.


Qualifications for the role

Job Description:

The opportunity

For our Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zurich‑Oerlikon, we are looking for an R&D Designer to strengthen our Interrupter Development team within High Voltage Circuit Breaker development.

In this role, you will contribute to product design and development activities within our CAD/PLM landscape for ongoing R&D projects. The position is part of the Interrupter Development team and works closely with the responsible R&D engineers within product development projects. You will be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and quality of 3D/2D model data for assigned components and assemblies, supporting virtual product development from prototype phase to serial production.

Are you looking for technical challenges in a fast‑paced development environment? Do you quickly grasp technical topics and enjoy working through different viewpoints to reach robust technical solutions? Do you like solving complex design tasks in close collaboration with experienced engineers? Then this position offers the right opportunity for you. Join our team and contribute to the development of high‑quality high‑voltage products in an international working environment in Zurich.

How you’ll make an impact
 

  • Take responsibility for the 3D/2D CAD/PLM implementation from concept design to series production within product development projects on high voltage switching devices

  • Create, modify and analyze the design of selected components and assemblies of switching devices in close collaboration with R&D Engineers, and collaborate and support other project stakeholders, such as supply chain and product care

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our CAD/PLM/SAP related processes and activities and drive the overall model quality

positions.description:
Req ID:511487 
 
À la tête des entreprises qui s’engagent vers un avenir plus vert, Alstom développe et commercialise des solutions de mobilité qui apportent les fondements durables pour l'avenir des transports. Notre portefeuille de produits s'étend des trains à grande vitesse, métros, monorails et tramways jusqu’aux systèmes intégrés, services sur mesure, infrastructures, signalisation et solutions de mobilité numérique. Nous rejoindre, c'est rejoindre une entreprise bienveillante, responsable et innovante où plus de 80 000 personnes ouvrent la voie à une mobilité plus verte et plus intelligente, dans le monde entier
 Pourriez-vous être l’Ingénieur System Designer Operation à Saint-Ouen que nous recherchons ?
Votre futur rôle
Relevez un nouveau défi et mettez à profit votre expertise en conception de systèmes dans un domaine de pointe. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe collaborative et orientée vers les besoins opérationnels des clients, et vous jouerez un rôle clé pour garantir l’efficacité et la cohérence des solutions de signalisation urbaine livrées par Alstom.
Au quotidien, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie projet, d’architecture système et de supervision. Vous serez également un interlocuteur privilégié pour les clients et d’autres parties prenantes internes, tout en contribuant à l’amélioration continue des processus et des méthodes d’ingénierie système.
Vous vous occuperez plus particulièrement de rédiger les spécifications des contextes opérationnels et des alarmes, mais aussi de contribuer aux simulations de performances des lignes et à la rédaction de documents techniques. Nous ferons appel à vous pour :

Analyser les exigences contractuelles et les contraintes spécifiques à chaque projet.

Rédiger les spécifications des contextes opérationnels (modes nominaux et dégradés) des solutions de signalisation urbaine.

Définir les alarmes et événements pertinents à afficher aux opérateurs en poste de contrôle.

Contribuer aux choix de design en tenant compte des besoins d’exploitation et d’exploitabilité.

Assurer la cohérence technique et l’alignement avec les équipes de conception et d’ingénierie projet.

Participer à l’écriture des documents du système, y compris les plans, spécifications et autres documents techniques.

Contribuer aux simulations des performances des lignes, comme les temps de parcours des trains ou les intervalles entre trains.

Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus et méthodes d’ingénierie système.

Votre profil
Nous accordons plus d'importance à la passion et à l’état d’esprit qu'à l'expérience. C'est pourquoi nous n'attendons pas de vous que vous possédiez toutes les compétences. Nous avons plutôt dressé une liste de celles qui, selon nous, vous aideront à réussir et à vous épanouir dans ce rôle :

Diplôme d’ingénieur (Bac+5).

Une expérience ou une compréhension du milieu ferroviaire, idéalement dans l’exploitation de lignes de métro.

Une bonne capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication.

Rigueur, autonomie et force de proposition.

Un bon esprit d’équipe et une aptitude à collaborer avec diverses parties prenantes.

Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Bonne maîtrise du pack Office.

Ce que vous apprécierez
Rejoignez-nous pour une nouvelle expérience de vie - le secteur ferroviaire est un secteur d’avenir, vous pouvez donc vous développer et acquérir de nouvelles compétences et expériences tout au long de votre carrière. Vous pourrez également :

Bénéficier de stabilité, de défis et d'une carrière à long terme sans routine quotidienne.

Travailler avec des experts passionnés et des équipes multiculturelles.

Collaborer avec des équipes transversales et des collègues qualifiés.

Contribuer à des projets innovants et stratégiques pour l’avenir de la mobilité.

Utiliser notre environnement de travail flexible et axé sur la collaboration.

Orienter votre carrière dans la direction de votre choix à travers les fonctions et les pays.

Bénéficier de notre investissement dans votre développement, par le biais de programmes d’apprentissage primés.

Progresser vers des rôles à responsabilité croissante, en fonction de vos aspirations.

Bénéficier d'un système de rémunération équitable et dynamique qui reconnaît vos performances et votre potentiel, ainsi que d'une couverture sociale complète et compétitive (assurance-vie, assurance-maladie, pension).

 Il n'est pas nécessaire d'être un passionné de trains pour s'épanouir chez nous. Nous vous garantissons que lorsque vous monterez dans l'un de nos trains avec vos amis ou votre famille, vous en serez fier. Si vous êtes prêt à relever le défi, nous aimerions vous connaître !
Important
En tant qu'entreprise mondiale, nous sommes un employeur qui prône l'égalité des chances et qui célèbre la diversité dans les 63 pays où nous sommes présents. Nous nous engageons à créer un lieu de travail inclusif pour tous.

positions.title: Railway AI solution System Designer 1 (Saint-Ouen, J, FR)
positions.description:
Req ID:516772 
Alstom leads the way toward a greener future by developing and marketing mobility solutions that provide sustainable foundations for the future of transportation. Its product portfolio ranges from high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams to integrated systems, customized services, infrastructure, signaling, and digital mobility solutions. Joining Alstom means joining a caring, responsible, and innovative company where more than 80,000 people are paving the way for greener and smarter mobility worldwide.
 Could you be the Railway AI Solution System Designer based in Saint-Ouen, France, that we are looking for?
 
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your system engineering and data architecture expertise within Alstom’s Railway Data Sciences & AI organization. Alstom’s Data Science and AI programs aim to develop, test, validate, and industrialize data driven solutions for the mobility domain, leveraging advanced analytics, simulations, and domain expertise.
As Railway AI Solution System Designer, you will lead the design of end to end system and data architectures for AI solutions, from definition to industrialization, working closely with multidisciplinary and international teams. You will hierarchically report to the Head of Railway Data Sciences & AI Solutions and functionally to the Railway AI Solution Program Managers.
Your responsibilities
 
As part of the Railway Data AI team, you will act as a key technical partner in the design and delivery of AI enabled railway solutions. Your responsibilities include:
 
• Analyze functional needs and translate user requirements into system-level specifications• Define and design end-to-end system and data architectures for AI solutions• Provide detailed system analyses and technical inputs to development teams• Ensure alignment of data engineering implementations with functional and performance objectives• Oversee end to end solution design, from concept to industrialization• Support verification and validation activities from a functional standpoint• Contribute to tender activities by identifying gaps and defining required core developments
 
Your profile
We value mindset, leadership and motivation as much as technical expertise. The following skills and experience will help you succeed in this role:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field• Strong Industry experience within system engineering, supervision or diagnostic systems; signaling or smart mobility experience is a plus• Strong knowledge of data architectures and data driven programs in on prem and cloud environments• Proven experience in data engineering and high availability, high performance system architectures• Proficiency in Python and experience with technologies such as Kafka, API management, Spark/Streaming, Linux, and Open APIs• Solid knowledge of data platforms and tools including Oracle / SQL Server / PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch / Kibana, InfluxDB, Minio, and dashboarding tools such as Grafana or Tableau• Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, Scala or Spark, with exposure to AI / machine learning driven solutions appreciated• Strong teamwork skills, autonomy and a proactive mindset, with fluent written and spoken English
What you’ll enjoy

Req ID:516772 

Alstom leads the way toward a greener future by developing and marketing mobility solutions that provide sustainable foundations for the future of transportation. Its product portfolio ranges from high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams to integrated systems, customized services, infrastructure, signaling, and digital mobility solutions. Joining Alstom means joining a caring, responsible, and innovative company where more than 80,000 people are paving the way for greener and smarter mobility worldwide.

 

Could you be the Railway AI Solution System Designer based in Saint-Ouen, France, that we are looking for?

 

Your future role


Take on a new challenge and apply your system engineering and data architecture expertise within Alstom’s Railway Data Sciences & AI organization. Alstom’s Data Science and AI programs aim to develop, test, validate, and industrialize data driven solutions for the mobility domain, leveraging advanced analytics, simulations, and domain expertise.


As Railway AI Solution System Designer, you will lead the design of end to end system and data architectures for AI solutions, from definition to industrialization, working closely with multidisciplinary and international teams. You will hierarchically report to the Head of Railway Data Sciences & AI Solutions and functionally to the Railway AI Solution Program Managers.


Your responsibilities

 

As part of the Railway Data AI team, you will act as a key technical partner in the design and delivery of AI enabled railway solutions. Your responsibilities include:

 

• Analyze functional needs and translate user requirements into system-level specifications
• Define and design end-to-end system and data architectures for AI solutions
• Provide detailed system analyses and technical inputs to development teams
• Ensure alignment of data engineering implementations with functional and performance objectives
• Oversee end to end solution design, from concept to industrialization
• Support verification and validation activities from a functional standpoint
• Contribute to tender activities by identifying gaps and defining required core developments

 

Your profile


We value mindset, leadership and motivation as much as technical expertise. The following skills and experience will help you succeed in this role:


• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
• Strong Industry experience within system engineering, supervision or diagnostic systems; signaling or smart mobility experience is a plus
• Strong knowledge of data architectures and data driven programs in on prem and cloud environments
• Proven experience in data engineering and high availability, high performance system architectures
• Proficiency in Python and experience with technologies such as Kafka, API management, Spark/Streaming, Linux, and Open APIs
• Solid knowledge of data platforms and tools including Oracle / SQL Server / PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch / Kibana, InfluxDB, Minio, and dashboarding tools such as Grafana or Tableau
• Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, Scala or Spark, with exposure to AI / machine learning driven solutions appreciated
• Strong teamwork skills, autonomy and a proactive mindset, with fluent written and spoken English


What you’ll enjoy


Join us for a new life experience — the railway sector is a future oriented industry, offering you the opportunity to grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You will also be able to:


• Benefit from stability, exciting challenges, and a long term career without daily routine
• Work with passionate and committed experts in an innovative environment
• Collaborate with cross functional teams and highly skilled colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects with strong impact
• Take advantage of a flexible, collaboration focused working environment
• Shape your career path across functions and countries, according to your aspirations
• Benefit from our strong investment in your development through award winning learning programs
• Progress toward leadership roles or advanced technical expertise
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward system that recognizes your performance and potential, along with comprehensive and competitive social benefits (life insurance, health insurance, pension plan)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast - though you may become one. We guarantee that when you ride one of our trains with friends or family, you’ll feel proud. If you’re ready to take on the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!


Important


As a global company, we are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity across the 63 countries in which we operate. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

positions.description:
Req ID:507988 

À la tête des entreprises qui s’engagent vers un avenir plus vert, Alstom développe et commercialise des solutions de mobilité qui apportent les fondements durables pour l'avenir des transports. Notre portefeuille de produits s'étend des trains à grande vitesse, métros, monorails et tramways jusqu’aux systèmes intégrés, services sur mesure, infrastructures, signalisation et solutions de mobilité numérique. Nous rejoindre, c'est rejoindre une entreprise bienveillante, responsable et innovante où plus de 70 000 personnes ouvrent la voie à une mobilité plus verte et plus intelligente, dans le monde entier.

Au sein du site de Villeurbanne de plus de 1200 collaborateurs, au sein du centre de développement spécialisé dans la conception et la fabrication de systèmes électroniques sol et bord (contrôle et monitoring, signalisation), nous développons les nouvelles solutions intelligentes permettant l’exploitation des réseaux de transports ferroviaires.

Nos métiers en production, innovation, informatique, cybersécurité, électronique et en télécommunications construisent l’intelligence des trains de demain afin de répondre aux besoins de mobilité plus durable.

Nous recherchons des personnes curieuses dotées d’un esprit novateur et qui ont à cœur de réinventer la mobilité en la rendant plus intelligente et plus durable.

Sustainer / Designer Hardware (H/F)
 
MISSIONS
 
En tant qu’ Ingénieur expérimenté , et rattaché(e) au département Hardware Design/Sustaining, vous êtes en charge de maintenir ou d'amener du support aux utilisateurs des produits, ainsi qu'aux différents EMS et/ou équipe d'industrialisation.
Vos principales missions sont : 

Réaliser les expertises de niveau 2 sur les produits ( ou cartes electroniques) de retour terrain ou de production dont l'analyse de premier niveau n'a pas permis de déterminer la cause du défaut remonté 
Apporter du support pour les projets utilisateurs des produits. 
Déterminer la cause racine du problème qu'il soit lié à la conception ou a l'industrialisation ( Test, programmation, etc)
Définir / valider la solution apportée aux différents problèmes détectés
Créer les retours d'expériences en lien avec les activités réalisées et les problèmes rencontrés (pour enrichir les règles de design HW et capitaliser sur les connaissances produits)
Effectuer des mises à jours/création des documents technique 
Assurer la veille technologique
Participer a des activités de design si la charge du service le nécessite 

Au travers de ces activités, vous contribuez à la standardisation de notre ligne de produit en réutilisant les solutions existantes ou en définissant des solutions réutilisables. Vous assurez une interface technique avec l’architecte matériel, le concepteur matériel , les équipes industrialisation, les achats, tout au long du cycle de développement HW. 
 
PROFIL RECHERCHE
 
Pour répondre aux attentes du poste, le/la candidat(e) doit être capable de démontrer les compétences et les qualités suivantes : 

Vous êtes Issu(e) d’une formation Ingénieur ou Technicien expérimenté (au moins 10 ans) en électronique , vous justifiez d'une première expérience d'au moins 3 ans réussie dans un domaine similaire (conception hardware, support et réparation électronique), idéalement dans un contexte industriel et international, 
Vous possédez de solides compétences en électronique, qui vous permettent d'etre polyvalent techniquement
 Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, d'un sens de l'initiative et vous disposez d'un bon sens de la communication & relationnel
Vous avez un niveau d’anglais intermédiaire (indispensable). 
Vous connaissez l'environnement de qualification ferroviaire (un plus) 

Rejoindre Alstom vous permettra de développer votre carrière dans un environnement de travail diversifié et international.

Vous contribuerez au succès d'un acteur mondial incontournable qui se positionne à la pointe de l'innovation et des modes de transports durables pour ses clients et les voyageurs. Notre culture d'entreprise est fondée sur l'innovation, la diversité, l'entrepreneuriat, la responsabilité sociale et l'éthique. Nous partageons des valeurs communes : l'esprit d'équipe, la confiance et le sens de l'action. Les perspectives d'évolution qu'offre Alstom en France et à l'international vous donneront l'opportunité d'être acteur de votre carrière professionnelle et de contribuer directement au développement de la mobilité durable dans le monde.

Alstom garantit l'égalité des chances et s'engage en tant qu’employeur à créer un environnement de travail inclusif où tous sont encouragés à atteindre leur plein potentiel, et où les différences individuelles sont valorisées et respectées. Tous les candidats qualifiés sont considérés dans nos processus de recrutement sans tenir compte de l’origine, de la couleur de peau, de la religion, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité de genre, de l'âge, de la nationalité, de la nature du handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi locale

positions.descriptionHtml:
Rôle et Contexte

Spartes développe une plateforme composée de plusieurs solutions au service de différentes BU aux cas d’usages variés (RH, Paie, Innovation, Énergie, Immobilier, etc) et de leurs clients

La fonction produit s'organise autour d'un Product Manager qui pilote la fonction transverse, et de Product Designer déployé·e·s sur les solutions, en binôme avec un·e IC Engineer pour piloter leur squad de bout en bout.

En tant que Product Designer, tu owne une solution end-to-end : tu portes la vision, tu mènes la discovery, tu designes la solution avec une vraie sensibilité produit, et tu délivres la valeur en binôme avec ton IC Engineer.

Le poste reflète une posture hands-on : nos profils produit ne se contentent pas de coordonner, ils construisent: discovery, design et delivery inclus.

Objectif

Tu auras pour objectif de :

  • Faire grandir une solution sur ses indicateurs business (acquisition, conversion, rétention selon le périmètre)

  • Garantir une qualité produit élevée, du premier insight utilisateur jusqu'au monitoring post-launch

  • Tirer parti de l'IA et des nouveaux outils marché pour accélérer la discovery, le design et la mise en production

Tu seras rattaché·e au Product Manager, en binôme étroit avec ton IC Engineer (squad), avec de fortes interactions avec l'Engineering Manager, les équipes Sales et Marketing.

Principales Missions

Stratégie de ta solution

  • Tu comprends finement les enjeux business, user et tech de ta solution

  • Tu définis sa vision et sa roadmap, alignées sur la roadmap consolidée plateforme tenue par la Product Manager

  • Tu priorises les features par valeur business et ROI (le what), en lien avec l'Engineer qui estime le how & when

  • Tu définis et suis les KPIs de ta solution

  • Tu identifies où l'IA peut créer un avantage produit dans ta solution

Discovery & design

  • Tu mènes la user research (interviews, tests utilisateurs, prototypes) et synthétises les insights en décisions produit

  • Tu conçois les solutions UX et UI avec un haut niveau d'exigence

  • Tu contribues au design system commun avec les autres Product Designer

  • Tu utilises les outils IA (génération, prototypage, analyse) pour aller plus vite et plus loin

  • Tu maintiens la qualité produit tout au long du delivery (design QA)

Delivery & co-leadership de ta squad

  • Tu écris les specs et arbitres le scope des features

  • Tu co-leades ta squad au quotidien en binôme avec ton IC Engineer

  • Tu co-décides des trade-offs scope ↔ effort, sans escalader systématiquement

  • Tu suis le delivery et mesure l'impact post-launch et capitalises sur les apprentissages

Stakeholders sur ta solution

  • Tu es le point d'entrée des sales & market sur les sujets opérationnels de ta solution

  • Tu communiques les décisions, la roadmap et les avancées

  • Tu contribues au collectif Product Designers : partage d'insights, cohérence cross-solutions

  • Tu rediriges vers la Product Manager les sujets stratégiques cross-solutions, branding ou positioning

Profil recherché

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en produit ou design produit, idéalement en environnement scale-up tech

  • Discovery utilisateur structurée : interviews, tests, synthèse d'insights actionnables

  • Design produit complet : UX, UI, parcours, contribution à un design system

  • Priorisation produit par valeur business et ROI

  • Delivery agile en binôme avec l'engineering

  • Design & build with AI : tu utilises concrètement les outils IA dans ton quotidien produit (discovery, design, prototypage, analyse)

  • Communication structurée à l'écrit comme à l'oral

  • Customer obsession et pragmatisme

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoindre Spartes, c’est évoluer au sein d’un entreprise en pleine croissance, qui valorise la progression, la confiance et l’intelligence collective ; un environnement dynamique où vos compétences comme votre impact peuvent grandir chaque jour.

Nous proposons également à nos collaborateurs un ensemble d’avantages pensés pour soutenir leur développement professionnel et leur bien-être au quotidien.

Avantages

  • Contrat CDI, comprenant un salaire fixe de 52 k€ plus variable,

  • Statut Cadre,

  • Possibilité de télétravail et accès aux RTT,

  • Avantages bien-être : Well Pass pour le sport et mutuelle premium partiellement prise en charge,

  • Prime de vacances après un an d’ancienneté, ainsi qu’un dispositif d’intéressement représentant 3 à 6 % du salaire brut annuel (sous conditions de déclenchements),

  • Chèques cadeaux de Noël et titres-restaurant

Culture d’entreprise

Les bureaux sont situés à Paris.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement :

  • Stimulant et exigeant,

  • Où votre impact est visible et reconnu.

  • Bienveillant, collaboratif et pluridisciplinaire (Finance, RH, Tech, Fiscalité, Immobilier, Assurance, Environnement),

  • Où petits déjeuners, apéros et événements d’équipes sont régulièrement organisés. 

Processus de Recrutement

  • Entretien avec le Responsable Recrutement

  • Entretien avec la Product Lead

  • Case study ou live case study avec un autre Product

  • Entretien avec le CPTO

  • Proposition finale

Chez Spartes, nous valorisons toutes les singularités et plaçons l’égalité des chances au centre de nos pratiques. Toutes les candidatures sont étudiées sur la base de compétences professionnelles.

Nous sommes attentifs aux besoins spécifiques et nous engageons à proposer les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir une expérience candidat et collaborateur inclusive.

Envie de relever de nouveaux défis dans un environnement en pleine croissance ?

Rejoignez Spartes !

positions.descriptionHtml:
LIEU : Neuilly sur Seine

Date : dès que possible – juin 2026

DUREE : CDD – 3 mois renouvelable

Chanel est une entreprise indépendante qui croit en la liberté de la création, cultive le potentiel humain et s’engage activement pour avoir un impact positif dans le monde.

L'activité Parfums Beauté affirme sa singularité à travers une promesse : celle de révéler la beauté de chaque femme dans ce qu'elle a de plus singulier à travers son Parfum, son Maquillage et ses produits de Soin. 

Au sein de la Direction Artistique de la Division Parfums Beauté, vous serez rattaché à la Direction de la Création Architecture et Merchandising Evènementiels et plus spécifiquement au pôle PLV/Merchandising Evènementiel.  

A ce titre, vous contribuez à la cohérence de l’image et de l’expérience client sur le point de vente au travers de la conception et du déploiement de matériels merchandising. Vous prenez en charge la création des PLV liés à une campagne ou un lancement nouveau produit.

En partenariat étroit avec vos interfaces, vous pilotez les projets créatifs du brief à la production et accompagnez les équipes internes dans l’adaptation des projets aux contraintes locales et aux spécificités des différents réseaux de distribution.  

VOTRE IMPACT CHEZ CHANEL

Au sein de l’équipe et en collaboration avec l’ensemble des acteurs projets, vous prenez en charge le pilotage de projets créatifs dans le respect des codes de la Maison, du budget et des délais impartis :

  • Participation au brainstorming créatif et propositions de pistes créatives en réponse à un brief
  • Recherches et propositions de matériaux
  • Réalisation des plans techniques des différents matériels (présentoirs, vitrines, PLV…)
  • Suivi des prototypages et proposition d’ajustement et de solutions techniques
  • Accompagnement de nos interfaces internes (marketing, achats, équipes régionales…) dans le suivi de conception et dans le déploiement
  • Proposition de solutions techniques et créatives en réponses aux spécificités locales

CE QUE VOUS APPORTEREZ

Titulaire d’un diplôme supérieur en design ou architecture d'intérieur, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative d’environ 5 ans dans un environnement créatif et exigeant dans l'univers du luxe et de la beauté.

Tout à la fois curieux, agile et doté d’excellente capacités relationnelles, vos expériences vous ont permis de mener des projets complexes et multi acteurs avec rigueur et autonomie.

Vous disposez d’une solide connaissance des matériaux (plastique, bois, métal, ...) et process de fabrication (injection, tabletterie, thermoformage, ...).

Vous maîtrisez Illustrator, Photoshop ainsi que des logiciels 3D tels que Sketchup ou Vectorworks.

La maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable aux échanges avec nos interfaces régionales.

CE QUI VOUS ENTHOUSIASME ET CE QUE CHANEL PEUT VOUS OFFRIR

Tout au long de votre expérience, vous serez immergé(e) dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et apprenant ; où la création et l’humain sont au cœur des préoccupations.

Vous rejoignez une activité singulière, aux méthodes et procédés uniques – qu’ils soient créatifs, de développement ou d’industrialisation – et évoluez aux côtés d’une diversité d’experts aux savoir-faire reconnus.

Chez CHANEL, nous nous attachons à promouvoir une culture inclusive qui favorise l’épanouissement personnel et contribue au progrès collectif. Nous sommes convaincus que le caractère unique de chaque individu contribue à la diversité, la complémentarité et l’efficacité de nos équipes. Nous encourageons vivement votre candidature, car nous apprécions la perspective, l’expérience et le potentiel que vous pourriez apporter à CHANEL.

  • Suivi de réalisation de plans techniques, de prototypes, de matériaux et de finitions spécifiques  
  • Communication de ces éléments techniques avec les marchés et les fournisseurs pour le suivi de la production de ces scénographies
  • Veille et Recherche

Issu.e d’une formation supérieure en design, architecture d’intérieur, scénographie ou communication visuelle, vous possédez de solides bases en conception d’espaces et en storytelling visuel. positions.title: Software Designer (Charleroi, BE)
positions.description:
Req ID:517846 

Leading societies to a low carbon future, Alstom develops and markets mobility solutions that provide the sustainable foundations for the future of transportation. Our product portfolio ranges from high-speed trains, metros, monorail, and trams to integrated systems, customised services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility solutions. Joining us means joining a caring, responsible, and innovative company where more than 70,000 people lead the way to greener and smarter mobility, worldwide
The Software Integrator role is critical in ensuring the seamless integration, functionality, and performance of software modules across both host machines (native on PC) and hardware platforms. Positioned at the lower part of the V-cycle, this role bridges the gap between software development and system validation, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy solving complex integration challenges, and are passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

 Software Integration & Validation

 Ensure proper functioning and cohesion of software modules on host machines and hardware platforms, adhering to requirements documentation and functional interfaces ([SwRS/SwID]).
 Verify the operational readiness of software deliveries, ensuring effective communication between functionalities.
 Evaluate overall software maturity before official configuration and release. 

 Platform Expertise 

 Develop a deep understanding of the platform, including hardware, software, and external peripherals. 
 Master platform configuration and peripheral setup, including the preparation of parameter files. 
 Participate in platform integrations with external peripherals. 
 Communicate with the platform stakeholders (MooN), particularly regarding integration, as well as issue reporting and tracking tickets. 

 Release Management

 Produce target executables for design and official releases, including release notes, production manuals, user manuals, and configuration documentation. 

 Support & Collaboration

 Assist software developers during designer tests on host/target platforms and analyze validation and verification feedback. 
 Manage the inventory of platforms available for software developers. 
 Collaborate with design teams to execute functional, endurance, and cybersecurity tests. 

 Performance Measurement & Automation

 Implement injection or measurement points at function interfaces based on documentation. 
 Automate and produce performance measurements for: 

 Embedded functionalities (e.g., reaction times). 
 Hardware resources (e.g., memory usage, CPU utilization). 

 Critically analyze performance metrics to identify areas for improvement. 

 Software Maintenance

 Merge developed software functionalities or support developers in this task. 
 Implement minor software corrections for integrated functions, as needed. 

Interfaces

 Collaborate with: 

 Software Developers 
 Systems Engineers, Validators, Safety & Cybersecurity Teams 
 Parameterization Teams 
 Tools & Simulators Teams 
 Platform Vendors 

Education: Master degree

Required Technical Skills 

 Mandatory:

 Configuration Management: GitLab 
 Scripting: Python, Lua, Bash (for automated test creation and maintenance), Make, Makefiles
 Programming Languages: C, C++, ADA (depending on the project) 
 Virtualization: VirtualBox, Docker 
 Operating Systems: Linux 

 Optional:

 Communication Protocols: Ethernet
 Databases: SQL (optional) 
 Test Frameworks: AUnit 

Behavioral Skills

 Proficiency English. (French is an asset)
 Strong organizational skills and multitasking ability. 
 Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with internal and external teams. 
 Ability to build and maintain a network of knowledgeable colleagues. 
 Analytical mindset with the ability to step back and assess the overall product. 
 Autonomous and independent, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. 

Location

 Based in Charleroi with the option for remote work 2 days per week.

Alstom is the leading company in the mobility sector, solving the most interesting challenges for tomorrow’s mobility. That’s why we value inquisitive and innovative people who are passionate about working together to reinvent mobility, making it smarter and more sustainable. Day after day, we are building an agile, inclusive and responsible culture, where a diverse group of people are offered opportunities to learn, grow and advance in their careers, with options across functions and geographic locations. Are you ready to join a truly international community of great people on a challenging journey with a tangible impact and purpose? 

Equal opportunity statement:
Alstom is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all our employees are encouraged to reach their full potential, and individual differences are valued and respected. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local law. 

Job Type:​Experienced​

Lead the design and specification of a system or a sub-system part of it for new development or evolutions of existing ones, in complement to its system designer role

POSITION IN THE ORGANISATION
Organisation structure:
Development Center (DC) (in program context)
 Reports directly to:
System Métier/domain Manager
 Other reporting to:
Program Development Manager (in program context)
Project Engineering Manager (in contract context)
 
ACCOUNTABILITIES & AUTHORITIES
Mission and deliverables

Member of the program engineering team
Applies processes, methods and tools as referenced by the program plans
Supports the Program Development Manager for identification of technical risks and definition of the development strategy

Leads and participates to the system design and specifications, defines the system architecture and by application of System Engineering techniques for :

System Design (conceptual design through critical thinking & holistic analysis; integration of end-users, experts and CCN recommendations; phases concurrent engineering; ensures design for testability, cybersecurity, RAM and safety; provides interface resolution and management)
Technical reviews & decisions 
System Specifications (Structured system specifications; development and integration of RAM, safety, cybersecurity, sub-system, software, hardware and V&V needs; system modelling and requirements writing, management and traceability)
Application of verifications (document reviews, peer reviews) 
Configuration Management 

Interfaces with the System Application Architect for projects and tenders activities (evolutions & anomalies analysis, design & documentation support) 
Prepares program/project documents (e.g. training material, user manuals, …) (s)he is in charge of
Participates to the material selection and procurement activities as required for the system delivery
Alerts and reports on any event/risks that may impact the system development 
Participates to the program CCB
Keep himself informed of the evolution of technologies through technological watch
Contribute to continuous improvement (REX: Return of EXperience, process, workload estimations/metrics, …)
Supports the Program Development Manager for workload estimations for the system design deliverables
Promoting the Alstom Code of Ethics and adhering to the highest standards of ethical conduct.

Performance measurements
Program/Métier KPIs
 
EXPERIENCE PREREQUISITES & REQUIRED COMPETENCES
Educational Requirements 
Mandatory:
Engineer Degree
Desirable:

Master Degree
Certification in System Engineering

Experience

Minimum 3 years experience in system métier (project or program)
Alstom internal Training Advanced System Architect Program (ASAP for Architects)
Knowledge of the (railway) program domain

Desirable:

Alstom internal Training Advanced System Architect Program (ASAP) 
Specific domain knowledge (as applicable - signalling, ATLAS, Metro systems, ATP, ITCS, ..)

Competencies & Skills 

Expertise in (Model Based) System Engineering
Product & Domain knowledge 
Ability to work transversally with Engineering teams 
Technical decision management
Understanding of Hardware and Software development
Understanding of System V&V
Design for safety and cybersecurity (when required) and RAM compliance
Design for Quality life cycle
English communication skills

  • Interfaces with the System Application Architect for projects and tenders activities (evolutions & anomalies analysis, design & documentation support)
  • Prepares program/project documents (e.g. training material, user manuals, …) (s)he is in charge of
  • Participates to the material selection and procurement activities as required for the system delivery
  • Alerts and reports on any event/risks that may impact the system development
  • Participates to the program CCB
  • Keep himself informed of the evolution of technologies through technological watch
  • Contribute to continuous improvement (REX: Return of EXperience, process, workload estimations/metrics, …)
  • Supports the Program Development Manager for workload estimations for the system design deliverables
  • Promoting the Alstom Code of Ethics and adhering to the highest standards of ethical conduct.

  • Knowledge of the (railway) program domain

Desirable:

positions.title: Designer - Centrifugal Compressors (Wilrijk; Antwerp, Other/Not Applicable, Belgium)
positions.description:
Our solutions are a key part of most industries - electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more. Working with us means working with the latest technologies and groundbreaking, sustainable innovations.

Join us on our journey for a better tomorrow.

Your role
Are you challenged by complex problems and motivated to design the best possible mechanical products down to the smallest detail?
 
What does a designer centrifugal compressors do at the Atlas Copco Group in Wilrijk? As a designer centrifugal compressors, you will become part of a highly specialized team focused on the design of next-generation direct-drive and integrally geared centrifugal compressors. Your primary responsibility as a designer centrifugal compressors is the full engineering of complete compressor cores, which includes managing large assemblies, drawing creation, and precise bill of materials (BOM) management. In this role, you will develop complex structured CAD models, perform parametric modeling for part variants, and execute basic finite element analysis (FEA) alongside mechanical calculations. You will collaborate closely with project teams, incorporate production feedback into improved designs, and occasionally follow up on the physical assembly of prototype machines or create custom designs for demanding applications where every marginal gain counts.
 
In this role, you will report to the team leader centrifugal compressors and work via a hybrid model at our facility in Wilrijk.To succeed, you will need
At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent mechanical design experience

Advanced CAD modeling proficiency with a preference for CATIA software

Applied knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing alongside standard production methods

Experience working within product lifecycle management systems is a plus

Professional fluency in English or Dutch with a willingness for occasional travel abroad

In return, we offer
At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.
 
You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.
 Job location
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site. 

Diverse by nature and inclusive by choice
Bright ideas come from all of us. The more unique perspectives we embrace, the more innovative we are. Together we build a culture where difference is valued and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.
