positions.title: Designer (Ghent, East Flanders, BE)
positions.descriptionHtml:
Daikin Europe is a subsidiary of Daikin Industries Ltd. and the leading provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. The company designs, manufactures and brings to market a broad portfolio of equipment, as well as tailor-made solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial purposes in Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). To date, Daikin EMEA has over 12 000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries. It has 12 major manufacturing facilities based in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Austria, and the UK. Our aim is to drive sustainable and effective solutions, sparking a good climate for the generations to come. And all this can only be achieved because of our People. 

 

                                                                                                   

                                                                                             PRODUCT DESIGNER

 

 

As the EMEA Development Centre (EDC), we develop air-conditioning, heating, refrigeration and ventilation products as well as controls and IOT solutions. These are produced in different factories located within and outside Europe. The products are put on the market through our various Daikin distributors and affiliates within Europe, Middle East and Africa.

 

 

ROLE:

As a Designer within our EMEA Development Centre, you will be involved in the development of heat pumps, refrigeration systems, commercial air conditioning and ventilation products, taking account the requirements of the different stakeholders (customers, manufacturing, (after-)sales,…).

The EMEA Development Centre headquarters is in Ghent and this vacant position is located in the Ghent office.

Within the CAD environment (re)design HVACR products. The currently used package is Solid Edge (3D/2D), but on short term a migration is planned to Siemens NX.

 

 

TASKS:

  • Design a wide range of parts (piping, sheet metal, insulation, plastics, packing, labels, wires,…) according to specific Daikin methods;
  • Make 3D design and 2D drawings to prepare for prototype parts ordering and for mass production;
  • Make specification drawings which are used as input for marketing data;
  • Maintain the Bill Of Material by using specific Daikin designed system;
  • Determine your own work-plan autonomously while taking the global project planning into account, in consultation with the project leader and team members;
  • Learn to understand the limitations of machinery and the process of DIE-making, including the production of various components such as sheet metal and plastic, follow the design standards established by EMEA Development Centre.
  • Join project meetings to report on the progress;
  • Join the prototype making process (e.g. parts ordering; actual building) and witness the designed prototype in our prototype shops on site; Evaluate your design and modify if required;
  • Together with the other project members analyse the result of a prototype evaluation test and propose modifications in the design when required;
  • Equally important is your role as contact person between EMEA Development Centre and other departments such as Procurement, Quality, Production and with external suppliers, whereby you will acquire a good insight to the whole Daikin production process.

 

 

PROFILE:

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in engineering, for example in mechanics, electromechanics, industrial design.
  • You are acquainted with CAD 3D and 2D design (parametric) and Microsoft Office tools and can assess the impact on tolerances of parts on the total design;
  • You are a person with a strong technical interest, willing to be a part of a project team;
  • You are a team player who is driven to find solutions for technical requirements and specific client enquiries.
  • You are hands on and next to the 3D/2D design you are interested to work on the actual unit yourself to improve your designs;
  • You work structured and have an attention for detail.
  • You have a strong interest in the HVACR business and want to actively contribute to achieving the goals of the Green Deal.
  • You enjoy playing an active role in projects and you have the natural behaviour to make priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge of both spoken and written English are essential for this position.
  • This vacancy is open to both recent graduates and candidates with experience.
  • Valid driving license

 

 

OFFER:

At Daikin you can count on a varied job, with an international market leader which encourages people to work together and develop. We can offer you a permanent contract. You will become part of the EDC team which is engaged to make the world a greener place by introducing renewable alternatives in our cooling/heating market. You will be supported by a team of enthusiastic designers and engineers. From the very beginning you can count on thorough training and intensive support. Your competitive salary is complemented by a package of extra-legal benefits.

 

Good climate starts with people 

Our employees are the beating heart of our company. At Daikin, you get to work in a positive environment backed by trust, creativity and continuous improvement. Together, we create our top-quality solutions by empowering talented teams. You will get plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. We are deeply committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that reflects the communities we serve. Good climate starts with people.

Dit ga je doen

Ben jij een grafisch talent met een sterke passie voor de digitale wereld, en daarnaast ook feeling voor drukwerk? Werk je graag aan visueel sterke campagnes en hou je van afwisseling in je job? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.

Als Designer werk je gedurende 6 maanden mee aan het vormgeven en uitwerken van commerciële en corporate communicatie. Je vertaalt briefings van de (Online) Marketing Specialist naar sterke visuele concepten en verzorgde ontwerpen. Online is helemaal jouw ding, maar je duikt ook met plezier in drukwerk.

Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Webbeheer: Updaten van de webshops via het Content Management System.
  • Online communicatie: Uitwerken van grafische content voor online communicatie: e-mails, websites, app, social media en advertising.
  • Webontwikkeling: Het designen en creëren van contentpages voor de websites in HTML & CSS
  • Drukwerk: Opmaken, aanpassen en finaliseren van drukwerk zoals POS-materialen, spaarkaarten, flyers, kortingsbonnen en folders.
  • Conceptontwikkeling: Meedenken over en uitwerken van grafische en creatieve concepten.
  • …

Dit krijg je ervoor terug

  • Een uitdagende, tijdelijke en fulltime functie
    ICI PARIS XL is een krachtige en dynamische internationale onderneming dat deel uitmaakt van de AS Watson Group, ’s werelds grootste retailer op het gebied van health & beauty.
  • Goede begeleiding
    Een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma om kennis te maken met onze mensen, producten en cultuur. De mogelijkheid tot het volgen van verschillende opleidingen via ons e-learning platform.
  • Professionele en enthousiaste collega’s
    Je zal je snel thuis voelen tussen collega’s die jou ondersteunen op verschillende vlakken.
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden
    Ambitieuze professionals die kansen benutten, beslissingen durven te nemen en zich thuis voelen in een informele, no-nonsense en resultaatgerichte organisatie, kunnen rekenen op uitstekende toekomstperspectieven.
  • Een goed salaris
    Rekening houdend met jouw kennis en ervaring (min. € 3.000 – max. € 3.800), aangevuld met maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering en een thuiswerkvergoeding.
  • Extra voordelen
    Laptop, 50% thuiswerk mogelijk, glijdende werkuren, 30% personeelskorting, Benefits@work, well-being partner BloomUp, uitnodigingen tot leuke evenementen, enz.

Dit ben jij

Je voelt je thuis in een wereld van luxe cosmetica- en schoonheidsproducten, in een informele werkomgeving waar verantwoordelijkheid, teamwork, ondernemerschap en een goede sfeer belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn.

Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel:

  • Opleiding: Je hebt bij voorkeur een bachelordiploma in grafische vormgeving of een gelijkaardige richting.
  • Adobe-expertise: Je hebt een grondige kennis van Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator en InDesign.
  • Webkennis: Je hebt een grondige kennis van HTML en CSS.
  • Officevaardigheden: Je hebt een vlotte kennis van Excel, Word en Outlook.
  • Talenkennis: Je hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands, Frans en Engels.
  • Nauwkeurigheid: Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.
  • Creativiteit en stressbestendig: Je bent creatief, stressbestendig en houdt van deadlines.
  • Samenwerking: Je werkt zelfstandig, maar communiceert ook vlot met collega’s en stakeholders.
  • Innovatie: Je staat open voor innovatie, digitalisering en nieuwe manieren van werken.

Ben jij een
grafisch talent met een sterke passie voor de digitale wereld, en daarnaast ook
feeling voor drukwerk? Werk je graag aan visueel sterke campagnes en hou je van
afwisseling in je job? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.

Als Designer werk
je gedurende 6 maanden mee aan het vormgeven en uitwerken van commerciële en corporate
communicatie. Je vertaalt briefings van de (Online) Marketing Specialist naar
sterke visuele concepten en verzorgde ontwerpen. Online is helemaal jouw ding, maar
je duikt ook met plezier in drukwerk.

Jouw taken bestaan uit:

- Webbeheer: Updaten van de webshops via het Content Management System.
- Online communicatie: Uitwerken van grafische content voor online communicatie: e-mails, websites, app, social media en advertising.
- Webontwikkeling: Het designen en creëren van contentpages voor de websites in HTML & CSS
- Drukwerk: Opmaken, aanpassen en finaliseren van drukwerk zoals POS-materialen, spaarkaarten, flyers, kortingsbonnen en folders.
- Conceptontwikkeling: Meedenken over en uitwerken van grafische en creatieve concepten.
- …
Dit krijg je ervoor terug

- Een
 uitdagende, tijdelijke en fulltime functie
 ICI PARIS XL is een krachtige en dynamische internationale onderneming dat
 deel uitmaakt van de AS Watson Group, ’s werelds grootste retailer op het
 gebied van health & beauty.
- Goede
 begeleiding
 Een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma om kennis te maken met onze mensen,
 producten en cultuur. De mogelijkheid tot het volgen van verschillende
 opleidingen via ons e-learning platform.
- Professionele
 en enthousiaste collega’s
 Je zal je snel thuis voelen tussen collega’s die jou ondersteunen op
 verschillende vlakken.
- Doorgroeimogelijkheden
 Ambitieuze professionals die kansen benutten, beslissingen durven te nemen
 en zich thuis voelen in een informele, no-nonsense en resultaatgerichte
 organisatie, kunnen rekenen op uitstekende toekomstperspectieven.
- Een
 goed salaris
 Rekening houdend met jouw kennis en ervaring (min. € 3.000 – max. € 3.800),
 aangevuld met maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering en
 een thuiswerkvergoeding.
- Extra
 voordelen
Laptop, 50% thuiswerk mogelijk, glijdende werkuren,
 30% personeelskorting, Benefits@work, well-being
 partner BloomUp, uitnodigingen tot leuke evenementen, enz.
Dit ben jij

Je voelt je thuis in een wereld
van luxe cosmetica- en schoonheidsproducten, in een informele werkomgeving waar
verantwoordelijkheid, teamwork, ondernemerschap en een goede sfeer belangrijke
uitgangspunten zijn.

Verder voldoe je aan het
volgende profiel:

- Opleiding: Je hebt bij voorkeur een bachelordiploma in grafische vormgeving of een gelijkaardige richting.
- Adobe-expertise: Je hebt een grondige kennis van Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator en InDesign.
- Webkennis: Je hebt een grondige kennis van HTML en CSS.
- Officevaardigheden: Je hebt een vlotte kennis van Excel, Word en Outlook.
- Talenkennis: Je hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands, Frans en Engels.
- Nauwkeurigheid: Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.
- Creativiteit en stressbestendig: Je bent creatief, stressbestendig en houdt van deadlines.
- Samenwerking: Je werkt zelfstandig, maar communiceert ook vlot met collega’s en stakeholders.
- Innovatie: Je staat open voor innovatie, digitalisering en nieuwe manieren van werken.

positions.title: E&I Designer / Draftsman (DELFT, ZH, NL, 2612 PA)
positions.descriptionHtml:
About Allseas

Division Description

Department Description

To stay ahead of the industry, we are developing tomorrow’s technology today, transforming bold ideas into state-of-the-art solutions to meet the market’s ever-changing needs. Do you trust your own vision and have the courage to pursue it? Then join the thinkers, leaders and visionaries at Allseas!

Allseas is seeking an experienced Electrical & Instrumentation Designer to join its Innovations Department in Delft. In this role, you will contribute to the design of electrical power systems, automation systems, and ship services across all engineering phases, from concept through to realisation.

Unit Scope

Discipline Description

Job Description

The Innovations Department focuses on developing new solutions and processes that enable Allseas to stay at the forefront of the industry. The E&I Unit is currently involved in the development of new equipment for Allseas’ subsea activities, the transition towards nuclear propulsion, the design of three new vessels, and the preparation of offshore production equipment for a new era of industrial automation.

As an E&I Designer, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining electrical documentation, with a strong focus on electrical drawings. Your main responsibilities include:

  • Create and update electrical installation details, including single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable lists, and consumer lists;
  • Select equipment for the design of electrical cabinets;
  • Review and integrate designs, schematics, and diagrams;
  • Support multidisciplinary teams with E&I drawings and related documentation;
  • Ensure compliance with applicable engineering codes and standards.

You will join an energetic, team-oriented department with committed and professional colleagues. You will work in a dynamic, world-leading offshore company with short communication lines. To succeed in this role, you should have a hands-on mindset, be driven by efficiency, and be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively while taking ownership of your responsibilities.

Education & Experience

  • You hold an MBO or BSc degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification;
  • You have at least 4 years of experience as an Electrical & Instrumentation Designer or 7 years as Electrical & Instrumentation Draftsman;
  • You have hands-on experience with both AutoCAD and EPLAN;
  • You have a broad affinity with technology;
  • You are able to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities;
  • You have experience with Siemens automation hardware.

Certifications

    Additional Information

    Joining Allseas gives you the chance to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, with creative thinking, collaboration and down-to-earth culture at its core.

    You can expect:

    • Competitive industry benchmarked salary and excellent pension;
    • Performance based salary raises and bonuses;
    • 30 holidays days per year, flexible working hours;
    • Company-sponsored fitness scheme;
    • On-the-job training, study budgets and coaching;
    • A close-knit community, BBQ’s, parties, (sportive) events and Friday afternoon drinks.

    Allseas has earned the "World-class Workplace" label. This means that as an employer we score above Effectory's global benchmark for being a good employer. The label is based solely on feedback from our employees. Wondering what our people say about working at Allseas? Read their stories.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Job description

Hello. We’re Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th century’s most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: “Don’t undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.”

In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.
At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

Job summary

We’re looking for a junior designer (human) to join our in-house creative team in Amsterdam.

We're not looking for someone who already has all the answers. We're looking for someone with curiosity, good instincts, and a desire to make things well. Someone who gets excited by great design, pays attention to the details, and understands that craft lives in both the big idea and the final pixel.

You'll work across campaigns, product launches, retail, social, digital, and everything in between, helping bring the Polaroid brand to life through considered design.

This is a junior role, so there’ll be plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. What matters most is that you bring enthusiasm, a strong work ethic, and the beginnings of a creative POV. An appreciation for photography, culture, and the analog world wouldn't hurt, either (in fact, we’d prefer it).

What you'll do

  • Work alongside senior designer and art director to create and execute assets for campaigns across different channels

  • Translate key visual concepts into thoughtful executions across multiple touchpoints

  • Design communications across our direct-to-consumer channels, including email, web, and digital experiences

  • Adhere to brand guidelines while helping evolve our visual language with care

  • Move between projects big and small, from major launches to quick-turnaround requests

  • Bring references, ideas, and curiosity into the room

What we're looking for

  • 1–3 years of experience as a designer, ideally in an agency, brand, or creative environment

  • Familiar with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

  • A portfolio that demonstrates both design thinking and reliable executional skills

  • Someone who is obsessed with craft and sweats the details, bringing care and intention to everything they make

  • A curious designer at the sweet spot of being open to learn, and still having a point of view

  • A low-ego collaborator who enjoys working with other creative humans and take feedback without taking it personally

Find out more about our applicant privacy policy here:

https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

positions.title: SMU Footwear Colour Designer (76092)
positions.description:
Be part of a movement that moves the world At ASICS, we’re more than just a brand; we're a movement. A movement of movement, propelled by the belief that motion strengthens the body and uplifts the mind. Our name itself, an acronym for "Anima Sana in Corpore Sano" (a Sound Mind in a Sound Body), encapsulates this commitment. Since taking our first step in Japan in 1949, our journey has been about more than just reaching the finish lines or clocking the fastest times. It's about the joy of moving and it's open to all. 

If you're inspired to move yourself and the world toward a brighter, more inclusive future, we're looking for you. 

Here at ASICS, we welcome diversity in our people, their backgrounds and life experiences. So, you could be the right person for this role regardless of your age, nationality, religious beliefs, or gender identification. 

Your role in our shared journey Located at our EMEA headquarters in Hoofddorp, near Amsterdam, you will join the European Creation Hub, a team that is actively being built. Working closely with our lead footwear designer, footwear colour coordinator, and development partners, you will lead colour and material design for our most strategic key accounts. You will translate account briefs, brand strategy, and market insight into commercially compelling footwear colour and material concepts that win on shelf and resonate with consumers. 

This is not a role for someone who wants to follow an established playbook. The team is lean, the momentum is real, and the right person will help shape what world-class SMU colour design looks like at ASICS Europe. With genuine creative latitude within briefs, direct exposure to major key account buyers, and a clear path to becoming the dedicated designer for a strategic account as those relationships deepen, this is a rare opportunity for a commercially minded colour designer who is ready to make their mark from day one.   

Your key responsibilities will be: 

Lead colour and material design for key accounts, translating account briefs, brand strategy, and Sportstyle category direction into commercially compelling, on-brand footwear colour and material concepts. 

Manage multiple concurrent key account design projects with structure and discipline: maintaining organised file systems (including SMU VLP documentation), meeting deadlines, and keeping all stakeholders clearly informed throughout. 

Collaborate daily with merchandising, product management, and the development team at ASICS HQ, ensuring creative intent is faithfully carried through into final product across colour, materials, and construction 

Review physical samples against design specifications, prepare clear improvement recommendations, and ensure all product meets quality expectations before client presentation. 

Communicate directly with key account buyers and their teams during design sessions, presenting colour and material concepts with clarity and confidence and incorporating feedback effectively. 

Conduct trend and market research to identify colour and material directions that can inform both key account briefs and the team’s broader creative development work. 

Support the team’s ambition to introduce 3D and digital visualisation into the key account process as an alternative to physical samples, contributing to this transition as the business and tools evolve. 

Contribute actively to shaping the ways of working and culture of a young, growing team, bringing your experience, ideas, and energy to a department that is still writing its playbook. 

You have the following skills and experience: 

Bachelor’s degree in Footwear Design, Industrial Design or a related creative field. 

3+ years of seasonal colour execution experience with a strong footwear-specific colour design portfolio. 

Deep knowledge of colour theory and footwear material application. 

Commercially oriented, confident working within brand guidelines, client briefs, and key account requirements; able to receive and act on feedback from multiple stakeholders without losing creative quality. 

Highly organised, able to manage a fast-paced, multi-account design workload with structure, clear file management, and consistent follow-through; this is as critical as the creative craft. 

Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite and relevant design software; comfortable working across digital and physical design processes. 

Experienced cross-functional collaborator; able to work effectively with merchandising, product management, development, and external key account contacts daily. 

Able to work independently at a senior individual contributor level while adapting to a young team’s evolving processes and ways of working. 

Fluent command of written and spoken English. 

Nie-to-haves: 

Experience with 3D or AI visualisation tools (e.g. Keyshot, CLO, or similar). 

Prior key account or B2B commercial design experience. 

Freelance background or experience adapting to feedback from diverse external clients. 

Life at ASICS When you join ASICS, you become part of something special. Here, your voice matters, your growth and wellbeing are important. We believe in fostering an environment where every step forward is celebrated, where diversity fuels our journey, and inclusion strengthens individuals. And together and as individuals we can inspire more people to move for body and for mind. 

Our commitment to your wellbeing We're dedicated to ensuring that every team member experiences the joy and benefits of movement. To support your wellbeing, we offer: 

Access to office gym and sports membership discount. 

Exclusive 50% discount on ASICS and ONITSUKA TIGER gear. 

Unlimited access to the Calm app for better sleep and mental fitness. 

Complimentary premium subscription to our Runkeeper Go™ app. 

A comprehensive wellness programme consisting of exercise and educational sessions. 

Professional support and meditation classes are available through OpenUp Access. 

Working abroad for four weeks every year. 

Hybrid working model. Combine the flexibility of working from home with the dynamic energy of an office environment. 

How to Apply Are you feeling inspired? We'd love to hear from you. Submit your application online and step into a role where you can truly make a difference. Let's move together, step by step, toward an uplifted world.

If you're inspired to move yourself and the world toward a brighter, more inclusive future, we're looking for you. 

 

Here at ASICS, we welcome diversity in our people, their backgrounds and life experiences. So, you could be the right person for this role regardless of your age, nationality, religious beliefs, or gender identification. 

 

Your role in our shared journey
Located at our EMEA headquarters in Hoofddorp, near Amsterdam, you will join the European Creation Hub, a team that is actively being built. Working closely with our lead footwear designer, footwear colour coordinator, and development partners, you will lead colour and material design for our most strategic key accounts. You will translate account briefs, brand strategy, and market insight into commercially compelling footwear colour and material concepts that win on shelf and resonate with consumers. 

  

This is not a role for someone who wants to follow an established playbook. The team is lean, the momentum is real, and the right person will help shape what world-class SMU colour design looks like at ASICS Europe. With genuine creative latitude within briefs, direct exposure to major key account buyers, and a clear path to becoming the dedicated designer for a strategic account as those relationships deepen, this is a rare opportunity for a commercially minded colour designer who is ready to make their mark from day one.   

 

Your key responsibilities will be: 

  • Lead colour and material design for key accounts, translating account briefs, brand strategy, and Sportstyle category direction into commercially compelling, on-brand footwear colour and material concepts. 

  • Manage multiple concurrent key account design projects with structure and discipline: maintaining organised file systems (including SMU VLP documentation), meeting deadlines, and keeping all stakeholders clearly informed throughout. 

  • Collaborate daily with merchandising, product management, and the development team at ASICS HQ, ensuring creative intent is faithfully carried through into final product across colour, materials, and construction 

  • Review physical samples against design specifications, prepare clear improvement recommendations, and ensure all product meets quality expectations before client presentation. 

  • Communicate directly with key account buyers and their teams during design sessions, presenting colour and material concepts with clarity and confidence and incorporating feedback effectively. 

  • Conduct trend and market research to identify colour and material directions that can inform both key account briefs and the team’s broader creative development work. 

  • Support the team’s ambition to introduce 3D and digital visualisation into the key account process as an alternative to physical samples, contributing to this transition as the business and tools evolve. 

  • Contribute actively to shaping the ways of working and culture of a young, growing team, bringing your experience, ideas, and energy to a department that is still writing its playbook. 

 

You have the following skills and experience: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Footwear Design, Industrial Design or a related creative field. 

  • 3+ years of seasonal colour execution experience with a strong footwear-specific colour design portfolio. 

  • Deep knowledge of colour theory and footwear material application. 

  • Commercially oriented, confident working within brand guidelines, client briefs, and key account requirements; able to receive and act on feedback from multiple stakeholders without losing creative quality. 

  • Highly organised, able to manage a fast-paced, multi-account design workload with structure, clear file management, and consistent follow-through; this is as critical as the creative craft. 

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite and relevant design software; comfortable working across digital and physical design processes. 

  • Experienced cross-functional collaborator; able to work effectively with merchandising, product management, development, and external key account contacts daily. 

  • Able to work independently at a senior individual contributor level while adapting to a young team’s evolving processes and ways of working. 

  • Fluent command of written and spoken English. 

 

Nie-to-haves: 

  • Experience with 3D or AI visualisation tools (e.g. Keyshot, CLO, or similar). 

  • Prior key account or B2B commercial design experience. 

  • Freelance background or experience adapting to feedback from diverse external clients. 

 

Life at ASICS
When you join ASICS, you become part of something special. Here, your voice matters, your growth and wellbeing are important. We believe in fostering an environment where every step forward is celebrated, where diversity fuels our journey, and inclusion strengthens individuals. And together and as individuals we can inspire more people to move for body and for mind. 

 

Our commitment to your wellbeing
We're dedicated to ensuring that every team member experiences the joy and benefits of movement. To support your wellbeing, we offer: 

  • Access to office gym and sports membership discount. 

  • Exclusive 50% discount on ASICS and ONITSUKA TIGER gear. 

  • Unlimited access to the Calm app for better sleep and mental fitness. 

  • Complimentary premium subscription to our Runkeeper Go™ app. 

  • A comprehensive wellness programme consisting of exercise and educational sessions. 

  • Professional support and meditation classes are available through OpenUp Access. 

  • Working abroad for four weeks every year. 

  • Hybrid working model. Combine the flexibility of working from home with the dynamic energy of an office environment. 

 

How to Apply
Are you feeling inspired? We'd love to hear from you. Submit your application online and step into a role where you can truly make a difference. Let's move together, step by step, toward an uplifted world.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Please note that for this role we are searching for someone who is proficient in the use of the Dutch language (B2 level) and is already living in the Netherlands.

De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als medior UX designer

Werken aan één van de meest cruciale vraagstukken binnen de energietransitie betekent dat je impact maakt op hoe besluiten worden genomen en processen worden ingericht. Je richt je op het ontwerpen van slimme systemen en logica die verder gaan dan alleen schermen. Daarbij combineer je UX met sterk business- en procesdenken, in een complexe omgeving waarin jouw werk écht het verschil maakt. En als UX designer (Interaction design & complexe flows) werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het:

  • Ontwerpen en verbeteren van end-to-end gebruikersflows en interaction patterns

  • Doorgronden van complexe domeinen zoals datamodellen en netstructuren

  • Vertalen van businessvraagstukken en stakeholderinput naar concrete ontwerpkeuzes

  • Structureren en versimpelen van processen samen met Product Owner en team

  • Werken op het snijvlak van UX en Business Analyse

  • Toetsen van ontwerpkeuzes op haalbaarheid met developers

  • Gericht toepassen van UX-methodieken waar nodig

  • Inzetten van AI-tools zoals Copilot en Figma AI

     

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers van Nederland. Dit doen we samen en met aandacht voor onze klant. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken wij de energietransitie mogelijk

Innovatieve applicaties ontwikkelen kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. De afdeling Digitalisering bestaat uit betrokken en behulpzame collega's. Jij gaat doen bij team Knelpuntadministratie & Keteninzicht (KaKi). Binnen KaKi werk je aan een centraal systeem waarin knelpunten op het elektriciteitsnet worden vastgelegd en in samenhang bekeken met klantvragen en technische oplossingsrichtingen. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair scrumteam met developers, een product owner en inhoudelijke experts. De omgeving is complex: veel data, afhankelijkheden en verschillende typen gebruikers.

Jouw belangrijkste uitdaging is het aanbrengen van structuur in deze complexiteit en het vertalen naar heldere, werkbare flows.

Werken met de nieuwste technieken en innovaties. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw logische manier van denken? En vul je dit daarnaast aan met:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als UX-designer in een enterprise omgeving

  • Sterke ervaring met interaction design en complexe flows

  • Vermogen om complexe context snel eigen te maken

  • Ervaring met vertalen van businessprocessen naar UX-oplossingen

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en requirements

  • Kennis van Design Thinking en methodieken

  • Ervaring met Figma en design systems

  • Agile mindset en ervaring in multidisciplinaire teams

  • AI-minded en ervaring met AI-tools in ontwerpwerk

  • Sterk analytisch en nieuwsgierig

Voor jou net beter geregeld

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

  • Aan de hand van kennis en ervaring een salaris van €4.672 tot €6.674 bruto per maand (schaal 9).

  • Jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.

  • 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB. Daarnaast is het mogelijk om 1 of 2 officiële feestdagen uit de cao uit te ruilen met feestdagen uit een andere cultuur of religie.

  • een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris.

  • elk jaar een DI-budget van € 500,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport of hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat.

  • Werken waar dit voor jou het beste werkt, als je functie dit toelaat. Vanaf kantoor of vanuit eigen huis. Zelfs een workation behoort tot de mogelijkheden. Werk je vanuit huis, dan ontvang je hiervoor een thuiswerktegemoetkoming.

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over Alliander en al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Voor jou net wat meer informatie

Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton op deze vacature voor de sluitingstermijn. Binnen 5 werkdagen krijg je een reactie van ons.
Bij grote hoeveelheden sollicitaties kan de vacature kan eerder offline gehaald worden dan de sluitingstermijn aangeeft. Ook kan er al contact opgenomen worden met sollicitanten voordat de sluitingsdatum van de vacature bereikt is.

Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden vind je meer informatie. Voor deze functie wordt een basis screening uitgevoerd. De Recruiter voorziet je van de

nodige informatie. Meer weten over de functie-inhoud of heb je nog vragen over de selectieprocedure of screening? Dan helpt Tim van Beek, Corporate Recruiter jou graag verder via tim.van.beek@alliander.com

  • Voor deze vacature zoeken wij geen ZZP'er of freelancer. Acquisitie naar deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Tim van Beek

positions.descriptionHtml:
Breng jij onze digitale dienstverlening naar een volgend level? Ons enthousiaste en ervaren UX-design team kan je hulp goed gebruiken om de digitale beleving van een van de grootste pensioenverzekeraars van Nederland te verbeteren. Pensioen lijkt misschien een 'saai’ onderwerp, maar dat maakt juist de gebruikerservaring extra belangrijk, uitdagend en vooral boeiend. Jij bent straks de doelgroep, wat weet jij nog niet en hoe kunnen wij dat ook aan onze gebruikers zo makkelijk mogelijk aanbieden? Ben jij de ultieme UX'er die zich verwondert, doorvraagt en durft te zeggen 'ik snap dit nog niet'?


Wat je gaat doen

Gebruikersinzichten en onderzoeksresultaten vertalen naar nieuwe designs voor onze digitale dienstverlening voor pensioenadviseurs, werkgevers met een pensioen voor hun werknemers bij Nationale-Nederlanden en de werknemers zelf.

Je gaat het UX design team helpen met het oplossen van échte klantproblemen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in alle onderdelen van het Design Thinking proces:

  • Voorbereiden en bijwonen gebruikersonderzoek
  • Participeren in design sessies
  • Uitwerken prototypes in Figma (gebruik makend van het NN Design System)
  • Valideren van het prototype
  • Designs klaarmaken voor de front-end developers


Wat wij jou bieden

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat jij je kunt blijven ontwikkelen. We geven je de ruimte en het vertrouwen om te groeien in je carrière en als mens. Wij helpen je hierbij met:

  • Stagevergoeding van €650.- op basis van 36 uur
  • Volop training- en opleidingsmogelijkheden in ons Learning & Development Centre
  • Een groot (internationaal) netwerk van collega’s die graag hun kennis met je delen
  • De autonomie om je eigen ontwikkelroute te bepalen
     

Wat je meebrengt

  • Enthousiasme en passie voor User Experience
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, verwondert & leert graag van de collega’s om je heen, maar vooral ook van de inzichten die gebruikers je geven
  • Vanuit je opleiding heb je ervaring met Figma

Met wie je werkt

In het team Propositie & Digital Experience zitten naast de UX-designers (3) en de UX lead, ook de Product Owners van de portalen van al onze doelgroepen en de Product/Propositie Marketeers. Dagelijks werk je samen met de UX-collega’s. Zij zoeken elkaar regelmatig op, zowel online als op kantoor om samen te werken en elkaar te inspireren. Het is een informeel en gezellig team met veel ervaring.

Bij NN werken we hybride. Deels vanuit huis en deels op kantoor. Teams ontmoeten elkaar digitaal, fysiek of hybride. Je spreekt samen met je team af wat het beste past. We hebben onze kantoren zo ingericht dat er voor elk type werk een passende plek is. De officiële standplaats van deze functie is Rotterdam, maar je vindt ons ook weleens bij UX-collega’s van andere afdelingen in Den Haag.


Rotterdam:

Als Stagiair UX designer Pensioen werk je direct naast Rotterdam Centraal, boven het  coffeecompany x Nationale-Nederlanden Café. Ideaal voor een goede kop koffie. In ons restaurant eet je een gezonde lunch en bieden we je ook een uitgebreide Aziatische keuken.
 

Heb je vragen?

Stel je vraag aan Rowena Taal, stage coördinator via Stagebureau@nn.nl.

Twijfel jij of je wel 100% aan de criteria voldoet? Dan willen we je aanmoedigen om toch te solliciteren. Wij zijn benieuwd naar jouw unieke kwaliteiten!
positions.descriptionMarkdown:
Breng jij onze digitale dienstverlening naar een volgend level? Ons enthousiaste en ervaren UX-design team kan je hulp goed gebruiken om de digitale beleving van een van de grootste pensioenverzekeraars van Nederland te verbeteren. Pensioen lijkt misschien een 'saai’ onderwerp, maar dat maakt juist de gebruikerservaring extra belangrijk, uitdagend en vooral boeiend. Jij bent straks de doelgroep, wat weet jij nog niet en hoe kunnen wij dat ook aan onze gebruikers zo makkelijk mogelijk aanbieden? Ben jij de ultieme UX'er die zich verwondert, doorvraagt en durft te zeggen 'ik snap dit nog niet'?

Wat je gaat doen

Gebruikersinzichten en onderzoeksresultaten vertalen naar nieuwe designs voor onze digitale dienstverlening voor pensioenadviseurs, werkgevers met een pensioen voor hun werknemers bij Nationale-Nederlanden en de werknemers zelf.

Je gaat het UX design team helpen met het oplossen van échte klantproblemen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in alle onderdelen van het Design Thinking proces:

- Voorbereiden en bijwonen gebruikersonderzoek
- Participeren in design sessies
- Uitwerken prototypes in Figma (gebruik makend van het NN Design System)
- Valideren van het prototype
- Designs klaarmaken voor de front-end developers
Wat wij jou bieden

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat jij je kunt blijven ontwikkelen. We geven je de ruimte en het vertrouwen om te groeien in je carrière en als mens. Wij helpen je hierbij met:

- Stagevergoeding van €650.- op basis van 36 uur
- Volop training- en opleidingsmogelijkheden in ons Learning & Development Centre
- Een groot (internationaal) netwerk van collega’s die graag hun kennis met je delen
- De autonomie om je eigen ontwikkelroute te bepalen
Wat je meebrengt

- Enthousiasme en passie voor User Experience
- Je bent nieuwsgierig, verwondert & leert graag van de collega’s om je heen, maar vooral ook van de inzichten die gebruikers je geven
- Vanuit je opleiding heb je ervaring met Figma
Met wie je werkt

In het team Propositie & Digital Experience zitten naast de UX-designers (3) en de UX lead, ook de Product Owners van de portalen van al onze doelgroepen en de Product/Propositie Marketeers. Dagelijks werk je samen met de UX-collega’s. Zij zoeken elkaar regelmatig op, zowel online als op kantoor om samen te werken en elkaar te inspireren. Het is een informeel en gezellig team met veel ervaring.

Bij NN werken we hybride. Deels vanuit huis en deels op kantoor. Teams ontmoeten elkaar digitaal, fysiek of hybride. Je spreekt samen met je team af wat het beste past. We hebben onze kantoren zo ingericht dat er voor elk type werk een passende plek is. De officiële standplaats van deze functie is Rotterdam, maar je vindt ons ook weleens bij UX-collega’s van andere afdelingen in Den Haag.

Rotterdam:

Als Stagiair UX designer Pensioen werk je direct naast Rotterdam Centraal, boven het coffeecompany x Nationale-Nederlanden Café. Ideaal voor een goede kop koffie. In ons restaurant eet je een gezonde lunch en bieden we je ook een uitgebreide Aziatische keuken.

Heb je vragen?

Stel je vraag aan Rowena Taal, stage coördinator via Stagebureau@nn.nl.

Twijfel jij of je wel 100% aan de criteria voldoet? Dan willen we je aanmoedigen om toch te solliciteren. Wij zijn benieuwd naar jouw unieke kwaliteiten!

Company Description:
  • Je beheert samen met het team meerdere KPMG-websites en zorgt dat deze actueel, stabiel en gebruiksvriendelijk blijven
  • Je voert dagelijks websitebeheer uit, zoals updates, performance checks en het oplossen van technische issues
  • Je plaatst en optimaliseert content in het CMS en ondersteunt collega’s bij vragen over webbeheer
  • Je stemt wijzigingen en releases af met IT en externe leveranciers en bewaakt een soepele livegang
  • Je draagt bij aan het naleven van richtlijnen rondom privacy, security en toegankelijkheid (WCAG)
  • Je analyseert websiteprestaties en werkt samen met collega’s aan verbeteringen in user journeys en digitale projecten
Job Description:

Als Web Designer ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor het beheer, de kwaliteit en de doorontwikkeling van verschillende KPMG-websites, zoals de corporate website, de careersite en de jaarverslagsite. Je combineert operationeel webbeheer met het doorvoeren van verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruiksvriendelijkheid, performance en toegankelijkheid. Daarbij ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor collega’s en ondersteun je hen bij het werken met het CMS en digital tooling.

Je werkt intensief samen met IT, externe leveranciers en collega’s binnen KPMG en zorgt ervoor dat wijzigingen goed worden afgestemd en gecontroleerd live gaan. Je houdt je actief bezig met website hygiene, zoals updates, security checks en het oplossen van technische issues. Tegelijkertijd denk je mee over hoe processen slimmer ingericht kunnen worden en hoe websites beter aansluiten op de behoefte van gebruikers.

Samen met de Sr. Web Designer / UX-specialist werk je aan het verbeteren van user journeys en het uitvoeren van audits. Je gebruikt data en inzichten uit analytics om optimalisaties door te voeren en maakt de impact van verbeteringen zichtbaar richting stakeholders. Zo draag je bij aan een stabiele, veilige en toekomstbestendige digitale omgeving binnen KPMG.

Je komt terecht in het Product Team Channels & Insights binnen Marketing & Reputation van KPMG Nederland. Dit team richt zich op de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van digitale kanalen.

Qualifications:
  • Je hebt een Hbo-opleiding in Web Design, Multimedia of een vergelijkbare richting
  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met webdesign en/of webbeheer binnen een professionele omgeving
  • Je hebt ervaring met een CMS, zoals WordPress of Drupal (Adobe is een pre)
  • Je beschikt over basiskennis van HTML en CSS (JavaScript is een pre)
  • Je communiceert vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels en schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders
  • Je hebt interesse in webstandaarden zoals toegankelijkheid, security, analytics en SEO en werkt graag samen met verschillende disciplines
  • Je hebt affiniteit met (generatieve) AI en bent gemotiveerd om deze technologie actief toe te passen in je dagelijkse werk
Additional Information:
  • Brutomaandsalaris tussen € 2.800,- en € 4.500,- afhankelijk van je werkervaring, variabele prestatie beloning, een vaste onkostenvergoeding en een vaste thuiswerkvergoeding per gewerkte dag.
  • Een flexibel pensioen zonder verplichte eigen bijdrage.
  • 30 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) en de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen of je vakantiedagen te verkopen.
  • Bij KPMG werken we hybride, dus een combinatie van zowel thuis, bij de klant als op kantoor.
  • Een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.
  • Vergoeding van je reiskosten met een NS business kaart of reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een laptop en iPhone.
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod van trainingen en opleidingen die bijdragen aan jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Diversiteitsnetwerken op het gebied van pride, gender, ability, cultural diversity en generations die regelmatig verschillende activiteiten organiseren om verschil te vieren!
  • Aandacht voor vitaliteit! Sporten op het kantoor in Amstelveen of korting op een sportschool bij jou in de buurt én toegang tot coaching, gezondheids- en vitaliteitprogramma’s.
  • ‘Together’ is één van onze kernwaarden. Je kunt dus rekenen op verschillende sociale activiteiten zoals teamuitjes, borrels en evenementen samen met je collega’s.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Company Description:

TOPdesk is an international Software company specializing in service management with 700 employees in 8 countries and 5,000 customers worldwide. For our office in Delft, Kaiserslautern or Budapest, we are looking for a UX Designer - Design Systems.

 

Your environment
As a UX Designer - Design Systems, you’ll join a multidisciplinary product enablement team, collaborating closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and other UX Designers. You’ll work in an environment that values creativity, user-centric thinking, and teamwork, with colleagues based in the Netherlands, Germany, and Hungary. You will report to a UX Manager and regularly engage with the Design System team and other stakeholders.

Job Description:
  • Adapt the design system to enable accurate prototyping with AI tooling.
  • Own components, patterns, and usage guidelines from definition to delivery.
  • Proactively identify gaps in the enterprise system and translate insights into accessible, inclusive, and scalable solutions.
  • Create prototypes to demo, test, and communicate component behavior to stakeholders.
  • Facilitate ideation and problem-solving with teammates and stakeholders.
  • Ensure consistency and efficiency across the system; propose new components or improvements when needed.
  • Define how design and code intersect, including AI-driven and token-aware surface needs.
  • Validate and refine components through feedback, usability testing, and data analysis.
  • Deliver clear documentation and handover materials for seamless developer implementation.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers to shape system decisions.
  • Contribute to raising design maturity and improving design processes across the organisation
  • Stay current on emerging trends, tools, and best practices in design systems and AI tooling.

 

Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of professional UX design experience
  • Degree or vocational qualification in design, HCI, or a related field.
  • Deep knowledge of design systems; not just how they work, but why.
  • Hands-on experience integrating design systems with AI tooling and token-based interactions.
  • Skilled in Figma for component and pattern design, prototyping, and documentation.
  • Experienced working across design, engineering, and accessibility.
  • Confident driving strategic decisions in a product triad.
  • Strong collaborator with clear communication across Engineers, PMs, and Designers.
  • Passionate about accessibility, inclusivity, and solving complex system-level challenges.
  • Proactive mindset; you come with a plan, not just intent.
  • Portfolio showing end-to-end design system work at meaningful scale.
Additional Information:
  • Working at one of the best employers in the Netherlands.
  • Contributing to an international, growing company.
  • 10 to Grow: you get 10% of your gross full-time salary and 10% of your contractual working time to spend freely on your personal development.
  • Energy left? Use 2.5% of your time for volunteer work.
  • Above all, be yourself! Diversity, inclusivity and social responsibility are of paramount importance to us.

positions.title: Verkoopmedewerker fulltime JACK&JONES Roosendaal Designer Outlet (Roosendaal, NB, NL, 4703 TB)
positions.description:
Verkoopmedewerker – JACK&JONES Roosendaal Designer OutletFulltime 32-38u
JACK&JONES, ONE CLUB!
Ben jij klaar om onze JACK&JONES-crew te versterken? Als Verkoopmedewerker verwelkom je klanten, geef je stijladvies en zorg je samen met je collega’s (de ONE CLUB!) dat de winkel er strak uitziet én elke klant zich welkom voelt. Bij JACK&JONES draait het om energie, teamspirit en resultaat. Je krijgt de vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid om echt impact te maken, of je nu helpt bij styling, winkelindeling of leveringen. Together we OWN IT.Zo ziet jouw werkdag eruitAls Verkoopmedewerker bij JACK&JONES zorg je ervoor dat de winkel er strak uitziet en dat klanten met een goed gevoel de deur uitgaan. Je verwelkomt ze met een glimlach, geeft stijladvies en helpt ze bij het vinden van denim-minded outfits die passen bij hun stijl. Ondertussen verwerk je nieuwe leveringen, vul je de winkel aan en wissel je werkzaamheden af tussen de vloer en de kassa. Samen met je team sluit je de dag af met een winkel die klaar is voor morgen.Wil jij deel uitmaken van een energiek team en écht het verschil maken op de winkelvloer? Lees dan verder!
Hier blink jij in uit

Energiek en servicegericht: jij zorgt ervoor dat iedere klant zich welkom voelt.
Je hebt feeling voor stijl én gevoel voor trends in de fashion wereld.
Je werkt graag samen en neemt actief verantwoordelijkheid binnen het team.
Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en blijft jezelf graag ontwikkelen.
Je bent flexibel beschikbaar, ook tijdens de gezellige drukte in de weekenden en overige piekmomenten.

Tik je nog niet alle boxen af? Geen probleem! Wij zoeken vooral de juiste mindset en drive!
Wat maakt dit jouw nieuwe werkplek?

Een eerlijk en marktconform salaris inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag.
Vakantiedagen, reiskosten (volledig vergoed met het openbaar vervoer), pensioenopbouw en een collectieve zorgverzekering: daar hoef jij je geen zorgen over te maken.
Shop je favoriete looks bij alle BESTSELLER brands met 20% personeelskorting, plus 30% extra verrekend met je brutoloon.

positions.descriptionHtml:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

 

Leadership/Team Quote:

The Partnerships department is responsible for all demand-facing B2B relationships at Booking.com, with full accountability for the B2B and B2B2C platform, product suite, business development, and account management. The Partnerships product team shapes how Booking.com's inventory and capabilities reach travelers through external platforms and partner integrations — from AI-native interfaces like ChatGPT and Claude to other partners within the Affiliates and Corporates markets.

 

Role Description:

As UX Designer in the Partnerships product team, you'll own the end-to-end experience of how Booking.com shows up across partner platforms and integrations. You'll keep the full journey in view when everyone else is focused on their slice, and collaborate with designers across the business who own adjacent parts of the experience to make sure it holds together.

 

You understand the technical landscape well enough to design for platform constraints and opportunities, not just surfaces. Whether that's AI-native interfaces or affiliate integrations — you shape interaction patterns that work within each platform's logic and make the experience legible to users.

 

You're also a practitioner of AI tooling yourself — using it to prototype faster, explore more options, and iterate at the pace this space demands. You bring structure to ambiguous briefs, work closely with product and engineering, and care about craft as much as speed.



Key Job Responsibilities and Duties: 

  • Contribute to a high-scale, complex, world-renowned product and see the real-time impact of your work on millions of travelers worldwide

  • Be part of a truly international fast-paced environment and performance-driven culture

  • Leverage opportunities to grow technically and personally via initiatives, hackathons, conferences, and UX community involvement

  • Design end-to-end user flows and UI solutions based on business needs and customer insights

  • Produce related UI and UX assets and relevant documentation

  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Research, Writing, and Engineering team members in conceiving design approaches, iterating/validating designs, and executing holistic, quality design solutions

  • Work with our design system team and components

  • Work with data analysts and internal tools to experiment and validate your proposed solutions



Qualifications & Skills:

  • Three to six years of experience designing production-level, high-quality assets for web products and native mobile apps

  • Advanced knowledge of desktop and web UI design methods, utilization of accessibility practices and design systems, and related the principles, concepts, and theories of product design

  • A successful track record of designing and shipping projects as evidenced in resume and portfolio

  • Experience collaborating with and influencing product management, copywriting, research, brand

  • Expertise in core design tools, such as Figma, Sketch, and familiarity with corporate collaboration and communication tools and software

  • Informing design approach and solutions based on customer insights garnered from quantitative and qualitative data and on business priorities

  • Strong communication, influence, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • Experience in leveraging AI tools (Figma Make, Claude Code, Bolt) on a regular basis to broaden discovery and accelerate delivery.

 

Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:



Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)

  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit 

 

Inclusion at Booking.com: 

 

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. 

 

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.” 

 

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

 

Application Process: 

  • Let’s go places together: How we Hire

 

Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.


Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

positions.title: Platform Solution Designer
positions.description: Company Description:As a Platform Solution Designer at KPN, you will work on the brand-new Nexora platform: the strategic Data & AI platform that is central to KPN’s digital transformation. You play a key role in the setup and adoption of this platform, with a direct impact on all KPN domains.You will work in a dynamic team with plenty of room for innovation, knowledge sharing, and personal growth. With excellent opportunities to work from home, attractive employment conditions, and extensive collaboration with stakeholders throughout KPN, this role is ideal for someone who wants to combine technical depth with strategic impact.Based in Amsterdam or working from home, you will work in a hybrid setup on the future of data within KPN.Job Description:As a Platform Solution Designer, you are the driving force behind designing and implementing technological solutions within the Nexora platform, KPN’s new central Data & AI platform. You ensure that the platform meets all performance requirements and aligns with KPN’s strategic objectives.You translate complex data and AI challenges into concrete platform configurations while guiding and advising teams. Thanks to you, data solutions can be realized faster, smarter, and more securely.Your responsibilities:Managing both the demand and supply sides of data solutions within the platform (demand management).Delivering appropriate configurations and optimal performance for the Nexora platform.Designing and implementing technological solutions in line with the strategy.Building an internal community for knowledge sharing and inspiration around data.Working closely with stakeholders and suppliers.Qualifications:You can easily switch between business objectives and concrete technology. You feel comfortable in complex stakeholder environments and can communicate technical information clearly. You are proactive, analytical, and collaborative.At the same time, you are curious about new technologies and trends in data and AI, and you know how to translate ideas into sustainable solutions.To be successful in this role, you will need at least:A Master’s degree (WO level) in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Data Science, or Engineering.At least 6 years of experience designing and implementing data or AI platform solutions.Experience with stakeholder management and demand management in a complex organization.Knowledge of platform configuration, performance requirements, and governance.Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English.Additional Information:Naturally, as an employer we also have a lot to offer you. This is what you can expect:A gross monthly salary of up to €9,177, depending on your relevant knowledge and work experience (based on 40 hours).A fixed 13th month salary, partly paid monthly and partly in January of the following year, or you can allocate it to a FLEX & BOOST goal of your choice.Annual individual and collective salary increases according to our collective labor agreement (CAO).€1,500 per year employability budget that you can use for training, coaching, or courses.Flexible leave days: colleagues can decide themselves (in consultation with their manager) how they use their leave.A good work–life balance.A home office package to optimally set up your workspace at home, including a mobile phone and laptop.50% discount on KPN products and services, allowing you to internet, call, and stream at a lower cost.Travel allowance: full reimbursement of public transport costs or €0.23 per km if traveling by car. Prefer cycling? You can claim €0.40 per km through our bicycle reimbursement.The option to purchase a lease bicycle, with KPN contributing monthly (for permanent contracts). From city bikes to e-bikes, racing bikes, or speed pedelecs—you choose what you ride.Excellent pension conditions: a total contribution of 23% of your pensionable salary, with KPN contributing 16% and you contributing 7%.We strongly believe in technology. It becomes even more powerful when combined with human connection—so we look forward to meeting you!Want to know more? Contact our recruiter Neo Nchabeleng at neo.nchabeleng@kpn.com.At KPN, our recruitment talent works smartly together to succeed. Therefore, acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

Company Description:

You will work in a dynamic team with plenty of room for innovation, knowledge sharing, and personal growth. With excellent opportunities to work from home, attractive employment conditions, and extensive collaboration with stakeholders throughout KPN, this role is ideal for someone who wants to combine technical depth with strategic impact.

Based in Amsterdam or working from home, you will work in a hybrid setup on the future of data within KPN.

Job Description:

As a Platform Solution Designer, you are the driving force behind designing and implementing technological solutions within the Nexora platform, KPN’s new central Data & AI platform. You ensure that the platform meets all performance requirements and aligns with KPN’s strategic objectives.

You translate complex data and AI challenges into concrete platform configurations while guiding and advising teams. Thanks to you, data solutions can be realized faster, smarter, and more securely.

Your responsibilities:

  • Managing both the demand and supply sides of data solutions within the platform (demand management).

  • Delivering appropriate configurations and optimal performance for the Nexora platform.

  • Designing and implementing technological solutions in line with the strategy.

  • Building an internal community for knowledge sharing and inspiration around data.

  • Working closely with stakeholders and suppliers.

Qualifications:

You can easily switch between business objectives and concrete technology. You feel comfortable in complex stakeholder environments and can communicate technical information clearly. You are proactive, analytical, and collaborative.

At the same time, you are curious about new technologies and trends in data and AI, and you know how to translate ideas into sustainable solutions.

To be successful in this role, you will need at least:

  • A Master’s degree (WO level) in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Data Science, or Engineering.

  • At least 6 years of experience designing and implementing data or AI platform solutions.

  • Experience with stakeholder management and demand management in a complex organization.

  • Knowledge of platform configuration, performance requirements, and governance.

  • Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English.

Additional Information:

Naturally, as an employer we also have a lot to offer you. This is what you can expect:

  • A gross monthly salary of up to €9,177, depending on your relevant knowledge and work experience (based on 40 hours).

  • A fixed 13th month salary, partly paid monthly and partly in January of the following year, or you can allocate it to a FLEX & BOOST goal of your choice.

  • Annual individual and collective salary increases according to our collective labor agreement (CAO).

  • €1,500 per year employability budget that you can use for training, coaching, or courses.

  • Flexible leave days: colleagues can decide themselves (in consultation with their manager) how they use their leave.

  • A good work–life balance.

  • A home office package to optimally set up your workspace at home, including a mobile phone and laptop.

  • 50% discount on KPN products and services, allowing you to internet, call, and stream at a lower cost.

  • Travel allowance: full reimbursement of public transport costs or €0.23 per km if traveling by car. Prefer cycling? You can claim €0.40 per km through our bicycle reimbursement.

  • The option to purchase a lease bicycle, with KPN contributing monthly (for permanent contracts). From city bikes to e-bikes, racing bikes, or speed pedelecs—you choose what you ride.

  • Excellent pension conditions: a total contribution of 23% of your pensionable salary, with KPN contributing 16% and you contributing 7%.

We strongly believe in technology. It becomes even more powerful when combined with human connection—so we look forward to meeting you!

Want to know more? Contact our recruiter Neo Nchabeleng at neo.nchabeleng@kpn.com.

At KPN, our recruitment talent works smartly together to succeed. Therefore, acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

positions.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and that can carry cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.


We are also developing different types of propulsion systems to power our future vehicles and missions. As a talented Turbomachinery AIT Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the development and production ramp-up of our e-pumps for the Huracan engine.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Turbomachinery AIT Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Prepare and execute assembly and test procedures for electric pump hardware, including inspection plans, acceptance testing and engine integration

  • Design and implement tooling for assembly and testing of pump components

  • Lead high-precision mechanical assembly of electric pump hardware (bearings, rotors, stators, seals)

  • Manage fluid interfaces and instrumentation on test articles, supporting integration at pump and engine levels

  • Support test preparation and execution with internal and external test bench teams

  • Act as a technical interface with design engineering teams, providing feedback for manufacturability, assembly, integration, and testability (MAIT)

  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams and external partners, including design engineers, AIT engineers and technicians, suppliers, and test facility operators, throughout the full test article lifecycle

What we would love to see from you

  • Bachelor's, master's or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field (master's and above preferred).

  • 1+ years of experience in turbomachinery MAIT or closely related fields with fluidic experience (Engineer I)

  • Hands-on experience with pump or rotating machinery testing (or equivalent experimental work)

  • Familiarity with dynamic seals, bearings, and manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, additive manufacturing, surface treatments, inspections) and their impact on tolerances and performance is highly valued

  • Solid understanding of cryogenics, thermodynamics, and fluid dynamics

  • Solution-oriented mindset, with the creativity and curiosity to tackle complex technical challenges

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

positions.descriptionHtml:
We are bsport. The place to be!

bsport is an all-in-one platform combining boutique fitness and advanced technology. Our platform helps our partners manage their bookings, payroll, marketing and more, to streamline operations and boost their commercial success.

Since we launched in 2019, we have already achieved the following:

  • We’ve built a community of over 7 million users 🤝

  • In December 2024 we have finalised the biggest Series B (€30 million)🏆

  • Grown our team to more than 200 employees 🚀

  • Experienced strong worldwide growth (75% YoY) and rapid geographical expansion (+20 countries)

We’re continuing to grow to become the #1 tech partner for boutique studios in Europe and the rest of the world!

Join us to write the next chapter of your career!

🎯 What you'll own & the role

📍Paris

Lead Design System Engineer

This is a lead role where you will have the opportunity to drive bsport's design system architecture, strategy, and vision, and have influence across the entire product, working closely with Design partner and Product teams.

Why this role is different?

Your initial focus will be Kaizen, our B2B design system powering our new back-office for studio managers, staff and teachers — a revamp is underway and you'll be leading the evolution of this Design system whilst all the company is building this new backoffice.

As you find your footing, the scope can expand to two additional systems: our white-label meta design system for B2C web, and our React Native mobile system. How these three systems relate, diverge, and potentially converge over time? That's yours to shape.

  • Lead the evolution of Kaizen, our B2B design system — architecture, component quality, documentation and adoption.

  • Drive accessibility improvements across the board — keyboard navigation, ARIA compliance, mobile interactions.

  • Own governance and standards: reduce redundancy, enforce consistency, and make sure product teams are building with the system, not around it.

  • Progressively extend your ownership to Fabrique (B2C web, white-label) and Okaia (React Native mobile).

  • Define how our design systems become AI-ready — machine-readable structure, cursor rules, agent-friendly naming conventions.

  • Bring vision on animation and micro-interactions to elevate the feel of our products.

  • Collaborate closely with our Sr. Design System Product Designer, with no PM or EM in between — high autonomy, high impact.

🌟You would be great fit if you have:

  • You have 4+ years of front-end experience, with at least 1 year as the primary owner or lead contributor of a mature design system.

  • You have a designer's eye — attention to detail, taste for quality, and the ability to push back on "good enough."

  • You're a systems thinker: you see redundancy, inconsistency, and debt across a codebase and know how to create order without slowing teams down.

  • You're fluent in React and TypeScript, and have solid knowledge of web components and advanced CSS (you know the difference between vh and dvh and why it matters).

  • You follow the design systems space closely and have opinions: who's leading, what's overrated, what's next.

  • You're excited about how LLMs and agents change the way we think about component architecture and developer tooling.

  • You have a portfolio or GitHub that shows design system work — real components, potential decisions and real trade-offs.

  • Bonus: experience with animation, transitions, and performance-optimized motion.

  • Bonus: React Native experience, or appetite to learn.

🌈🌍 Diversity is one of our most valuable assets, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences to help us build a more inclusive, equitable team.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply-curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn are just as important to us as specific skills.

What We Offer

We believe great work comes from happy, supported people-that’s why we offer meaningful perks designed to promote balance, growth, and connection.

💵 Attractive compensation package
Competitive salary packages based on your experience and role.

💻 Work-Life harmony
Hybrid model with 3 days per week in the office

🌎 Work from anywhere
Enjoy up to 15 days of remote work from abroad each year.

💪🏽 Exclusive perks
Stay active with a specially discounted HelloCSE membership.

🌍 Diverse fun loving team
Multicultural colleagues, after-work events, team-building & more.

Company Description:Founded in 2014, Shippeo is a leading European SaaS company transforming supply chain visibility.
